# pr-1512: gh-1511 [BUG] publish-fa-llm red since 08-14: pub.dev 'Only users are allowed to upload new packages' — first publish must be manual (one-time owner step)

## Description

Closes #1511
# gh-1511 — publish-fa-llm first-publish guard + docs

### Root Cause
pub.dev OIDC publishing can only upload new **versions** of an **existing** package — the first upload of a new package must come from an authenticated human. `fa_llm` didn't exist on pub.dev at tag `fa_llm-v0.1.0`, so the upload died with `Only users are allowed to upload new packages.` and the workflow had no pre-flight to explain it.

### Fix
- `.github/workflows/publish-fa-llm.yml` — new pre-flight step: HEAD-probe `https://pub.dev/api/packages/fa_llm`; on 404 prints the actionable first-publish steps (manual `dart pub publish` + OIDC publisher entry, links issue #1511) and exits with distinct code `10`; unexpected probe codes warn but continue. Verified locally: 404 ⇒ exit 10, 200 ⇒ guard passes.

name: Publish fa_llm

on:
  push:
    tags: ['fa_llm-v*']

# Cancel superseded runs of the same ref (issue #177).
concurrency:
  group: Publish fa_llm-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

permissions:
  id-token: write # OIDC — pub.dev verifies the GitHub identity, no secrets
  contents: read

jobs:
  publish:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: packages/fa_llm
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@6afc89df92d6eb3834022f73cd65adc8cdfcb92d # v1
        with:
          sdk: stable

      - run: dart pub get

      # Pre-flight (issue #1511): pub.dev OIDC publishing can only upload new
      # VERSIONS of an existing package — the first upload must be manual.
      # Probe the package; on 404 fail loudly with the actionable steps.
      - name: Pre-flight — package must already exist on pub.dev
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -I \
            https://pub.dev/api/packages/fa_llm || true)
          if [ "$code" = "404" ]; then
            echo "::error::fa_llm does not exist on pub.dev yet."
            echo "Automated (OIDC) publishing can only upload new VERSIONS of an"
            echo "existing package — the first upload must be done manually by an"
            echo "authenticated owner:"
            echo "  cd packages/fa_llm && dart pub publish"
            echo "Then add the OIDC publisher on pub.dev (package admin → automated"
            echo "publishing → GitHub Actions, repo IstiN/flutter_agent_harness,"
            echo "workflow publish-fa-llm.yml, tag pattern fa_llm-v*)."
            echo "See https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/issues/1511"
            exit 10
          fi
          if [ "$code" != "200" ]; then
            echo "::warning::pub.dev probe returned HTTP '${code:-<none>}' (expected 200); continuing anyway."
          fi

      - name: Publish to pub.dev
        run: dart pub publish --force

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Stage the publishable package into a target directory (issue #597).
#
# `dart publish` packs everything under the repo root that isn't
# gitignored — and the root hosts sub-projects that are NOT part of the
# pub package (flutter_app with its 57 MB wasm toolchain, yoclip media,
# browser_ext, office_addin, vendored forks, docs, packages/*). That
# blew the archive past pub.dev's hard 100 MB cap (v0.1.406: 100.4 MB).
#
# The staged copy carries the package surface (~32 MB) plus the two PATH
# dev-dependencies (packages/fa_llm_mock, vendored vendor/xterm —
# accepted by pub.dev since v0.1.369). pubspec_overrides.yaml (the
# local-only dart_tui vendor pin, "never ships to pub.dev" by its own
# comment) must NOT enter the stage: version solving would re-pin the
# path dep and fail (the v0.1.407 failure, exit 66).
#
# Usage: stage_publish_package.sh <target-dir>
# Exits non-zero (with ::error) when the staged tree exceeds the guard.
# The repo root hosts sub-projects that are NOT part of the pub package
# (flutter_app, yoclip, browser_ext, office_addin, vendored forks, docs)
# — `dart publish` packs everything under the root that isn't gitignored
# (v0.1.406: 100.4 MB, over pub.dev's hard cap). Stage the package
# surface instead. PATH dev-deps of the core pubspec must resolve inside
# the stage (#584, `dart pub get` exit 66 on v0.1.407): their subtrees
# are included BEFORE the parent excludes, and the parent excludes are
# child-scoped (vendor/*) — excluding the parent dir itself would prune
# the subtree before the includes are ever consulted.
# pubspec_overrides.yaml is the workspace-only dart_tui pin (never
# published, see its header); shipped into the stage it re-dangles
# dart_tui onto the excluded vendor dir.
set -euo pipefail

target="${1:?usage: stage_publish_package.sh <target-dir>}"
repo_root="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)"

mkdir -p "$target"
# Root-scoped excludes are ANCHORED: rsync matches an unanchored name
# against the basename at ANY depth — `memory` also pruned lib/src/memory/,
# shipping v0.1.411 with broken memory imports (issue #613). build/ and
# .dart_tool stay unanchored: build artifacts may appear at any depth and
# never belong in the stage.
# gh-1452: /CHANGELOG_ARCHIVE.md (the lossless trimmed tail of CHANGELOG.md)
# has no consumer in the pub package — GitHub carries the history. It is
# excluded below; must mirror /CHANGELOG_ARCHIVE.md in .pubignore (guarded
# by test/publish_staging_test.dart).
rsync -a "$repo_root"/ "$target"/ \
  --include 'vendor/xterm/' --include 'vendor/xterm/**' \
  --include 'packages/fa_llm_mock/' --include 'packages/fa_llm_mock/**' \
  --exclude '/.git' --exclude '/.github' --exclude '/.worktrees' \
  --exclude '/flutter_app' --exclude '/browser_ext' \
  --exclude '/office_addin' --exclude '/yoclip' \
  --exclude 'vendor/*' --exclude '/docs' --exclude '/fa-local' \
  --exclude 'packages/*' \
  --exclude '/pubspec_overrides.yaml' \
  --exclude '/CHANGELOG_ARCHIVE.md' \
  --exclude '.dart_tool' --exclude 'build' \
  --exclude '/memory' --exclude '/.trash' --exclude '/coverage'

size=$(du -sm "$target" | cut -f1)
echo "staged package: ${size} MB"
if [ "$size" -gt 90 ]; then
  echo "::error::staged package is ${size} MB (>90) — pub.dev caps uploads at 100 MB. Trim the staging excludes."
  exit 1
fi

## PR Description

Closes #1511
# gh-1511 — publish-fa-llm first-publish guard + docs

### Root Cause
pub.dev OIDC publishing can only upload new **versions** of an **existing** package — the first upload of a new package must come from an authenticated human. `fa_llm` didn't exist on pub.dev at tag `fa_llm-v0.1.0`, so the upload died with `Only users are allowed to upload new packages.` and the workflow had no pre-flight to explain it.

### Fix
- `.github/workflows/publish-fa-llm.yml` — new pre-flight step: HEAD-probe `https://pub.dev/api/packages/fa_llm`; on 404 prints the actionable first-publish steps (manual `dart pub publish` + OIDC publisher entry, links issue #1511) and exits with distinct code `10`; unexpected probe codes warn but continue. Verified locally: 404 ⇒ exit 10, 200 ⇒ guard passes.
- `packages/fa_llm/README.md` — new **Publishing** section documenting the tag → OIDC flow and the one-time manual first-publish dance.
- `AGENTS.md` (`Commits and releases`) — bullet covering the `fa_llm` publish path; previously only the core package's auto-release was documented.

### Test Coverage
- Guard logic exercised locally against pub.dev: nonexistent package → exit 10 with message; `fa_llm` → 200, publish proceeds. Workflow YAML parses clean.
- `packages/fa_llm`: 87 tests passed (no Dart code changed).

### Notes
- The owner one-time step is **already done**: `https://pub.dev/api/packages/fa_llm` returns 200, latest `0.1.0` live on pub.dev (acceptance 1 ✅).
- Remaining acceptance 2 (`workflow green on next tag`) needs the owner to confirm the OIDC publisher entry on pub.dev (package admin → automated publishing → GitHub Actions, repo `IstiN/flutter_agent_harness`, workflow `publish-fa-llm.yml`, tag pattern `fa_llm-v*`) and push a new `fa_llm-v*` tag — not verifiable from code.
- `packages/fa_llm/pubspec.lock` (created by local `pub get`) is gitignored and outside the `check_lockfiles.sh` inventory — intentionally not committed.

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-10):
💡 **SUGGESTION: bare `curl` — add retry/timeout flags per repo convention**

The pre-flight probe uses a bare `curl`:

```bash
code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -I \
  https://pub.dev/api/packages/fa_llm || true)
```

Two consequences:

1. **No timeout** — if the connection to pub.dev hangs, `curl` has no default timeout and the step can stall until the job-level timeout (default 6h on hosted runners).
2. **No retry** — a transient failure yields code `000`, which falls into the warn-and-continue branch. That's a safe fallback, but a transient blip would then push a publish through the unguarded path.

The repo convention elsewhere (`ci.yml`, `nightly.yml`, `build-macos.yml`) is:

```bash
curl --retry 3 --retry-all-errors --retry-delay 10 --max-time 600 \
  --connect-timeout 30 ...
```

Suggest at minimum:

```bash
code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -I \
  --retry 3 --retry-all-errors --connect-timeout 15 --max-time 60 \
  https://pub.dev/api/packages/fa_llm || true)
```

Note `--retry-all-errors` is needed for `--retry` to apply to the probe-style exit paths here (a plain `--retry` skips some transient failures such as curl 56 — already documented in `ci.yml:2051`).

## Description

# gh-1511 — publish-fa-llm first-publish guard + docs

### Root Cause
pub.dev OIDC publishing can only upload new **versions** of an **existing** package — the first upload of a new package must come from an authenticated human. `fa_llm` didn't exist on pub.dev at tag `fa_llm-v0.1.0`, so the upload died with `Only users are allowed to upload new packages.` and the workflow had no pre-flight to explain it.

- `.github/workflows/publish-fa-llm.yml` — new pre-flight step: HEAD-probe `https://pub.dev/api/packages/fa_llm`; on 404 prints the actionable first-publish steps (manual `dart pub publish` + OIDC publisher entry, links issue #1511) and exits with distinct code `10`; unexpected probe codes warn but continue. Verified locally: 404 ⇒ exit 10, 200 ⇒ guard passes.
- `packages/fa_llm/README.md` — new **Publishing** section documenting the tag → OIDC flow and the one-time manual first-publish dance.
- `AGENTS.md` (`Commits and releases`) — bullet covering the `fa_llm` publish path; previously only the core package's auto-release was documented.

### Test Coverage
- Guard logic exercised locally against pub.dev: nonexistent package → exit 10 with message; `fa_llm` → 200, publish proceeds. Workflow YAML parses clean.
- `packages/fa_llm`: 87 tests passed (no Dart code changed).

### Notes
- The owner one-time step is **already done**: `https://pub.dev/api/packages/fa_llm` returns 200, latest `0.1.0` live on pub.dev (acceptance 1 ✅).
- Remaining acceptance 2 (`workflow green on next tag`) needs the owner to confirm the OIDC publisher entry on pub.dev (package admin → automated publishing → GitHub Actions, repo `IstiN/flutter_agent_harness`, workflow `publish-fa-llm.yml`, tag pattern `fa_llm-v*`) and push a new `fa_llm-v*` tag — not verifiable from code.

name: Publish fa_llm

on:
  push:
    tags: ['fa_llm-v*']

# Cancel superseded runs of the same ref (issue #177).
concurrency:
  group: Publish fa_llm-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

permissions:
  id-token: write # OIDC — pub.dev verifies the GitHub identity, no secrets
  contents: read

jobs:
  publish:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: packages/fa_llm
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@6afc89df92d6eb3834022f73cd65adc8cdfcb92d # v1
        with:
          sdk: stable

      - run: dart pub get

      # Pre-flight (issue #1511): pub.dev OIDC publishing can only upload new
      # VERSIONS of an existing package — the first upload must be manual.
      # Probe the package; on 404 fail loudly with the actionable steps.
      - name: Pre-flight — package must already exist on pub.dev
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -I \
            https://pub.dev/api/packages/fa_llm || true)
          if [ "$code" = "404" ]; then
            echo "::error::fa_llm does not exist on pub.dev yet."
            echo "Automated (OIDC) publishing can only upload new VERSIONS of an"
            echo "existing package — the first upload must be done manually by an"
            echo "authenticated owner:"
            echo "  cd packages/fa_llm && dart pub publish"
            echo "Then add the OIDC publisher on pub.dev (package admin → automated"
            echo "publishing → GitHub Actions, repo IstiN/flutter_agent_harness,"
            echo "workflow publish-fa-llm.yml, tag pattern fa_llm-v*)."
            echo "See https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/issues/1511"
            exit 10
          fi
          if [ "$code" != "200" ]; then
            echo "::warning::pub.dev probe returned HTTP '${code:-<none>}' (expected 200); continuing anyway."
          fi

      - name: Publish to pub.dev
        run: dart pub publish --force

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Stage the publishable package into a target directory (issue #597).
#
# `dart publish` packs everything under the repo root that isn't
# gitignored — and the root hosts sub-projects that are NOT part of the
# pub package (flutter_app with its 57 MB wasm toolchain, yoclip media,
# browser_ext, office_addin, vendored forks, docs, packages/*). That
# blew the archive past pub.dev's hard 100 MB cap (v0.1.406: 100.4 MB).
#
# The staged copy carries the package surface (~32 MB) plus the two PATH
# dev-dependencies (packages/fa_llm_mock, vendored vendor/xterm —
# accepted by pub.dev since v0.1.369). pubspec_overrides.yaml (the
# local-only dart_tui vendor pin, "never ships to pub.dev" by its own
# comment) must NOT enter the stage: version solving would re-pin the
# path dep and fail (the v0.1.407 failure, exit 66).
#
# Usage: stage_publish_package.sh <target-dir>
# Exits non-zero (with ::error) when the staged tree exceeds the guard.
# The repo root hosts sub-projects that are NOT part of the pub package
# (flutter_app, yoclip, browser_ext, office_addin, vendored forks, docs)
# — `dart publish` packs everything under the root that isn't gitignored
# (v0.1.406: 100.4 MB, over pub.dev's hard cap). Stage the package
# surface instead. PATH dev-deps of the core pubspec must resolve inside
# the stage (#584, `dart pub get` exit 66 on v0.1.407): their subtrees
# are included BEFORE the parent excludes, and the parent excludes are
# child-scoped (vendor/*) — excluding the parent dir itself would prune
# the subtree before the includes are ever consulted.
# pubspec_overrides.yaml is the workspace-only dart_tui pin (never
# published, see its header); shipped into the stage it re-dangles
# dart_tui onto the excluded vendor dir.
set -euo pipefail

target="${1:?usage: stage_publish_package.sh <target-dir>}"
repo_root="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)"

mkdir -p "$target"
# Root-scoped excludes are ANCHORED: rsync matches an unanchored name
# against the basename at ANY depth — `memory` also pruned lib/src/memory/,
# shipping v0.1.411 with broken memory imports (issue #613). build/ and
# .dart_tool stay unanchored: build artifacts may appear at any depth and
# never belong in the stage.
# gh-1452: /CHANGELOG_ARCHIVE.md (the lossless trimmed tail of CHANGELOG.md)
# has no consumer in the pub package — GitHub carries the history. It is
# excluded below; must mirror /CHANGELOG_ARCHIVE.md in .pubignore (guarded
# by test/publish_staging_test.dart).
rsync -a "$repo_root"/ "$target"/ \
  --include 'vendor/xterm/' --include 'vendor/xterm/**' \
  --include 'packages/fa_llm_mock/' --include 'packages/fa_llm_mock/**' \
  --exclude '/.git' --exclude '/.github' --exclude '/.worktrees' \
  --exclude '/flutter_app' --exclude '/browser_ext' \
  --exclude '/office_addin' --exclude '/yoclip' \
  --exclude 'vendor/*' --exclude '/docs' --exclude '/fa-local' \
  --exclude 'packages/*' \
  --exclude '/pubspec_overrides.yaml' \
  --exclude '/CHANGELOG_ARCHIVE.md' \
  --exclude '.dart_tool' --exclude 'build' \
  --exclude '/memory' --exclude '/.trash' --exclude '/coverage'

size=$(du -sm "$target" | cut -f1)
echo "staged package: ${size} MB"
if [ "$size" -gt 90 ]; then
  echo "::error::staged package is ${size} MB (>90) — pub.dev caps uploads at 100 MB. Trim the staging excludes."
  exit 1
fi

## PR Description

Closes #1511
# gh-1511 — publish-fa-llm first-publish guard + docs

### Root Cause
pub.dev OIDC publishing can only upload new **versions** of an **existing** package — the first upload of a new package must come from an authenticated human. `fa_llm` didn't exist on pub.dev at tag `fa_llm-v0.1.0`, so the upload died with `Only users are allowed to upload new packages.` and the workflow had no pre-flight to explain it.

### Fix
- `.github/workflows/publish-fa-llm.yml` — new pre-flight step: HEAD-probe `https://pub.dev/api/packages/fa_llm`; on 404 prints the actionable first-publish steps (manual `dart pub publish` + OIDC publisher entry, links issue #1511) and exits with distinct code `10`; unexpected probe codes warn but continue. Verified locally: 404 ⇒ exit 10, 200 ⇒ guard passes.
- `packages/fa_llm/README.md` — new **Publishing** section documenting the tag → OIDC flow and the one-time manual first-publish dance.
- `AGENTS.md` (`Commits and releases`) — bullet covering the `fa_llm` publish path; previously only the core package's auto-release was documented.

### Test Coverage
- Guard logic exercised locally against pub.dev: nonexistent package → exit 10 with message; `fa_llm` → 200, publish proceeds. Workflow YAML parses clean.
- `packages/fa_llm`: 87 tests passed (no Dart code changed).

### Notes
- The owner one-time step is **already done**: `https://pub.dev/api/packages/fa_llm` returns 200, latest `0.1.0` live on pub.dev (acceptance 1 ✅).
- Remaining acceptance 2 (`workflow green on next tag`) needs the owner to confirm the OIDC publisher entry on pub.dev (package admin → automated publishing → GitHub Actions, repo `IstiN/flutter_agent_harness`, workflow `publish-fa-llm.yml`, tag pattern `fa_llm-v*`) and push a new `fa_llm-v*` tag — not verifiable from code.
- `packages/fa_llm/pubspec.lock` (created by local `pub get`) is gitignored and outside the `check_lockfiles.sh` inventory — intentionally not committed.

### Thread 1 — `.github/workflows/publish-fa-llm.yml`

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-10):
💡 **SUGGESTION: bare `curl` — add retry/timeout flags per repo convention**

The pre-flight probe uses a bare `curl`:

```bash
code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -I \
  https://pub.dev/api/packages/fa_llm || true)
```

Two consequences:

1. **No timeout** — if the connection to pub.dev hangs, `curl` has no default timeout and the step can stall until the job-level timeout (default 6h on hosted runners).
2. **No retry** — a transient failure yields code `000`, which falls into the warn-and-continue branch. That's a safe fallback, but a transient blip would then push a publish through the unguarded path.

The repo convention elsewhere (`ci.yml`, `nightly.yml`, `build-macos.yml`) is:

```bash
curl --retry 3 --retry-all-errors --retry-delay 10 --max-time 600 \
  --connect-timeout 30 ...
```

Suggest at minimum:

```bash
code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -I \
  --retry 3 --retry-all-errors --connect-timeout 15 --max-time 60 \
  https://pub.dev/api/packages/fa_llm || true)
```

Note `--retry-all-errors` is needed for `--retry` to apply to the probe-style exit paths here (a plain `--retry` skips some transient failures such as curl 56 — already documented in `ci.yml:2051`).

# pr-1512: gh-1511 [BUG] publish-fa-llm red since 08-14: pub.dev 'Only users are allowed to upload new packages' — first publish must be manual (one-time owner step)

## Description

Closes #1511
# gh-1511 — publish-fa-llm first-publish guard + docs

### Root Cause
pub.dev OIDC publishing can only upload new **versions** of an **existing** package — the first upload of a new package must come from an authenticated human. `fa_llm` didn't exist on pub.dev at tag `fa_llm-v0.1.0`, so the upload died with `Only users are allowed to upload new packages.` and the workflow had no pre-flight to explain it.

### Fix
- `.github/workflows/publish-fa-llm.yml` — new pre-flight step: HEAD-probe `https://pub.dev/api/packages/fa_llm`; on 404 prints the actionable first-publish steps (manual `dart pub publish` + OIDC publisher entry, links issue #1511) and exits with distinct code `10`; unexpected probe codes warn but continue. Verified locally: 404 ⇒ exit 10, 200 ⇒ guard passes.
- `packages/fa_llm/README.md` — new **Publishing** section documenting the tag → OIDC flow and the one-time manual first-publish dance.
- `AGENTS.md` (`Commits and releases`) — bullet covering the `fa_llm` publish path; previously only the core package's auto-release was documented.

### Test Coverage
- Guard logic exercised locally against pub.dev: nonexistent package → exit 10 with message; `fa_llm` → 200, publish proceeds. Workflow YAML parses clean.
- `packages/fa_llm`: 87 tests passed (no Dart code changed).

### Notes
- The owner one-time step is **already done**: `https://pub.dev/api/packages/fa_llm` returns 200, latest `0.1.0` live on pub.dev (acceptance 1 ✅).
- Remaining acceptance 2 (`workflow green on next tag`) needs the owner to confirm the OIDC publisher entry on pub.dev (package admin → automated publishing → GitHub Actions, repo `IstiN/flutter_agent_harness`, workflow `publish-fa-llm.yml`, tag pattern `fa_llm-v*`) and push a new `fa_llm-v*` tag — not verifiable from code.
- `packages/fa_llm/pubspec.lock` (created by local `pub get`) is gitignored and outside the `check_lockfiles.sh` inventory — intentionally not committed.

            echo "authenticated owner:"
            echo "  cd packages/fa_llm && dart pub publish"
            echo "Then add the OIDC publisher on pub.dev (package admin → automated"
            echo "publishing → GitHub Actions, repo IstiN/flutter_agent_harness,"
            echo "workflow publish-fa-llm.yml, tag pattern fa_llm-v*)."
            echo "See https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/issues/1511"

        run: dart pub publish --force

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Stage the publishable package into a target directory (issue #597).
#
# `dart publish` packs everything under the repo root that isn't
# gitignored — and the root hosts sub-projects that are NOT part of the
# pub package (flutter_app with its 57 MB wasm toolchain, yoclip media,
# browser_ext, office_addin, vendored forks, docs, packages/*). That
# blew the archive past pub.dev's hard 100 MB cap (v0.1.406: 100.4 MB).
#
# The staged copy carries the package surface (~32 MB) plus the two PATH
# dev-dependencies (packages/fa_llm_mock, vendored vendor/xterm —
# accepted by pub.dev since v0.1.369). pubspec_overrides.yaml (the
# local-only dart_tui vendor pin, "never ships to pub.dev" by its own
# comment) must NOT enter the stage: version solving would re-pin the
# path dep and fail (the v0.1.407 failure, exit 66).
#
# Usage: stage_publish_package.sh <target-dir>
# Exits non-zero (with ::error) when the staged tree exceeds the guard.
# The repo root hosts sub-projects that are NOT part of the pub package
# (flutter_app, yoclip, browser_ext, office_addin, vendored forks, docs)
# — `dart publish` packs everything under the root that isn't gitignored
# (v0.1.406: 100.4 MB, over pub.dev's hard cap). Stage the package
# surface instead. PATH dev-deps of the core pubspec must resolve inside
# the stage (#584, `dart pub get` exit 66 on v0.1.407): their subtrees
# are included BEFORE the parent excludes, and the parent excludes are
# child-scoped (vendor/*) — excluding the parent dir itself would prune
# the subtree before the includes are ever consulted.
# pubspec_overrides.yaml is the workspace-only dart_tui pin (never
# published, see its header); shipped into the stage it re-dangles
# dart_tui onto the excluded vendor dir.
set -euo pipefail

target="${1:?usage: stage_publish_package.sh <target-dir>}"
repo_root="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)"

mkdir -p "$target"
# Root-scoped excludes are ANCHORED: rsync matches an unanchored name
# against the basename at ANY depth — `memory` also pruned lib/src/memory/,
# shipping v0.1.411 with broken memory imports (issue #613). build/ and
# .dart_tool stay unanchored: build artifacts may appear at any depth and
# never belong in the stage.
# gh-1452: /CHANGELOG_ARCHIVE.md (the lossless trimmed tail of CHANGELOG.md)
# has no consumer in the pub package — GitHub carries the history. It is
# excluded below; must mirror /CHANGELOG_ARCHIVE.md in .pubignore (guarded
# by test/publish_staging_test.dart).
rsync -a "$repo_root"/ "$target"/ \
  --include 'vendor/xterm/' --include 'vendor/xterm/**' \
  --include 'packages/fa_llm_mock/' --include 'packages/fa_llm_mock/**' \
  --exclude '/.git' --exclude '/.github' --exclude '/.worktrees' \
  --exclude '/flutter_app' --exclude '/browser_ext' \
  --exclude '/office_addin' --exclude '/yoclip' \
  --exclude 'vendor/*' --exclude '/docs' --exclude '/fa-local' \
  --exclude 'packages/*' \
  --exclude '/pubspec_overrides.yaml' \
  --exclude '/CHANGELOG_ARCHIVE.md' \
  --exclude '.dart_tool' --exclude 'build' \
  --exclude '/memory' --exclude '/.trash' --exclude '/coverage'

size=$(du -sm "$target" | cut -f1)
echo "staged package: ${size} MB"
if [ "$size" -gt 90 ]; then
  echo "::error::staged package is ${size} MB (>90) — pub.dev caps uploads at 100 MB. Trim the staging excludes."
  exit 1
fi

# Publish gate at PR time: publish-blocking problems (undeclared lib/
      # imports, stray PEM-like strings) used to surface only in the tag-time
      # publish job — the v0.1.331 era: an undeclared package:cryptography
      # import shipped red on ~26 consecutive tags. --ignore-warnings: the
      # two known layout warnings (gitignored install_local.sh, docs/
      # naming) must not redden every PR, while validation ERRORS — "does
      # not have X in the dependencies section of pubspec.yaml" — still
      # fail. setup-dart (sdk >= 3.13) registers a publish-scoped PUB_TOKEN
      # job-wide and pub.dev rejects authenticated metadata reads, so
      # resolve unauthenticated (same pattern as the publish job);
      # --dry-run never uploads.
      - name: Publish dry-run (unauthenticated)
        run: |
          dart pub token remove https://pub.dev || true
          dart pub publish --dry-run --ignore-warnings

      # The example Flutter app lives in this repo; without its package
      # config the repo-wide `dart analyze` cannot resolve Flutter imports.
      - name: Example app pub get (for repo-wide analyze)
        uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

      # The repo-wide `dart analyze` also walks office_addin/dart; without
      # its package config the analyzer cannot resolve
      # `package:fa_office_agent/...` imports (nightly full-quality was red
      # on email_quarantine_test.dart since the add-in landed). ci.yml's
      # analyze job already does this — nightly must match.
      - name: Office add-in pub get (for repo-wide analyze)
        run: dart pub get --directory=office_addin/dart

      # .env is gitignored but declared as a Flutter asset (flutter_dotenv);

# publish job — the v0.1.331 era: an undeclared package:cryptography
      # import shipped red on ~26 consecutive tags. --ignore-warnings: the
      # two known layout warnings (gitignored install_local.sh, docs/
      # naming) must not redden every PR, while validation ERRORS — "does
      # not have X in the dependencies section of pubspec.yaml" — still
      # fail. setup-dart (sdk >= 3.13) registers a publish-scoped PUB_TOKEN
      # job-wide and pub.dev rejects authenticated metadata reads, so
      # resolve unauthenticated (same pattern as the publish job);
      # --dry-run never uploads.
      - name: Publish dry-run (unauthenticated)
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        run: |
          dart pub token remove https://pub.dev || true
          # Against the STAGED tree, not the repo root (#597 AC1): the
          # publish job publishes from the stage — the v0.1.407 class of
          # failure (staged resolution re-pinning vendor/dart_tui through
          # pubspec_overrides.yaml) must redden the PR, not the tag.
          bash scripts/stage_publish_package.sh /tmp/pr-dry-run-stage
          # The staged tree must ANALYZE clean: v0.1.411 shipped files
          # with broken imports (the staging filter pruned lib/src/memory;
          # imports of fork-only dart_tui symbols) that only a consumer's
          # `dart analyze` ever surfaced (issue #613). Errors fail the
          # gate; warnings/infos pass, matching the static analyze stage.
          (cd /tmp/pr-dry-run-stage && dart pub get && dart analyze)
          (cd /tmp/pr-dry-run-stage && dart pub publish --dry-run --ignore-warnings)

# gh-1511 — publish-fa-llm first-publish guard + docs

### Root Cause
pub.dev OIDC publishing can only upload new **versions** of an **existing** package — the first upload of a new package must come from an authenticated human. `fa_llm` didn't exist on pub.dev at tag `fa_llm-v0.1.0`, so the upload died with `Only users are allowed to upload new packages.` and the workflow had no pre-flight to explain it.

### Fix
- `.github/workflows/publish-fa-llm.yml` — new pre-flight step: HEAD-probe `https://pub.dev/api/packages/fa_llm`; on 404 prints the actionable first-publish steps (manual `dart pub publish` + OIDC publisher entry, links issue #1511) and exits with distinct code `10`; unexpected probe codes warn but continue. Verified locally: 404 ⇒ exit 10, 200 ⇒ guard passes.
- `packages/fa_llm/README.md` — new **Publishing** section documenting the tag → OIDC flow and the one-time manual first-publish dance.
- `AGENTS.md` (`Commits and releases`) — bullet covering the `fa_llm` publish path; previously only the core package's auto-release was documented.

### Test Coverage
- Guard logic exercised locally against pub.dev: nonexistent package → exit 10 with message; `fa_llm` → 200, publish proceeds. Workflow YAML parses clean.
- `packages/fa_llm`: 87 tests passed (no Dart code changed).

### Notes
- The owner one-time step is **already done**: `https://pub.dev/api/packages/fa_llm` returns 200, latest `0.1.0` live on pub.dev (acceptance 1 ✅).
- Remaining acceptance 2 (`workflow green on next tag`) needs the owner to confirm the OIDC publisher entry on pub.dev (package admin → automated publishing → GitHub Actions, repo `IstiN/flutter_agent_harness`, workflow `publish-fa-llm.yml`, tag pattern `fa_llm-v*`) and push a new `fa_llm-v*` tag — not verifiable from code.
- `packages/fa_llm/pubspec.lock` (created by local `pub get`) is gitignored and outside the `check_lockfiles.sh` inventory — intentionally not committed.

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-10):
💡 **SUGGESTION: bare `curl` — add retry/timeout flags per repo convention**

The pre-flight probe uses a bare `curl`:

```bash
code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -I \
  https://pub.dev/api/packages/fa_llm || true)
```

Two consequences:

1. **No timeout** — if the connection to pub.dev hangs, `curl` has no default timeout and the step can stall until the job-level timeout (default 6h on hosted runners).
2. **No retry** — a transient failure yields code `000`, which falls into the warn-and-continue branch. That's a safe fallback, but a transient blip would then push a publish through the unguarded path.

The repo convention elsewhere (`ci.yml`, `nightly.yml`, `build-macos.yml`) is:

```bash
curl --retry 3 --retry-all-errors --retry-delay 10 --max-time 600 \
  --connect-timeout 30 ...
```

Suggest at minimum:

```bash
code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -I \
  --retry 3 --retry-all-errors --connect-timeout 15 --max-time 60 \
  https://pub.dev/api/packages/fa_llm || true)
```

Note `--retry-all-errors` is needed for `--retry` to apply to the probe-style exit paths here (a plain `--retry` skips some transient failures such as curl 56 — already documented in `ci.yml:2051`).

## Description

Closes #1511
# gh-1511 — publish-fa-llm first-publish guard + docs

### Root Cause
pub.dev OIDC publishing can only upload new **versions** of an **existing** package — the first upload of a new package must come from an authenticated human. `fa_llm` didn't exist on pub.dev at tag `fa_llm-v0.1.0`, so the upload died with `Only users are allowed to upload new packages.` and the workflow had no pre-flight to explain it.

### Fix
- `.github/workflows/publish-fa-llm.yml` — new pre-flight step: HEAD-probe `https://pub.dev/api/packages/fa_llm`; on 404 prints the actionable first-publish steps (manual `dart pub publish` + OIDC publisher entry, links issue #1511) and exits with distinct code `10`; unexpected probe codes warn but continue. Verified locally: 404 ⇒ exit 10, 200 ⇒ guard passes.
- `packages/fa_llm/README.md` — new **Publishing** section documenting the tag → OIDC flow and the one-time manual first-publish dance.
- `AGENTS.md` (`Commits and releases`) — bullet covering the `fa_llm` publish path; previously only the core package's auto-release was documented.

### Test Coverage
- Guard logic exercised locally against pub.dev: nonexistent package → exit 10 with message; `fa_llm` → 200, publish proceeds. Workflow YAML parses clean.
- `packages/fa_llm`: 87 tests passed (no Dart code changed).

### Notes
- The owner one-time step is **already done**: `https://pub.dev/api/packages/fa_llm` returns 200, latest `0.1.0` live on pub.dev (acceptance 1 ✅).
- Remaining acceptance 2 (`workflow green on next tag`) needs the owner to confirm the OIDC publisher entry on pub.dev (package admin → automated publishing → GitHub Actions, repo `IstiN/flutter_agent_harness`, workflow `publish-fa-llm.yml`, tag pattern `fa_llm-v*`) and push a new `fa_llm-v*` tag — not verifiable from code.
- `packages/fa_llm/pubspec.lock` (created by local `pub get`) is gitignored and outside the `check_lockfiles.sh` inventory — intentionally not committed.

name: Publish fa_llm

on:
  push:
    tags: ['fa_llm-v*']

# Cancel superseded runs of the same ref (issue #177).
concurrency:
  group: Publish fa_llm-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

permissions:
  id-token: write # OIDC — pub.dev verifies the GitHub identity, no secrets
  contents: read

jobs:
  publish:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: packages/fa_llm
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@6afc89df92d6eb3834022f73cd65adc8cdfcb92d # v1
        with:
          sdk: stable

      - run: dart pub get

      # Pre-flight (issue #1511): pub.dev OIDC publishing can only upload new
      # VERSIONS of an existing package — the first upload must be manual.
      # Probe the package; on 404 fail loudly with the actionable steps.
      - name: Pre-flight — package must already exist on pub.dev
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -I \
            https://pub.dev/api/packages/fa_llm || true)
          if [ "$code" = "404" ]; then
            echo "::error::fa_llm does not exist on pub.dev yet."
            echo "Automated (OIDC) publishing can only upload new VERSIONS of an"
            echo "existing package — the first upload must be done manually by an"
            echo "authenticated owner:"
            echo "  cd packages/fa_llm && dart pub publish"
            echo "Then add the OIDC publisher on pub.dev (package admin → automated"
            echo "publishing → GitHub Actions, repo IstiN/flutter_agent_harness,"
            echo "workflow publish-fa-llm.yml, tag pattern fa_llm-v*)."
            echo "See https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/issues/1511"
            exit 10
          fi
          if [ "$code" != "200" ]; then
            echo "::warning::pub.dev probe returned HTTP '${code:-<none>}' (expected 200); continuing anyway."
          fi

      - name: Publish to pub.dev
        run: dart pub publish --force

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Stage the publishable package into a target directory (issue #597).
#
# `dart publish` packs everything under the repo root that isn't
# gitignored — and the root hosts sub-projects that are NOT part of the
# pub package (flutter_app with its 57 MB wasm toolchain, yoclip media,
# browser_ext, office_addin, vendored forks, docs, packages/*). That
# blew the archive past pub.dev's hard 100 MB cap (v0.1.406: 100.4 MB).
#
# The staged copy carries the package surface (~32 MB) plus the two PATH
# dev-dependencies (packages/fa_llm_mock, vendored vendor/xterm —
# accepted by pub.dev since v0.1.369). pubspec_overrides.yaml (the
# local-only dart_tui vendor pin, "never ships to pub.dev" by its own
# comment) must NOT enter the stage: version solving would re-pin the
# path dep and fail (the v0.1.407 failure, exit 66).
#
# Usage: stage_publish_package.sh <target-dir>
# Exits non-zero (with ::error) when the staged tree exceeds the guard.
# The repo root hosts sub-projects that are NOT part of the pub package
# (flutter_app, yoclip, browser_ext, office_addin, vendored forks, docs)
# — `dart publish` packs everything under the root that isn't gitignored
# (v0.1.406: 100.4 MB, over pub.dev's hard cap). Stage the package
# surface instead. PATH dev-deps of the core pubspec must resolve inside
# the stage (#584, `dart pub get` exit 66 on v0.1.407): their subtrees
# are included BEFORE the parent excludes, and the parent excludes are
# child-scoped (vendor/*) — excluding the parent dir itself would prune
# the subtree before the includes are ever consulted.
# pubspec_overrides.yaml is the workspace-only dart_tui pin (never
# published, see its header); shipped into the stage it re-dangles
# dart_tui onto the excluded vendor dir.
set -euo pipefail

target="${1:?usage: stage_publish_package.sh <target-dir>}"
repo_root="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)"

mkdir -p "$target"
# Root-scoped excludes are ANCHORED: rsync matches an unanchored name
# against the basename at ANY depth — `memory` also pruned lib/src/memory/,
# shipping v0.1.411 with broken memory imports (issue #613). build/ and
# .dart_tool stay unanchored: build artifacts may appear at any depth and
# never belong in the stage.
# gh-1452: /CHANGELOG_ARCHIVE.md (the lossless trimmed tail of CHANGELOG.md)
# has no consumer in the pub package — GitHub carries the history. It is
# excluded below; must mirror /CHANGELOG_ARCHIVE.md in .pubignore (guarded
# by test/publish_staging_test.dart).
rsync -a "$repo_root"/ "$target"/ \
  --include 'vendor/xterm/' --include 'vendor/xterm/**' \
  --include 'packages/fa_llm_mock/' --include 'packages/fa_llm_mock/**' \
  --exclude '/.git' --exclude '/.github' --exclude '/.worktrees' \
  --exclude '/flutter_app' --exclude '/browser_ext' \
  --exclude '/office_addin' --exclude '/yoclip' \
  --exclude 'vendor/*' --exclude '/docs' --exclude '/fa-local' \
  --exclude 'packages/*' \
  --exclude '/pubspec_overrides.yaml' \
  --exclude '/CHANGELOG_ARCHIVE.md' \
  --exclude '.dart_tool' --exclude 'build' \
  --exclude '/memory' --exclude '/.trash' --exclude '/coverage'

size=$(du -sm "$target" | cut -f1)
echo "staged package: ${size} MB"
if [ "$size" -gt 90 ]; then
  echo "::error::staged package is ${size} MB (>90) — pub.dev caps uploads at 100 MB. Trim the staging excludes."
  exit 1
fi

## PR Description

# gh-1511 — publish-fa-llm first-publish guard + docs

### Root Cause
pub.dev OIDC publishing can only upload new **versions** of an **existing** package — the first upload of a new package must come from an authenticated human. `fa_llm` didn't exist on pub.dev at tag `fa_llm-v0.1.0`, so the upload died with `Only users are allowed to upload new packages.` and the workflow had no pre-flight to explain it.

### Fix
- `.github/workflows/publish-fa-llm.yml` — new pre-flight step: HEAD-probe `https://pub.dev/api/packages/fa_llm`; on 404 prints the actionable first-publish steps (manual `dart pub publish` + OIDC publisher entry, links issue #1511) and exits with distinct code `10`; unexpected probe codes warn but continue. Verified locally: 404 ⇒ exit 10, 200 ⇒ guard passes.
- `packages/fa_llm/README.md` — new **Publishing** section documenting the tag → OIDC flow and the one-time manual first-publish dance.
- `AGENTS.md` (`Commits and releases`) — bullet covering the `fa_llm` publish path; previously only the core package's auto-release was documented.

### Test Coverage
- Guard logic exercised locally against pub.dev: nonexistent package → exit 10 with message; `fa_llm` → 200, publish proceeds. Workflow YAML parses clean.
- `packages/fa_llm`: 87 tests passed (no Dart code changed).

### Notes
- The owner one-time step is **already done**: `https://pub.dev/api/packages/fa_llm` returns 200, latest `0.1.0` live on pub.dev (acceptance 1 ✅).
- Remaining acceptance 2 (`workflow green on next tag`) needs the owner to confirm the OIDC publisher entry on pub.dev (package admin → automated publishing → GitHub Actions, repo `IstiN/flutter_agent_harness`, workflow `publish-fa-llm.yml`, tag pattern `fa_llm-v*`) and push a new `fa_llm-v*` tag — not verifiable from code.
- `packages/fa_llm/pubspec.lock` (created by local `pub get`) is gitignored and outside the `check_lockfiles.sh` inventory — intentionally not committed.

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-10):
💡 **SUGGESTION: bare `curl` — add retry/timeout flags per repo convention**

The pre-flight probe uses a bare `curl`:

```bash
code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -I \
  https://pub.dev/api/packages/fa_llm || true)
```

Two consequences:

1. **No timeout** — if the connection to pub.dev hangs, `curl` has no default timeout and the step can stall until the job-level timeout (default 6h on hosted runners).
2. **No retry** — a transient failure yields code `000`, which falls into the warn-and-continue branch. That's a safe fallback, but a transient blip would then push a publish through the unguarded path.

The repo convention elsewhere (`ci.yml`, `nightly.yml`, `build-macos.yml`) is:

```bash
curl --retry 3 --retry-all-errors --retry-delay 10 --max-time 600 \
  --connect-timeout 30 ...
```

Suggest at minimum:

```bash
code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -I \
  --retry 3 --retry-all-errors --connect-timeout 15 --max-time 60 \
  https://pub.dev/api/packages/fa_llm || true)
```

Note `--retry-all-errors` is needed for `--retry` to apply to the probe-style exit paths here (a plain `--retry` skips some transient failures such as curl 56 — already documented in `ci.yml:2051`).

+      # Pre-flight (issue #1511): pub.dev OIDC publishing can only upload new

+            echo "::error::fa_llm does not exist on pub.dev yet."
+            echo "Automated (OIDC) publishing can only upload new VERSIONS of an"
+            echo "existing package — the first upload must be done manually by an"
+            echo "authenticated owner:"
+            echo "  cd packages/fa_llm && dart pub publish"
+            echo "Then add the OIDC publisher on pub.dev (package admin → automated"
+            echo "publishing → GitHub Actions, repo IstiN/flutter_agent_harness,"
+            echo "workflow publish-fa-llm.yml, tag pattern fa_llm-v*)."
+            echo "See https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/issues/1511"
+            exit 10
+          fi
+          if [ "$code" != "200" ]; then
+            echo "::warning::pub.dev probe returned HTTP '${code:-<none>}' (expected 200); continuing anyway."
+          fi
+
       - name: Publish to pub.dev

+## Publishing
+
+Tags matching `fa_llm-v*` trigger `.github/workflows/publish-fa-llm.yml`,

+

+`https://pub.dev/api/packages/fa_llm` and fails with the actionable
+message (exit code 10) if the package does not exist yet, instead of a
+bare `Only users are allowed to upload new packages.` server error.

name: Publish fa_llm

on:
  push:
    tags: ['fa_llm-v*']

# Cancel superseded runs of the same ref (issue #177).
concurrency:
  group: Publish fa_llm-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

permissions:
  id-token: write # OIDC — pub.dev verifies the GitHub identity, no secrets
  contents: read

jobs:
  publish:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: packages/fa_llm
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@6afc89df92d6eb3834022f73cd65adc8cdfcb92d # v1
        with:
          sdk: stable

      - run: dart pub get

      # Pre-flight (issue #1511): pub.dev OIDC publishing can only upload new
      # VERSIONS of an existing package — the first upload must be manual.
      # Probe the package; on 404 fail loudly with the actionable steps.
      - name: Pre-flight — package must already exist on pub.dev
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -I \
            https://pub.dev/api/packages/fa_llm || true)
          if [ "$code" = "404" ]; then
            echo "::error::fa_llm does not exist on pub.dev yet."
            echo "Automated (OIDC) publishing can only upload new VERSIONS of an"
            echo "existing package — the first upload must be done manually by an"
            echo "authenticated owner:"
            echo "  cd packages/fa_llm && dart pub publish"
            echo "Then add the OIDC publisher on pub.dev (package admin → automated"
            echo "publishing → GitHub Actions, repo IstiN/flutter_agent_harness,"
            echo "workflow publish-fa-llm.yml, tag pattern fa_llm-v*)."
            echo "See https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/issues/1511"
            exit 10
          fi
          if [ "$code" != "200" ]; then
            echo "::warning::pub.dev probe returned HTTP '${code:-<none>}' (expected 200); continuing anyway."
          fi

      - name: Publish to pub.dev
        run: dart pub publish --force

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Stage the publishable package into a target directory (issue #597).
#
# `dart publish` packs everything under the repo root that isn't
# gitignored — and the root hosts sub-projects that are NOT part of the
# pub package (flutter_app with its 57 MB wasm toolchain, yoclip media,
# browser_ext, office_addin, vendored forks, docs, packages/*). That
# blew the archive past pub.dev's hard 100 MB cap (v0.1.406: 100.4 MB).
#
# The staged copy carries the package surface (~32 MB) plus the two PATH
# dev-dependencies (packages/fa_llm_mock, vendored vendor/xterm —
# accepted by pub.dev since v0.1.369). pubspec_overrides.yaml (the
# local-only dart_tui vendor pin, "never ships to pub.dev" by its own
# comment) must NOT enter the stage: version solving would re-pin the
# path dep and fail (the v0.1.407 failure, exit 66).
#
# Usage: stage_publish_package.sh <target-dir>
# Exits non-zero (with ::error) when the staged tree exceeds the guard.
# The repo root hosts sub-projects that are NOT part of the pub package
# (flutter_app, yoclip, browser_ext, office_addin, vendored forks, docs)
# — `dart publish` packs everything under the root that isn't gitignored
# (v0.1.406: 100.4 MB, over pub.dev's hard cap). Stage the package
# surface instead. PATH dev-deps of the core pubspec must resolve inside
# the stage (#584, `dart pub get` exit 66 on v0.1.407): their subtrees
# are included BEFORE the parent excludes, and the parent excludes are
# child-scoped (vendor/*) — excluding the parent dir itself would prune
# the subtree before the includes are ever consulted.
# pubspec_overrides.yaml is the workspace-only dart_tui pin (never
# published, see its header); shipped into the stage it re-dangles
# dart_tui onto the excluded vendor dir.
set -euo pipefail

target="${1:?usage: stage_publish_package.sh <target-dir>}"
repo_root="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)"

mkdir -p "$target"
# Root-scoped excludes are ANCHORED: rsync matches an unanchored name
# against the basename at ANY depth — `memory` also pruned lib/src/memory/,
# shipping v0.1.411 with broken memory imports (issue #613). build/ and
# .dart_tool stay unanchored: build artifacts may appear at any depth and
# never belong in the stage.
# gh-1452: /CHANGELOG_ARCHIVE.md (the lossless trimmed tail of CHANGELOG.md)
# has no consumer in the pub package — GitHub carries the history. It is
# excluded below; must mirror /CHANGELOG_ARCHIVE.md in .pubignore (guarded
# by test/publish_staging_test.dart).
rsync -a "$repo_root"/ "$target"/ \
  --include 'vendor/xterm/' --include 'vendor/xterm/**' \
  --include 'packages/fa_llm_mock/' --include 'packages/fa_llm_mock/**' \
  --exclude '/.git' --exclude '/.github' --exclude '/.worktrees' \
  --exclude '/flutter_app' --exclude '/browser_ext' \
  --exclude '/office_addin' --exclude '/yoclip' \
  --exclude 'vendor/*' --exclude '/docs' --exclude '/fa-local' \
  --exclude 'packages/*' \
  --exclude '/pubspec_overrides.yaml' \
  --exclude '/CHANGELOG_ARCHIVE.md' \
  --exclude '.dart_tool' --exclude 'build' \
  --exclude '/memory' --exclude '/.trash' --exclude '/coverage'

size=$(du -sm "$target" | cut -f1)
echo "staged package: ${size} MB"
if [ "$size" -gt 90 ]; then
  echo "::error::staged package is ${size} MB (>90) — pub.dev caps uploads at 100 MB. Trim the staging excludes."
  exit 1
fi

# Publish gate at PR time: publish-blocking problems (undeclared lib/
      # imports, stray PEM-like strings) used to surface only in the tag-time
      # publish job — the v0.1.331 era: an undeclared package:cryptography
      # import shipped red on ~26 consecutive tags. --ignore-warnings: the
      # two known layout warnings (gitignored install_local.sh, docs/
      # naming) must not redden every PR, while validation ERRORS — "does
      # not have X in the dependencies section of pubspec.yaml" — still
      # fail. setup-dart (sdk >= 3.13) registers a publish-scoped PUB_TOKEN
      # job-wide and pub.dev rejects authenticated metadata reads, so
      # resolve unauthenticated (same pattern as the publish job);
      # --dry-run never uploads.
      - name: Publish dry-run (unauthenticated)
        run: |
          dart pub token remove https://pub.dev || true
          dart pub publish --dry-run --ignore-warnings

      # The example Flutter app lives in this repo; without its package
      # config the repo-wide `dart analyze` cannot resolve Flutter imports.
      - name: Example app pub get (for repo-wide analyze)
        uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

# publish job — the v0.1.331 era: an undeclared package:cryptography
      # import shipped red on ~26 consecutive tags. --ignore-warnings: the
      # two known layout warnings (gitignored install_local.sh, docs/
      # naming) must not redden every PR, while validation ERRORS — "does
      # not have X in the dependencies section of pubspec.yaml" — still
      # fail. setup-dart (sdk >= 3.13) registers a publish-scoped PUB_TOKEN
      # job-wide and pub.dev rejects authenticated metadata reads, so
      # resolve unauthenticated (same pattern as the publish job);
      # --dry-run never uploads.
      - name: Publish dry-run (unauthenticated)
        if: needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        run: |
          dart pub token remove https://pub.dev || true
          # Against the STAGED tree, not the repo root (#597 AC1): the
          # publish job publishes from the stage — the v0.1.407 class of
          # failure (staged resolution re-pinning vendor/dart_tui through
          # pubspec_overrides.yaml) must redden the PR, not the tag.
          bash scripts/stage_publish_package.sh /tmp/pr-dry-run-stage
          # The staged tree must ANALYZE clean: v0.1.411 shipped files
          # with broken imports (the staging filter pruned lib/src/memory;
          # imports of fork-only dart_tui symbols) that only a consumer's
          # `dart analyze` ever surfaced (issue #613). Errors fail the
          # gate; warnings/infos pass, matching the static analyze stage.
          (cd /tmp/pr-dry-run-stage && dart pub get && dart analyze)
          (cd /tmp/pr-dry-run-stage && dart pub publish --dry-run --ignore-warnings)

  test-core:
    # Always runs (no job-level path gate): a path-filtered matrix skip
    # posts a check-run with the LITERAL unrendered name — the required
    # contexts (shard 0..3) never report, and branch protection blocks
    # out-of-scope PRs at 27 green checks. The scope fastpass below

So:
- ci.yml PR gate: stages via `stage_publish_package.sh`, then `dart publish --dry-run` inside the staged tree. So the root payload = staged tree. If I add rsync includes for fa_llm/fa_llm_flutter (option A), the staged tree would now include them and the dry-run would validate them too. If fa_llm_flutter lacks a LICENSE... wait, `packages/fa_llm_flutter` has no LICENSE file listed! Thread 10 said dry-run fails with "missing LICENSE". Actually the reported failure was for fa_llm. Let me check: fa_llm has LICENSE. fa_llm_flutter does NOT have a LICENSE (listing shows: README.md, lib, pubspec.yaml, test). Hmm.

But wait — in the staged root payload, LICENSE absence isn't an error for the root package (the root has its own LICENSE at root). The sub-tree files just ride along as files; pub's per-package validation applies to the root pubspec only. So including fa_llm_flutter in the root payload is fine as long as files don't trip leak detectors (PEM-like strings). Risk: the leak detector ("stray PEM-like strings") — fa_llm tests might contain fake keys? Unlikely. Let me check for leak-detector tests.

Actually — also nightly.yml does a ROOT-level `dart publish --dry-run` (line 52-55) without staging? Let me look at the context. Line 51-55 in nightly — run at repo root? It says "Publish dry-run (unauthenticated)" — and the gh-1220 comment in .pubignore says "The nightly/PR dry-runs validate at the REPO ROOT". Hmm, but ci.yml stages. Let me check nightly more fully.

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1512
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1512
- **Title**: gh-1511 [BUG] publish-fa-llm red since 08-14: pub.dev 'Only users are allowed to upload new packages' — first publish must be manual (one-time owner step)
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1511` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 3
- **Additions**: +53
- **Deletions**: -0
- **Created**: 2026-10-10T19:04:53Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-10T20:08:59Z

## PR Description

Closes #1511
# gh-1511 — publish-fa-llm first-publish guard + docs

### Root Cause
pub.dev OIDC publishing can only upload new **versions** of an **existing** package — the first upload of a new package must come from an authenticated human. `fa_llm` didn't exist on pub.dev at tag `fa_llm-v0.1.0`, so the upload died with `Only users are allowed to upload new packages.` and the workflow had no pre-flight to explain it.

### Fix
- `.github/workflows/publish-fa-llm.yml` — new pre-flight step: HEAD-probe `https://pub.dev/api/packages/fa_llm`; on 404 prints the actionable first-publish steps (manual `dart pub publish` + OIDC publisher entry, links issue #1511) and exits with distinct code `10`; unexpected probe codes warn but continue. Verified locally: 404 ⇒ exit 10, 200 ⇒ guard passes.
- `packages/fa_llm/README.md` — new **Publishing** section documenting the tag → OIDC flow and the one-time manual first-publish dance.
- `AGENTS.md` (`Commits and releases`) — bullet covering the `fa_llm` publish path; previously only the core package's auto-release was documented.

### Test Coverage
- Guard logic exercised locally against pub.dev: nonexistent package → exit 10 with message; `fa_llm` → 200, publish proceeds. Workflow YAML parses clean.
- `packages/fa_llm`: 87 tests passed (no Dart code changed).

### Notes
- The owner one-time step is **already done**: `https://pub.dev/api/packages/fa_llm` returns 200, latest `0.1.0` live on pub.dev (acceptance 1 ✅).
- Remaining acceptance 2 (`workflow green on next tag`) needs the owner to confirm the OIDC publisher entry on pub.dev (package admin → automated publishing → GitHub Actions, repo `IstiN/flutter_agent_harness`, workflow `publish-fa-llm.yml`, tag pattern `fa_llm-v*`) and push a new `fa_llm-v*` tag — not verifiable from code.
- `packages/fa_llm/pubspec.lock` (created by local `pub get`) is gitignored and outside the `check_lockfiles.sh` inventory — intentionally not committed.

# gh-1511 — publish-fa-llm first-publish guard + docs

### Root Cause
pub.dev OIDC publishing can only upload new **versions** of an **existing** package — the first upload of a new package must come from an authenticated human. `fa_llm` didn't exist on pub.dev at tag `fa_llm-v0.1.0`, so the upload died with `Only users are allowed to upload new packages.` and the workflow had no pre-flight to explain it.

- `packages/fa_llm/README.md` — new **Publishing** section documenting the tag → OIDC flow and the one-time manual first-publish dance.
- `AGENTS.md` (`Commits and releases`) — bullet covering the `fa_llm` publish path; previously only the core package's auto-release was documented.

- Guard logic exercised locally against pub.dev: nonexistent package → exit 10 with message; `fa_llm` → 200, publish proceeds. Workflow YAML parses clean.

- The owner one-time step is **already done**: `https://pub.dev/api/packages/fa_llm` returns 200, latest `0.1.0` live on pub.dev (acceptance 1 ✅).

name: Publish fa_llm

on:

concurrency:
  group: Publish fa_llm-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

permissions:
  id-token: write # OIDC — pub.dev verifies the GitHub identity, no secrets
  contents: read

jobs:
  publish:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: packages/fa_llm
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@6afc89df92d6eb3834022f73cd65adc8cdfcb92d # v1
        with:
          sdk: stable

      - run: dart pub get

      # Pre-flight (issue #1511): pub.dev OIDC publishing can only upload new
      # VERSIONS of an existing package — the first upload must be manual.
      # Probe the package; on 404 fail loudly with the actionable steps.
      - name: Pre-flight — package must already exist on pub.dev
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -I \
            https://pub.dev/api/packages/fa_llm || true)
          if [ "$code" = "404" ]; then
            echo "::error::fa_llm does not exist on pub.dev yet."
            echo "Automated (OIDC) publishing can only upload new VERSIONS of an"
            echo "existing package — the first upload must be done manually by an"
            echo "authenticated owner:"
            echo "  cd packages/fa_llm && dart pub publish"
            echo "Then add the OIDC publisher on pub.dev (package admin → automated"
            echo "publishing → GitHub Actions, repo IstiN/flutter_agent_harness,"
            echo "workflow publish-fa-llm.yml, tag pattern fa_llm-v*)."
            echo "See https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/issues/1511"
            exit 10
          fi
          if [ "$code" != "200" ]; then
            echo "::warning::pub.dev probe returned HTTP '${code:-<none>}' (expected 200); continuing anyway."
          fi

      - name: Publish to pub.dev
        run: dart pub publish --force

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Stage the publishable package into a target directory (issue #597).
#
# `dart publish` packs everything under the repo root that isn't
# gitignored — and the root hosts sub-projects that are NOT part of the
# pub package (flutter_app with its 57 MB wasm toolchain, yoclip media,
# browser_ext, office_addin, vendored forks, docs, packages/*). That
# blew the archive past pub.dev's hard 100 MB cap (v0.1.406: 100.4 MB).
#
# The staged copy carries the package surface (~32 MB) plus the two PATH
# dev-dependencies (packages/fa_llm_mock, vendored vendor/xterm —
# accepted by pub.dev since v0.1.369). pubspec_overrides.yaml (the
# local-only dart_tui vendor pin, "never ships to pub.dev" by its own
# comment) must NOT enter the stage: version solving would re-pin the
# path dep and fail (the v0.1.407 failure, exit 66).
#
# Usage: stage_publish_package.sh <target-dir>
# Exits non-zero (with ::error) when the staged tree exceeds the guard.
# The repo root hosts sub-projects that are NOT part of the pub package
# (flutter_app, yoclip, browser_ext, office_addin, vendored forks, docs)
# — `dart publish` packs everything under the root that isn't gitignored
# (v0.1.406: 100.4 MB, over pub.dev's hard cap). Stage the package
# surface instead. PATH dev-deps of the core pubspec must resolve inside
# the stage (#584, `dart pub get` exit 66 on v0.1.407): their subtrees
# are included BEFORE the parent excludes, and the parent excludes are
# child-scoped (vendor/*) — excluding the parent dir itself would prune
# the subtree before the includes are ever consulted.
# pubspec_overrides.yaml is the workspace-only dart_tui pin (never
# published, see its header); shipped into the stage it re-dangles
# dart_tui onto the excluded vendor dir.
set -euo pipefail

target="${1:?usage: stage_publish_package.sh <target-dir>}"
repo_root="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)"

mkdir -p "$target"
# Root-scoped excludes are ANCHORED: rsync matches an unanchored name
# against the basename at ANY depth — `memory` also pruned lib/src/memory/,
# shipping v0.1.411 with broken memory imports (issue #613). build/ and
# .dart_tool stay unanchored: build artifacts may appear at any depth and
# never belong in the stage.
# gh-1452: /CHANGELOG_ARCHIVE.md (the lossless trimmed tail of CHANGELOG.md)
# has no consumer in the pub package — GitHub carries the history. It is
# excluded below; must mirror /CHANGELOG_ARCHIVE.md in .pubignore (guarded
# by test/publish_staging_test.dart).
rsync -a "$repo_root"/ "$target"/ \
  --include 'vendor/xterm/' --include 'vendor/xterm/**' \
  --include 'packages/fa_llm_mock/' --include 'packages/fa_llm_mock/**' \
  --exclude '/.git' --exclude '/.github' --exclude '/.worktrees' \
  --exclude '/flutter_app' --exclude '/browser_ext' \
  --exclude '/office_addin' --exclude '/yoclip' \
  --exclude 'vendor/*' --exclude '/docs' --exclude '/fa-local' \
  --exclude 'packages/*' \
  --exclude '/pubspec_overrides.yaml' \
  --exclude '/CHANGELOG_ARCHIVE.md' \
  --exclude '.dart_tool' --exclude 'build' \
  --exclude '/memory' --exclude '/.trash' --exclude '/coverage'

size=$(du -sm "$target" | cut -f1)
echo "staged package: ${size} MB"
if [ "$size" -gt 90 ]; then
  echo "::error::staged package is ${size} MB (>90) — pub.dev caps uploads at 100 MB. Trim the staging excludes."
  exit 1
fi

      # job-wide and pub.dev rejects authenticated metadata reads, so
      # resolve unauthenticated (same pattern as the publish job);

      - name: Publish dry-run (unauthenticated)

          dart pub token remove https://pub.dev || true

      - name: Example app pub get (for repo-wide analyze)

## PR Description

Closes #1511
# gh-1511 — publish-fa-llm first-publish guard + docs

### Root Cause
pub.dev OIDC publishing can only upload new **versions** of an **existing** package — the first upload of a new package must come from an authenticated human. `fa_llm` didn't exist on pub.dev at tag `fa_llm-v0.1.0`, so the upload died with `Only users are allowed to upload new packages.` and the workflow had no pre-flight to explain it.

### Fix

The pre-flight probe uses a bare `curl`:

```bash

  https://pub.dev/api/packages/fa_llm || true)
```

Two consequences:

1. **No timeout** — if the connection to pub.dev hangs, `curl` has no default timeout and the step can stall until the job-level timeout (default 6h on hosted runners).
2. **No retry** — a transient failure yields code `000`, which falls into the warn-and-continue branch. That's a safe fallback, but a transient blip would then push a publish through the unguarded path.

The repo convention elsewhere (`ci.yml`, `nightly.yml`, `build-macos.yml`) is:

  --connect-timeout 30 ...

```bash
code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -I \
  --retry 3 --retry-all-errors --connect-timeout 15 --max-time 60 \
  https://pub.dev/api/packages/fa_llm || true)

@@ -28,5 +28,29 @@ jobs:
 
       - run: dart pub get
 
+      # Pre-flight (issue #1511): pub.dev OIDC publishing can only upload new
+      # VERSIONS of an existing package — the first upload must be manual.
+      # Probe the package; on 404 fail loudly with the actionable steps.
+      - name: Pre-flight — package must already exist on pub.dev
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -I \
+            https://pub.dev/api/packages/fa_llm || true)
+          if [ "$code" = "404" ]; then
+            echo "::error::fa_llm does not exist on pub.dev yet."
+            echo "Automated (OIDC) publishing can only upload new VERSIONS of an"
+            echo "existing package — the first upload must be done manually by an"
+            echo "authenticated owner:"
+            echo "  cd packages/fa_llm && dart pub publish"
+            echo "Then add the OIDC publisher on pub.dev (package admin → automated"
+            echo "publishing → GitHub Actions, repo IstiN/flutter_agent_harness,"
+            echo "workflow publish-fa-llm.yml, tag pattern fa_llm-v*)."
+            echo "See https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/issues/1511"
+            exit 10
+          fi
+          if [ "$code" != "200" ]; then
+            echo "::warning::pub.dev probe returned HTTP '${code:-<none>}' (expected 200); continuing anyway."
+          fi
+
       - name: Publish to pub.dev
         run: dart pub publish --force

 - Ollama local inference

+
+## Publishing
+
+Tags matching `fa_llm-v*` trigger `.github/workflows/publish-fa-llm.yml`,
+which publishes to pub.dev via OIDC (no tokens; pub.dev verifies the
+GitHub identity).
+
+**First publish of a new package is manual** (issue #1511): pub.dev OIDC
+publishing can only upload new *versions* of an *existing* package, so the
+very first upload must come from an authenticated owner:
+
+1. `cd packages/fa_llm && dart pub publish` (logged-in user account).
+2. On pub.dev: package admin → automated publishing → GitHub Actions,
+   repo `IstiN/flutter_agent_harness`, workflow `publish-fa-llm.yml`,
+   tag pattern `fa_llm-v*`.
+3. Push the tag — the workflow takes over from there.
+
+The workflow pre-flights this: it HEAD-probes
+`https://pub.dev/api/packages/fa_llm` and fails with the actionable
+message (exit code 10) if the package does not exist yet, instead of a
+bare `Only users are allowed to upload new packages.` server error.

## Description

Closes #1511
# gh-1511 — publish-fa-llm first-publish guard + docs

### Root Cause
pub.dev OIDC publishing can only upload new **versions** of an **existing** package — the first upload of a new package must come from an authenticated human. `fa_llm` didn't exist on pub.dev at tag `fa_llm-v0.1.0`, so the upload died with `Only users are allowed to upload new packages.` and the workflow had no pre-flight to explain it.

### Fix
- `.github/workflows/publish-fa-llm.yml` — new pre-flight step: HEAD-probe `https://pub.dev/api/packages/fa_llm`; on 404 prints the actionable first-publish steps (manual `dart pub publish` + OIDC publisher entry, links issue #1511) and exits with distinct code `10`; unexpected probe codes warn but continue. Verified locally: 404 ⇒ exit 10, 200 ⇒ guard passes.
- `packages/fa_llm/README.md` — new **Publishing** section documenting the tag → OIDC flow and the one-time manual first-publish dance.
- `AGENTS.md` (`Commits and releases`) — bullet covering the `fa_llm` publish path; previously only the core package's auto-release was documented.

### Test Coverage
- Guard logic exercised locally against pub.dev: nonexistent package → exit 10 with message; `fa_llm` → 200, publish proceeds. Workflow YAML parses clean.
- `packages/fa_llm`: 87 tests passed (no Dart code changed).

### Notes
- The owner one-time step is **already done**: `https://pub.dev/api/packages/fa_llm` returns 200, latest `0.1.0` live on pub.dev (acceptance 1 ✅).
- Remaining acceptance 2 (`workflow green on next tag`) needs the owner to confirm the OIDC publisher entry on pub.dev (package admin → automated publishing → GitHub Actions, repo `IstiN/flutter_agent_harness`, workflow `publish-fa-llm.yml`, tag pattern `fa_llm-v*`) and push a new `fa_llm-v*` tag — not verifiable from code.
- `packages/fa_llm/pubspec.lock` (created by local `pub get`) is gitignored and outside the `check_lockfiles.sh` inventory — intentionally not committed.

name: Publish fa_llm

on:
  push:
    tags: ['fa_llm-v*']

# Cancel superseded runs of the same ref (issue #177).
concurrency:
  group: Publish fa_llm-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

permissions:
  id-token: write # OIDC — pub.dev verifies the GitHub identity, no secrets
  contents: read

jobs:
  publish:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: packages/fa_llm
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@6afc89df92d6eb3834022f73cd65adc8cdfcb92d # v1
        with:
          sdk: stable

      - run: dart pub get

      # Pre-flight (issue #1511): pub.dev OIDC publishing can only upload new
      # VERSIONS of an existing package — the first upload must be manual.
      # Probe the package; on 404 fail loudly with the actionable steps.
      - name: Pre-flight — package must already exist on pub.dev
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -I \
            https://pub.dev/api/packages/fa_llm || true)
          if [ "$code" = "404" ]; then
            echo "::error::fa_llm does not exist on pub.dev yet."
            echo "Automated (OIDC) publishing can only upload new VERSIONS of an"
            echo "existing package — the first upload must be done manually by an"
            echo "authenticated owner:"
            echo "  cd packages/fa_llm && dart pub publish"
            echo "Then add the OIDC publisher on pub.dev (package admin → automated"
            echo "publishing → GitHub Actions, repo IstiN/flutter_agent_harness,"
            echo "workflow publish-fa-llm.yml, tag pattern fa_llm-v*)."
            echo "See https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/issues/1511"
            exit 10
          fi
          if [ "$code" != "200" ]; then
            echo "::warning::pub.dev probe returned HTTP '${code:-<none>}' (expected 200); continuing anyway."
          fi

      - name: Publish to pub.dev
        run: dart pub publish --force

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Stage the publishable package into a target directory (issue #597).
#
# `dart publish` packs everything under the repo root that isn't
# gitignored — and the root hosts sub-projects that are NOT part of the
# pub package (flutter_app with its 57 MB wasm toolchain, yoclip media,
# browser_ext, office_addin, vendored forks, docs, packages/*). That
# blew the archive past pub.dev's hard 100 MB cap (v0.1.406: 100.4 MB).
#
# The staged copy carries the package surface (~32 MB) plus the two PATH
# dev-dependencies (packages/fa_llm_mock, vendored vendor/xterm —
# accepted by pub.dev since v0.1.369). pubspec_overrides.yaml (the
# local-only dart_tui vendor pin, "never ships to pub.dev" by its own
# comment) must NOT enter the stage: version solving would re-pin the
# path dep and fail (the v0.1.407 failure, exit 66).
#
# Usage: stage_publish_package.sh <target-dir>
# Exits non-zero (with ::error) when the staged tree exceeds the guard.
# The repo root hosts sub-projects that are NOT part of the pub package
# (flutter_app, yoclip, browser_ext, office_addin, vendored forks, docs)
# — `dart publish` packs everything under the root that isn't gitignored
# (v0.1.406: 100.4 MB, over pub.dev's hard cap). Stage the package
# surface instead. PATH dev-deps of the core pubspec must resolve inside
# the stage (#584, `dart pub get` exit 66 on v0.1.407): their subtrees
# are included BEFORE the parent excludes, and the parent excludes are
# child-scoped (vendor/*) — excluding the parent dir itself would prune
# the subtree before the includes are ever consulted.
# pubspec_overrides.yaml is the workspace-only dart_tui pin (never
# published, see its header); shipped into the stage it re-dangles
# dart_tui onto the excluded vendor dir.
set -euo pipefail

target="${1:?usage: stage_publish_package.sh <target-dir>}"
repo_root="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)"

mkdir -p "$target"
# Root-scoped excludes are ANCHORED: rsync matches an unanchored name
# against the basename at ANY depth — `memory` also pruned lib/src/memory/,
# shipping v0.1.411 with broken memory imports (issue #613). build/ and
# .dart_tool stay unanchored: build artifacts may appear at any depth and
# never belong in the stage.
# gh-1452: /CHANGELOG_ARCHIVE.md (the lossless trimmed tail of CHANGELOG.md)
# has no consumer in the pub package — GitHub carries the history. It is
# excluded below; must mirror /CHANGELOG_ARCHIVE.md in .pubignore (guarded
# by test/publish_staging_test.dart).
rsync -a "$repo_root"/ "$target"/ \
  --include 'vendor/xterm/' --include 'vendor/xterm/**' \
  --include 'packages/fa_llm_mock/' --include 'packages/fa_llm_mock/**' \
  --exclude '/.git' --exclude '/.github' --exclude '/.worktrees' \
  --exclude '/flutter_app' --exclude '/browser_ext' \
  --exclude '/office_addin' --exclude '/yoclip' \
  --exclude 'vendor/*' --exclude '/docs' --exclude '/fa-local' \
  --exclude 'packages/*' \
  --exclude '/pubspec_overrides.yaml' \
  --exclude '/CHANGELOG_ARCHIVE.md' \
  --exclude '.dart_tool' --exclude 'build' \
  --exclude '/memory' --exclude '/.trash' --exclude '/coverage'

size=$(du -sm "$target" | cut -f1)
echo "staged package: ${size} MB"
if [ "$size" -gt 90 ]; then
  echo "::error::staged package is ${size} MB (>90) — pub.dev caps uploads at 100 MB. Trim the staging excludes."
  exit 1
fi

## PR Description

Closes #1511
# gh-1511 — publish-fa-llm first-publish guard + docs

### Root Cause
pub.dev OIDC publishing can only upload new **versions** of an **existing** package — the first upload of a new package must come from an authenticated human. `fa_llm` didn't exist on pub.dev at tag `fa_llm-v0.1.0`, so the upload died with `Only users are allowed to upload new packages.` and the workflow had no pre-flight to explain it.

### Fix
- `.github/workflows/publish-fa-llm.yml` — new pre-flight step: HEAD-probe `https://pub.dev/api/packages/fa_llm`; on 404 prints the actionable first-publish steps (manual `dart pub publish` + OIDC publisher entry, links issue #1511) and exits with distinct code `10`; unexpected probe codes warn but continue. Verified locally: 404 ⇒ exit 10, 200 ⇒ guard passes.
- `packages/fa_llm/README.md` — new **Publishing** section documenting the tag → OIDC flow and the one-time manual first-publish dance.
- `AGENTS.md` (`Commits and releases`) — bullet covering the `fa_llm` publish path; previously only the core package's auto-release was documented.

### Test Coverage
- Guard logic exercised locally against pub.dev: nonexistent package → exit 10 with message; `fa_llm` → 200, publish proceeds. Workflow YAML parses clean.
- `packages/fa_llm`: 87 tests passed (no Dart code changed).

### Notes
- The owner one-time step is **already done**: `https://pub.dev/api/packages/fa_llm` returns 200, latest `0.1.0` live on pub.dev (acceptance 1 ✅).
- Remaining acceptance 2 (`workflow green on next tag`) needs the owner to confirm the OIDC publisher entry on pub.dev (package admin → automated publishing → GitHub Actions, repo `IstiN/flutter_agent_harness`, workflow `publish-fa-llm.yml`, tag pattern `fa_llm-v*`) and push a new `fa_llm-v*` tag — not verifiable from code.
- `packages/fa_llm/pubspec.lock` (created by local `pub get`) is gitignored and outside the `check_lockfiles.sh` inventory — intentionally not committed.

### Thread 1 — `.github/workflows/publish-fa-llm.yml`

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-10):
💡 **SUGGESTION: bare `curl` — add retry/timeout flags per repo convention**

The pre-flight probe uses a bare `curl`:

```bash
code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -I \
  https://pub.dev/api/packages/fa_llm || true)
```

Two consequences:

1. **No timeout** — if the connection to pub.dev hangs, `curl` has no default timeout and the step can stall until the job-level timeout (default 6h on hosted runners).
2. **No retry** — a transient failure yields code `000`, which falls into the warn-and-continue branch. That's a safe fallback, but a transient blip would then push a publish through the unguarded path.

The repo convention elsewhere (`ci.yml`, `nightly.yml`, `build-macos.yml`) is:

```bash
curl --retry 3 --retry-all-errors --retry-delay 10 --max-time 600 \
  --connect-timeout 30 ...
```

Suggest at minimum:

```bash
code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -I \
  --retry 3 --retry-all-errors --connect-timeout 15 --max-time 60 \
  https://pub.dev/api/packages/fa_llm || true)
```

Note `--retry-all-errors` is needed for `--retry` to apply to the probe-style exit paths here (a plain `--retry` skips some transient failures such as curl 56 — already documented in `ci.yml:2051`).
