# pr-1512: gh-1511 [BUG] publish-fa-llm red since 08-14: pub.dev 'Only users are allowed to upload new packages' — first publish must be manual (one-time owner step)

## Description

Closes #1511
# gh-1511 — publish-fa-llm first-publish guard + docs

### Root Cause
pub.dev OIDC publishing can only upload new **versions** of an **existing** package — the first upload of a new package must come from an authenticated human. `fa_llm` didn't exist on pub.dev at tag `fa_llm-v0.1.0`, so the upload died with `Only users are allowed to upload new packages.` and the workflow had no pre-flight to explain it.

### Fix
- `.github/workflows/publish-fa-llm.yml` — new pre-flight step: HEAD-probe `https://pub.dev/api/packages/fa_llm`; on 404 prints the actionable first-publish steps (manual `dart pub publish` + OIDC publisher entry, links issue #1511) and exits with distinct code `10`; unexpected probe codes warn but continue. Verified locally: 404 ⇒ exit 10, 200 ⇒ guard passes.
- `packages/fa_llm/README.md` — new **Publishing** section documenting the tag → OIDC flow and the one-time manual first-publish dance.
- `AGENTS.md` (`Commits and releases`) — bullet covering the `fa_llm` publish path; previously only the core package's auto-release was documented.

### Test Coverage
- Guard logic exercised locally against pub.dev: nonexistent package → exit 10 with message; `fa_llm` → 200, publish proceeds. Workflow YAML parses clean.
- `packages/fa_llm`: 87 tests passed (no Dart code changed).

### Notes
- The owner one-time step is **already done**: `https://pub.dev/api/packages/fa_llm` returns 200, latest `0.1.0` live on pub.dev (acceptance 1 ✅).
- Remaining acceptance 2 (`workflow green on next tag`) needs the owner to confirm the OIDC publisher entry on pub.dev (package admin → automated publishing → GitHub Actions, repo `IstiN/flutter_agent_harness`, workflow `publish-fa-llm.yml`, tag pattern `fa_llm-v*`) and push a new `fa_llm-v*` tag — not verifiable from code.
- `packages/fa_llm/pubspec.lock` (created by local `pub get`) is gitignored and outside the `check_lockfiles.sh` inventory — intentionally not committed.

name: Publish fa_llm

on:
  push:
    tags: ['fa_llm-v*']

# Cancel superseded runs of the same ref (issue #177).
concurrency:
  group: Publish fa_llm-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

permissions:
  id-token: write # OIDC — pub.dev verifies the GitHub identity, no secrets
  contents: read

jobs:
  publish:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: packages/fa_llm
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@6afc89df92d6eb3834022f73cd65adc8cdfcb92d # v1
        with:
          sdk: stable

      - run: dart pub get

      # Pre-flight (issue #1511): pub.dev OIDC publishing can only upload new
      # VERSIONS of an existing package — the first upload must be manual.
      # Probe the package; on 404 fail loudly with the actionable steps.
      - name: Pre-flight — package must already exist on pub.dev
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -I \
            https://pub.dev/api/packages/fa_llm || true)
          if [ "$code" = "404" ]; then
            echo "::error::fa_llm does not exist on pub.dev yet."
            echo "Automated (OIDC) publishing can only upload new VERSIONS of an"
            echo "existing package — the first upload must be done manually by an"
            echo "authenticated owner:"
            echo "  cd packages/fa_llm && dart pub publish"
            echo "Then add the OIDC publisher on pub.dev (package admin → automated"
            echo "publishing → GitHub Actions, repo IstiN/flutter_agent_harness,"
            echo "workflow publish-fa-llm.yml, tag pattern fa_llm-v*)."
            echo "See https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/issues/1511"
            exit 10
          fi
          if [ "$code" != "200" ]; then
            echo "::warning::pub.dev probe returned HTTP '${code:-<none>}' (expected 200); continuing anyway."
          fi

      - name: Publish to pub.dev
        run: dart pub publish --force

blocks.text:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Stage the publishable package into a target directory (issue #597).
#
# `dart publish` packs everything under the repo root that isn't
# gitignored — and the root hosts sub-projects that are NOT part of the
# pub package (flutter_app with its 57 MB wasm toolchain, yoclip media,
# browser_ext, office_addin, vendored forks, docs, packages/*). That
# blew the archive past pub.dev's hard 100 MB cap (v0.1.406: 100.4 MB).
#
# The staged copy carries the package surface (~32 MB) plus the two PATH
# dev-dependencies (packages/fa_llm_mock, vendored vendor/xterm —
# accepted by pub.dev since v0.1.369). pubspec_overrides.yaml (the
# local-only dart_tui vendor pin, "never ships to pub.dev" by its own
# comment) must NOT enter the stage: version solving would re-pin the
# path dep and fail (the v0.1.407 failure, exit 66).
#
# Usage: stage_publish_package.sh <target-dir>
# Exits non-zero (with ::error) when the staged tree exceeds the guard.
# The repo root hosts sub-projects that are NOT part of the pub package
# (flutter_app, yoclip, browser_ext, office_addin, vendored forks, docs)
# — `dart publish` packs everything under the root that isn't gitignored
# (v0.1.406: 100.4 MB, over pub.dev's hard cap). Stage the package
# surface instead. PATH dev-deps of the core pubspec must resolve inside
# the stage (#584, `dart pub get` exit 66 on v0.1.407): their subtrees
# are included BEFORE the parent excludes, and the parent excludes are
# child-scoped (vendor/*) — excluding the parent dir itself would prune
# the subtree before the includes are ever consulted.
# pubspec_overrides.yaml is the workspace-only dart_tui pin (never
# published, see its header); shipped into the stage it re-dangles
# dart_tui onto the excluded vendor dir.
set -euo pipefail

target="${1:?usage: stage_publish_package.sh <target-dir>}"
repo_root="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)"

mkdir -p "$target"
# Root-scoped excludes are ANCHORED: rsync matches an unanchored name
# against the basename at ANY depth — `memory` also pruned lib/src/memory/,
# shipping v0.1.411 with broken memory imports (issue #613). build/ and
# .dart_tool stay unanchored: build artifacts may appear at any depth and
# never belong in the stage.
# gh-1452: /CHANGELOG_ARCHIVE.md (the lossless trimmed tail of CHANGELOG.md)
# has no consumer in the pub package — GitHub carries the history. It is
# excluded below; must mirror /CHANGELOG_ARCHIVE.md in .pubignore (guarded
# by test/publish_staging_test.dart).
rsync -a "$repo_root"/ "$target"/ \
  --include 'vendor/xterm/' --include 'vendor/xterm/**' \
  --include 'packages/fa_llm_mock/' --include 'packages/fa_llm_mock/**' \
  --exclude '/.git' --exclude '/.github' --exclude '/.worktrees' \
  --exclude '/flutter_app' --exclude '/browser_ext' \
  --exclude '/office_addin' --exclude '/yoclip' \
  --exclude 'vendor/*' --exclude '/docs' --exclude '/fa-local' \
  --exclude 'packages/*' \
  --exclude '/pubspec_overrides.yaml' \
  --exclude '/CHANGELOG_ARCHIVE.md' \
  --exclude '.dart_tool' --exclude 'build' \
  --exclude '/memory' --exclude '/.trash' --exclude '/coverage'

size=$(du -sm "$target" | cut -f1)
echo "staged package: ${size} MB"
if [ "$size" -gt 90 ]; then
  echo "::error::staged package is ${size} MB (>90) — pub.dev caps uploads at 100 MB. Trim the staging excludes."
  exit 1
fi

# gh-1511 — publish-fa-llm first-publish guard + docs

### Root Cause
pub.dev OIDC publishing can only upload new **versions** of an **existing** package — the first upload of a new package must come from an authenticated human. `fa_llm` didn't exist on pub.dev at tag `fa_llm-v0.1.0`, so the upload died with `Only users are allowed to upload new packages.` and the workflow had no pre-flight to explain it.

### Fix
- `.github/workflows/publish-fa-llm.yml` — new pre-flight step: HEAD-probe `https://pub.dev/api/packages/fa_llm`; on 404 prints the actionable first-publish steps (manual `dart pub publish` + OIDC publisher entry, links issue #1511) and exits with distinct code `10`; unexpected probe codes warn but continue. Verified locally: 404 ⇒ exit 10, 200 ⇒ guard passes.
- `packages/fa_llm/README.md` — new **Publishing** section documenting the tag → OIDC flow and the one-time manual first-publish dance.
- `AGENTS.md` (`Commits and releases`) — bullet covering the `fa_llm` publish path; previously only the core package's auto-release was documented.

### Test Coverage
- Guard logic exercised locally against pub.dev: nonexistent package → exit 10 with message; `fa_llm` → 200, publish proceeds. Workflow YAML parses clean.
- `packages/fa_llm`: 87 tests passed (no Dart code changed).

### Notes
- The owner one-time step is **already done**: `https://pub.dev/api/packages/fa_llm` returns 200, latest `0.1.0` live on pub.dev (acceptance 1 ✅).
- Remaining acceptance 2 (`workflow green on next tag`) needs the owner to confirm the OIDC publisher entry on pub.dev (package admin → automated publishing → GitHub Actions, repo `IstiN/flutter_agent_harness`, workflow `publish-fa-llm.yml`, tag pattern `fa_llm-v*`) and push a new `fa_llm-v*` tag — not verifiable from code.
- `packages/fa_llm/pubspec.lock` (created by local `pub get`) is gitignored and outside the `check_lockfiles.sh` inventory — intentionally not committed.

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-10):
💡 **SUGGESTION: bare `curl` — add retry/timeout flags per repo convention**

The pre-flight probe uses a bare `curl`:

```bash
code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -I \
  https://pub.dev/api/packages/fa_llm || true)
```

Two consequences:

1. **No timeout** — if the connection to pub.dev hangs, `curl` has no default timeout and the step can stall until the job-level timeout (default 6h on hosted runners).
2. **No retry** — a transient failure yields code `000`, which falls into the warn-and-continue branch. That's a safe fallback, but a transient blip would then push a publish through the unguarded path.

The repo convention elsewhere (`ci.yml`, `nightly.yml`, `build-macos.yml`) is:

```bash
curl --retry 3 --retry-all-errors --retry-delay 10 --max-time 600 \
  --connect-timeout 30 ...
```

Suggest at minimum:

```bash
code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -I \
  --retry 3 --retry-all-errors --connect-timeout 15 --max-time 60 \
  https://pub.dev/api/packages/fa_llm || true)
```

Note `--retry-all-errors` is needed for `--retry` to apply to the probe-style exit paths here (a plain `--retry` skips some transient failures such as curl 56 — already documented in `ci.yml:2051`).

## Description

Closes #1511
# gh-1511 — publish-fa-llm first-publish guard + docs

### Root Cause
pub.dev OIDC publishing can only upload new **versions** of an **existing** package — the first upload of a new package must come from an authenticated human. `fa_llm` didn't exist on pub.dev at tag `fa_llm-v0.1.0`, so the upload died with `Only users are allowed to upload new packages.` and the workflow had no pre-flight to explain it.

### Fix
- `.github/workflows/publish-fa-llm.yml` — new pre-flight step: HEAD-probe `https://pub.dev/api/packages/fa_llm`; on 404 prints the actionable first-publish steps (manual `dart pub publish` + OIDC publisher entry, links issue #1511) and exits with distinct code `10`; unexpected probe codes warn but continue. Verified locally: 404 ⇒ exit 10, 200 ⇒ guard passes.
- `packages/fa_llm/README.md` — new **Publishing** section documenting the tag → OIDC flow and the one-time manual first-publish dance.
- `AGENTS.md` (`Commits and releases`) — bullet covering the `fa_llm` publish path; previously only the core package's auto-release was documented.

### Test Coverage
- Guard logic exercised locally against pub.dev: nonexistent package → exit 10 with message; `fa_llm` → 200, publish proceeds. Workflow YAML parses clean.
- `packages/fa_llm`: 87 tests passed (no Dart code changed).

### Notes
- The owner one-time step is **already done**: `https://pub.dev/api/packages/fa_llm` returns 200, latest `0.1.0` live on pub.dev (acceptance 1 ✅).
- Remaining acceptance 2 (`workflow green on next tag`) needs the owner to confirm the OIDC publisher entry on pub.dev (package admin → automated publishing → GitHub Actions, repo `IstiN/flutter_agent_harness`, workflow `publish-fa-llm.yml`, tag pattern `fa_llm-v*`) and push a new `fa_llm-v*` tag — not verifiable from code.
- `packages/fa_llm/pubspec.lock` (created by local `pub get`) is gitignored and outside the `check_lockfiles.sh` inventory — intentionally not committed.

name: Publish fa_llm

on:
  push:
    tags: ['fa_llm-v*']

# Cancel superseded runs of the same ref (issue #177).
concurrency:
  group: Publish fa_llm-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

permissions:
  id-token: write # OIDC — pub.dev verifies the GitHub identity, no secrets
  contents: read

jobs:
  publish:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: packages/fa_llm
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@6afc89df92d6eb3834022f73cd65adc8cdfcb92d # v1
        with:
          sdk: stable

      - run: dart pub get

      # Pre-flight (issue #1511): pub.dev OIDC publishing can only upload new
      # VERSIONS of an existing package — the first upload must be manual.
      # Probe the package; on 404 fail loudly with the actionable steps.
      - name: Pre-flight — package must already exist on pub.dev
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -I \
            https://pub.dev/api/packages/fa_llm || true)
          if [ "$code" = "404" ]; then
            echo "::error::fa_llm does not exist on pub.dev yet."
            echo "Automated (OIDC) publishing can only upload new VERSIONS of an"
            echo "existing package — the first upload must be done manually by an"
            echo "authenticated owner:"
            echo "  cd packages/fa_llm && dart pub publish"
            echo "Then add the OIDC publisher on pub.dev (package admin → automated"
            echo "publishing → GitHub Actions, repo IstiN/flutter_agent_harness,"
            echo "workflow publish-fa-llm.yml, tag pattern fa_llm-v*)."
            echo "See https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/issues/1511"
            exit 10
          fi
          if [ "$code" != "200" ]; then
            echo "::warning::pub.dev probe returned HTTP '${code:-<none>}' (expected 200); continuing anyway."
          fi

      - name: Publish to pub.dev
        run: dart pub publish --force

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Stage the publishable package into a target directory (issue #597).
#
# `dart publish` packs everything under the repo root that isn't
# gitignored — and the root hosts sub-projects that are NOT part of the
# pub package (flutter_app with its 57 MB wasm toolchain, yoclip media,
# browser_ext, office_addin, vendored forks, docs, packages/*). That
# blew the archive past pub.dev's hard 100 MB cap (v0.1.406: 100.4 MB).
#
# The staged copy carries the package surface (~32 MB) plus the two PATH
# dev-dependencies (packages/fa_llm_mock, vendored vendor/xterm —
# accepted by pub.dev since v0.1.369). pubspec_overrides.yaml (the
# local-only dart_tui vendor pin, "never ships to pub.dev" by its own
# comment) must NOT enter the stage: version solving would re-pin the
# path dep and fail (the v0.1.407 failure, exit 66).
#
# Usage: stage_publish_package.sh <target-dir>
# Exits non-zero (with ::error) when the staged tree exceeds the guard.
# The repo root hosts sub-projects that are NOT part of the pub package
# (flutter_app, yoclip, browser_ext, office_addin, vendored forks, docs)
# — `dart publish` packs everything under the root that isn't gitignored
# (v0.1.406: 100.4 MB, over pub.dev's hard cap). Stage the package
# surface instead. PATH dev-deps of the core pubspec must resolve inside
# the stage (#584, `dart pub get` exit 66 on v0.1.407): their subtrees
# are included BEFORE the parent excludes, and the parent excludes are
# child-scoped (vendor/*) — excluding the parent dir itself would prune
# the subtree before the includes are ever consulted.
# pubspec_overrides.yaml is the workspace-only dart_tui pin (never
# published, see its header); shipped into the stage it re-dangles
# dart_tui onto the excluded vendor dir.
set -euo pipefail

target="${1:?usage: stage_publish_package.sh <target-dir>}"
repo_root="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)"

mkdir -p "$target"
# Root-scoped excludes are ANCHORED: rsync matches an unanchored name
# against the basename at ANY depth — `memory` also pruned lib/src/memory/,
# shipping v0.1.411 with broken memory imports (issue #613). build/ and
# .dart_tool stay unanchored: build artifacts may appear at any depth and
# never belong in the stage.
# gh-1452: /CHANGELOG_ARCHIVE.md (the lossless trimmed tail of CHANGELOG.md)
# has no consumer in the pub package — GitHub carries the history. It is
# excluded below; must mirror /CHANGELOG_ARCHIVE.md in .pubignore (guarded
# by test/publish_staging_test.dart).
rsync -a "$repo_root"/ "$target"/ \
  --include 'vendor/xterm/' --include 'vendor/xterm/**' \
  --include 'packages/fa_llm_mock/' --include 'packages/fa_llm_mock/**' \
  --exclude '/.git' --exclude '/.github' --exclude '/.worktrees' \
  --exclude '/flutter_app' --exclude '/browser_ext' \
  --exclude '/office_addin' --exclude '/yoclip' \
  --exclude 'vendor/*' --exclude '/docs' --exclude '/fa-local' \
  --exclude 'packages/*' \
  --exclude '/pubspec_overrides.yaml' \
  --exclude '/CHANGELOG_ARCHIVE.md' \
  --exclude '.dart_tool' --exclude 'build' \
  --exclude '/memory' --exclude '/.trash' --exclude '/coverage'

size=$(du -sm "$target" | cut -f1)
echo "staged package: ${size} MB"
if [ "$size" -gt 90 ]; then
  echo "::error::staged package is ${size} MB (>90) — pub.dev caps uploads at 100 MB. Trim the staging excludes."
  exit 1
fi

## PR Description

Closes #1511
# gh-1511 — publish-fa-llm first-publish guard + docs

### Root Cause
pub.dev OIDC publishing can only upload new **versions** of an **existing** package — the first upload of a new package must come from an authenticated human. `fa_llm` didn't exist on pub.dev at tag `fa_llm-v0.1.0`, so the upload died with `Only users are allowed to upload new packages.` and the workflow had no pre-flight to explain it.

### Fix
- `.github/workflows/publish-fa-llm.yml` — new pre-flight step: HEAD-probe `https://pub.dev/api/packages/fa_llm`; on 404 prints the actionable first-publish steps (manual `dart pub publish` + OIDC publisher entry, links issue #1511) and exits with distinct code `10`; unexpected probe codes warn but continue. Verified locally: 404 ⇒ exit 10, 200 ⇒ guard passes.
- `packages/fa_llm/README.md` — new **Publishing** section documenting the tag → OIDC flow and the one-time manual first-publish dance.
- `AGENTS.md` (`Commits and releases`) — bullet covering the `fa_llm` publish path; previously only the core package's auto-release was documented.

### Test Coverage
- Guard logic exercised locally against pub.dev: nonexistent package → exit 10 with message; `fa_llm` → 200, publish proceeds. Workflow YAML parses clean.
- `packages/fa_llm`: 87 tests passed (no Dart code changed).

### Notes
- The owner one-time step is **already done**: `https://pub.dev/api/packages/fa_llm` returns 200, latest `0.1.0` live on pub.dev (acceptance 1 ✅).
- Remaining acceptance 2 (`workflow green on next tag`) needs the owner to confirm the OIDC publisher entry on pub.dev (package admin → automated publishing → GitHub Actions, repo `IstiN/flutter_agent_harness`, workflow `publish-fa-llm.yml`, tag pattern `fa_llm-v*`) and push a new `fa_llm-v*` tag — not verifiable from code.
- `packages/fa_llm/pubspec.lock` (created by local `pub get`) is gitignored and outside the `check_lockfiles.sh` inventory — intentionally not committed.

# pr-1512: gh-1511 [BUG] publish-fa-llm red since 08-14: pub.dev 'Only users are allowed to upload new packages' — first publish must be manual (one-time owner step)

## Description

Closes #1511
# gh-1511 — publish-fa-llm first-publish guard + docs

### Root Cause
pub.dev OIDC publishing can only upload new **versions** of an **existing** package — the first upload of a new package must come from an authenticated human. `fa_llm` didn't exist on pub.dev at tag `fa_llm-v0.1.0`, so the upload died with `Only users are allowed to upload new packages.` and the workflow had no pre-flight to explain it.

### Fix

name: Publish fa_llm

on:
  push:
    tags: ['fa_llm-v*']

# Cancel superseded runs of the same ref (issue #177).
concurrency:
  group: Publish fa_llm-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

permissions:
  id-token: write # OIDC — pub.dev verifies the GitHub identity, no secrets
  contents: read

jobs:
  publish:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: packages/fa_llm
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@6afc89df92d6eb3834022f73cd65adc8cdfcb92d # v1
        with:
          sdk: stable

      - run: dart pub get

      # Pre-flight (issue #1511): pub.dev OIDC publishing can only upload new
      # VERSIONS of an existing package — the first upload must be manual.
      # Probe the package; on 404 fail loudly with the actionable steps.
      - name: Pre-flight — package must already exist on pub.dev
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -I \
            https://pub.dev/api/packages/fa_llm || true)
          if [ "$code" = "404" ]; then
            echo "::error::fa_llm does not exist on pub.dev yet."
            echo "Automated (OIDC) publishing can only upload new VERSIONS of an"
            echo "existing package — the first upload must be done manually by an"
            echo "authenticated owner:"
            echo "  cd packages/fa_llm && dart pub publish"
            echo "Then add the OIDC publisher on pub.dev (package admin → automated"
            echo "publishing → GitHub Actions, repo IstiN/flutter_agent_harness,"
            echo "workflow publish-fa-llm.yml, tag pattern fa_llm-v*)."
            echo "See https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/issues/1511"
            exit 10
          fi
          if [ "$code" != "200" ]; then
            echo "::warning::pub.dev probe returned HTTP '${code:-<none>}' (expected 200); continuing anyway."
          fi

      - name: Publish to pub.dev
        run: dart pub publish --force

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Stage the publishable package into a target directory (issue #597).
#
# `dart publish` packs everything under the repo root that isn't
# gitignored — and the root hosts sub-projects that are NOT part of the
# pub package (flutter_app with its 57 MB wasm toolchain, yoclip media,
# browser_ext, office_addin, vendored forks, docs, packages/*). That
# blew the archive past pub.dev's hard 100 MB cap (v0.1.406: 100.4 MB).
#
# The staged copy carries the package surface (~32 MB) plus the two PATH
# dev-dependencies (packages/fa_llm_mock, vendored vendor/xterm —
# accepted by pub.dev since v0.1.369). pubspec_overrides.yaml (the
# local-only dart_tui vendor pin, "never ships to pub.dev" by its own
# comment) must NOT enter the stage: version solving would re-pin the
# path dep and fail (the v0.1.407 failure, exit 66).
#
# Usage: stage_publish_package.sh <target-dir>
# Exits non-zero (with ::error) when the staged tree exceeds the guard.
# The repo root hosts sub-projects that are NOT part of the pub package
# (flutter_app, yoclip, browser_ext, office_addin, vendored forks, docs)
# — `dart publish` packs everything under the root that isn't gitignored
# (v0.1.406: 100.4 MB, over pub.dev's hard cap). Stage the package
# surface instead. PATH dev-deps of the core pubspec must resolve inside
# the stage (#584, `dart pub get` exit 66 on v0.1.407): their subtrees
# are included BEFORE the parent excludes, and the parent excludes are
# child-scoped (vendor/*) — excluding the parent dir itself would prune
# the subtree before the includes are ever consulted.
# pubspec_overrides.yaml is the workspace-only dart_tui pin (never
# published, see its header); shipped into the stage it re-dangles
# dart_tui onto the excluded vendor dir.
set -euo pipefail

target="${1:?usage: stage_publish_package.sh <target-dir>}"
repo_root="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)"

mkdir -p "$target"
# Root-scoped excludes are ANCHORED: rsync matches an unanchored name
# against the basename at ANY depth — `memory` also pruned lib/src/memory/,
# shipping v0.1.411 with broken memory imports (issue #613). build/ and
# .dart_tool stay unanchored: build artifacts may appear at any depth and
# never belong in the stage.
# gh-1452: /CHANGELOG_ARCHIVE.md (the lossless trimmed tail of CHANGELOG.md)
# has no consumer in the pub package — GitHub carries the history. It is
# excluded below; must mirror /CHANGELOG_ARCHIVE.md in .pubignore (guarded
# by test/publish_staging_test.dart).
rsync -a "$repo_root"/ "$target"/ \
  --include 'vendor/xterm/' --include 'vendor/xterm/**' \
  --include 'packages/fa_llm_mock/' --include 'packages/fa_llm_mock/**' \
  --exclude '/.git' --exclude '/.github' --exclude '/.worktrees' \
  --exclude '/flutter_app' --exclude '/browser_ext' \
  --exclude '/office_addin' --exclude '/yoclip' \
  --exclude 'vendor/*' --exclude '/docs' --exclude '/fa-local' \
  --exclude 'packages/*' \
  --exclude '/pubspec_overrides.yaml' \
  --exclude '/CHANGELOG_ARCHIVE.md' \
  --exclude '.dart_tool' --exclude 'build' \
  --exclude '/memory' --exclude '/.trash' --exclude '/coverage'

size=$(du -sm "$target" | cut -f1)
echo "staged package: ${size} MB"
if [ "$size" -gt 90 ]; then
  echo "::error::staged package is ${size} MB (>90) — pub.dev caps uploads at 100 MB. Trim the staging excludes."
  exit 1
fi

      # Publish gate at PR time: publish-blocking problems (undeclared lib/
      # imports, stray PEM-like strings) used to surface only in the tag-time

      # fail. setup-dart (sdk >= 3.13) registers a publish-scoped PUB_TOKEN
      # job-wide and pub.dev rejects authenticated metadata reads, so
      # resolve unauthenticated (same pattern as the publish job);
      # --dry-run never uploads.
      - name: Publish dry-run (unauthenticated)
        run: |
          dart pub token remove https://pub.dev || true
          dart pub publish --dry-run --ignore-warnings

      # The example Flutter app lives in this repo; without its package
      # config the repo-wide `dart analyze` cannot resolve Flutter imports.
      - name: Example app pub get (for repo-wide analyze)
        uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

## PR Description

Closes #1511
# gh-1511 — publish-fa-llm first-publish guard + docs

### Root Cause
pub.dev OIDC publishing can only upload new **versions** of an **existing** package — the first upload of a new package must come from an authenticated human. `fa_llm` didn't exist on pub.dev at tag `fa_llm-v0.1.0`, so the upload died with `Only users are allowed to upload new packages.` and the workflow had no pre-flight to explain it.

### Fix
- `.github/workflows/publish-fa-llm.yml` — new pre-flight step: HEAD-probe `https://pub.dev/api/packages/fa_llm`; on 404 prints the actionable first-publish steps (manual `dart pub publish` + OIDC publisher entry, links issue #1511) and exits with distinct code `10`; unexpected probe codes warn but continue. Verified locally: 404 ⇒ exit 10, 200 ⇒ guard passes.
- `packages/fa_llm/README.md` — new **Publishing** section documenting the tag → OIDC flow and the one-time manual first-publish dance.
- `AGENTS.md` (`Commits and releases`) — bullet covering the `fa_llm` publish path; previously only the core package's auto-release was documented.

### Test Coverage
- Guard logic exercised locally against pub.dev: nonexistent package → exit 10 with message; `fa_llm` → 200, publish proceeds. Workflow YAML parses clean.
- `packages/fa_llm`: 87 tests passed (no Dart code changed).

### Notes
- The owner one-time step is **already done**: `https://pub.dev/api/packages/fa_llm` returns 200, latest `0.1.0` live on pub.dev (acceptance 1 ✅).
- Remaining acceptance 2 (`workflow green on next tag`) needs the owner to confirm the OIDC publisher entry on pub.dev (package admin → automated publishing → GitHub Actions, repo `IstiN/flutter_agent_harness`, workflow `publish-fa-llm.yml`, tag pattern `fa_llm-v*`) and push a new `fa_llm-v*` tag — not verifiable from code.
- `packages/fa_llm/pubspec.lock` (created by local `pub get`) is gitignored and outside the `check_lockfiles.sh` inventory — intentionally not committed.

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-10):
💡 **SUGGESTION: bare `curl` — add retry/timeout flags per repo convention**

The pre-flight probe uses a bare `curl`:

```bash
code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -I \
  https://pub.dev/api/packages/fa_llm || true)
```

Two consequences:

1. **No timeout** — if the connection to pub.dev hangs, `curl` has no default timeout and the step can stall until the job-level timeout (default 6h on hosted runners).
2. **No retry** — a transient failure yields code `000`, which falls into the warn-and-continue branch. That's a safe fallback, but a transient blip would then push a publish through the unguarded path.

The repo convention elsewhere (`ci.yml`, `nightly.yml`, `build-macos.yml`) is:

```bash
curl --retry 3 --retry-all-errors --retry-delay 10 --max-time 600 \
  --connect-timeout 30 ...
```

Suggest at minimum:

```bash
code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -I \
  --retry 3 --retry-all-errors --connect-timeout 15 --max-time 60 \
  https://pub.dev/api/packages/fa_llm || true)
```

Note `--retry-all-errors` is needed for `--retry` to apply to the probe-style exit paths here (a plain `--retry` skips some transient failures such as curl 56 — already documented in `ci.yml:2051`).

### Root Cause
pub.dev OIDC publishing can only upload new **versions** of an **existing** package — the first upload of a new package must come from an authenticated human. `fa_llm` didn't exist on pub.dev at tag `fa_llm-v0.1.0`, so the upload died with `Only users are allowed to upload new packages.` and the workflow had no pre-flight to explain it.

Verified locally: 404 ⇒ exit 10, 200 ⇒ guard passes.
- `packages/fa_llm/README.md` — new **Publishing** section documenting the tag → OIDC flow and the one-time manual first-publish dance.
- `AGENTS.md` (`Commits and releases`) — bullet covering the `fa_llm` publish path; previously only the core package's auto-release was documented.

### Test Coverage
- Guard logic exercised locally against pub.dev: nonexistent package → exit 10 with message; `fa_llm` → 200, publish proceeds. Workflow YAML parses clean.
- `packages/fa_llm`: 87 tests passed (no Dart code changed).

### Notes
- The owner one-time step is **already done**: `https://pub.dev/api/packages/fa_llm` returns 200, latest `0.1.0` live on pub.dev (acceptance 1 ✅).
- Remaining acceptance 2 (`workflow green on next tag`) needs the owner to confirm the OIDC publisher entry on pub.dev (package admin → automated publishing → GitHub Actions, repo `IstiN/flutter_agent_harness`, workflow `publish-fa-llm.yml`, tag pattern `fa_llm-v*`) and push a new `fa_llm-v*` tag — not verifiable from code.

name: Publish fa_llm

on:
  push:
    tags: ['fa_llm-v*']

# Cancel superseded runs of the same ref (issue #177).
concurrency:
  group: Publish fa_llm-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

permissions:
  id-token: write # OIDC — pub.dev verifies the GitHub identity, no secrets
  contents: read

jobs:
  publish:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: packages/fa_llm
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@6afc89df92d6eb3834022f73cd65adc8cdfcb92d # v1
        with:
          sdk: stable

      - run: dart pub get

      # Pre-flight (issue #1511): pub.dev OIDC publishing can only upload new
      # VERSIONS of an existing package — the first upload must be manual.
      # Probe the package; on 404 fail loudly with the actionable steps.
      - name: Pre-flight — package must already exist on pub.dev
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -I \
            https://pub.dev/api/packages/fa_llm || true)
          if [ "$code" = "404" ]; then
            echo "::error::fa_llm does not exist on pub.dev yet."
            echo "Automated (OIDC) publishing can only upload new VERSIONS of an"
            echo "existing package — the first upload must be done manually by an"
            echo "authenticated owner:"
            echo "  cd packages/fa_llm && dart pub publish"
            echo "Then add the OIDC publisher on pub.dev (package admin → automated"
            echo "publishing → GitHub Actions, repo IstiN/flutter_agent_harness,"
            echo "workflow publish-fa-llm.yml, tag pattern fa_llm-v*)."
            echo "See https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/issues/1511"
            exit 10
          fi
          if [ "$code" != "200" ]; then
            echo "::warning::pub.dev probe returned HTTP '${code:-<none>}' (expected 200); continuing anyway."
          fi

      - name: Publish to pub.dev
        run: dart pub publish --force

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Stage the publishable package into a target directory (issue #597).
#
# `dart publish` packs everything under the repo root that isn't
# gitignored — and the root hosts sub-projects that are NOT part of the
# pub package (flutter_app with its 57 MB wasm toolchain, yoclip media,
# browser_ext, office_addin, vendored forks, docs, packages/*). That
# blew the archive past pub.dev's hard 100 MB cap (v0.1.406: 100.4 MB).
#
# The staged copy carries the package surface (~32 MB) plus the two PATH
# dev-dependencies (packages/fa_llm_mock, vendored vendor/xterm —
# accepted by pub.dev since v0.1.369). pubspec_overrides.yaml (the
# local-only dart_tui vendor pin, "never ships to pub.dev" by its own
# comment) must NOT enter the stage: version solving would re-pin the
# path dep and fail (the v0.1.407 failure, exit 66).
#
# Usage: stage_publish_package.sh <target-dir>
# Exits non-zero (with ::error) when the staged tree exceeds the guard.
# The repo root hosts sub-projects that are NOT part of the pub package
# (flutter_app, yoclip, browser_ext, office_addin, vendored forks, docs)
# — `dart publish` packs everything under the root that isn't gitignored
# (v0.1.406: 100.4 MB, over pub.dev's hard cap). Stage the package
# surface instead. PATH dev-deps of the core pubspec must resolve inside
# the stage (#584, `dart pub get` exit 66 on v0.1.407): their subtrees
# are included BEFORE the parent excludes, and the parent excludes are
# child-scoped (vendor/*) — excluding the parent dir itself would prune
# the subtree before the includes are ever consulted.
# pubspec_overrides.yaml is the workspace-only dart_tui pin (never
# published, see its header); shipped into the stage it re-dangles
# dart_tui onto the excluded vendor dir.
set -euo pipefail

target="${1:?usage: stage_publish_package.sh <target-dir>}"
repo_root="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)"

mkdir -p "$target"
# Root-scoped excludes are ANCHORED: rsync matches an unanchored name
# against the basename at ANY depth — `memory` also pruned lib/src/memory/,
# shipping v0.1.411 with broken memory imports (issue #613). build/ and
# .dart_tool stay unanchored: build artifacts may appear at any depth and
# never belong in the stage.
# gh-1452: /CHANGELOG_ARCHIVE.md (the lossless trimmed tail of CHANGELOG.md)
# has no consumer in the pub package — GitHub carries the history. It is
# excluded below; must mirror /CHANGELOG_ARCHIVE.md in .pubignore (guarded
# by test/publish_staging_test.dart).
rsync -a "$repo_root"/ "$target"/ \
  --include 'vendor/xterm/' --include 'vendor/xterm/**' \
  --include 'packages/fa_llm_mock/' --include 'packages/fa_llm_mock/**' \
  --exclude '/.git' --exclude '/.github' --exclude '/.worktrees' \
  --exclude '/flutter_app' --exclude '/browser_ext' \
  --exclude '/office_addin' --exclude '/yoclip' \
  --exclude 'vendor/*' --exclude '/docs' --exclude '/fa-local' \
  --exclude 'packages/*' \
  --exclude '/pubspec_overrides.yaml' \
  --exclude '/CHANGELOG_ARCHIVE.md' \
  --exclude '.dart_tool' --exclude 'build' \
  --exclude '/memory' --exclude '/.trash' --exclude '/coverage'

size=$(du -sm "$target" | cut -f1)
echo "staged package: ${size} MB"
if [ "$size" -gt 90 ]; then
  echo "::error::staged package is ${size} MB (>90) — pub.dev caps uploads at 100 MB. Trim the staging excludes."
  exit 1
fi

Now I understand the setup. The mirror test has a test: "root-scoped staging excludes are mirrored in .pubignore" — iterates over staging rsync anchored excludes and requires each to be ignored by .pubignore. The staging script excludes `packages/*` (anchored? `'packages/*'` — contains `/` so anchored=true in the test's `_Filter` logic). Body = `packages/*`. The test checks `_ignoredByPubIgnore(rules, 'packages/*/pubspec.yaml', false)` — wait, body is `packages/*`, so it probes `${f.body}/pubspec.yaml` = `packages/*/pubspec.yaml`. Hmm, `_globMatch('packages/*', 'packages/*/pubspec.yaml')` — `*` matches `[^/]*`, so `packages/*` matches `packages/*`? The path to match is `packages/*/pubspec.yaml` — the glob `packages/*` would need to match the whole string; `*` = `[^/]*` can't cross `/`, so `packages/*` does NOT match `packages/*/pubspec.yaml`. Hmm wait, but `_ignoredByPubIgnore` evaluates per path prefix. Path `packages/*/pubspec.yaml` — prefixes: `packages` (dir), `packages/*` (dir), `packages/*/pubspec.yaml` (file). Rule `/packages/*` — body `packages/*` — matches prefix `packages/*` as dir? `_globMatch('packages/*', 'packages/*')` → `^packages/[^/]*$` matches "packages/*"? The literal `*` in the probed path is just a character; `[^/]*` matches `*`. Yes! So the rule `/packages/*` matches the prefix `packages/*` (the literal star), setting ignored=true. OK, so the test passes currently.

Now, thread 10's fix: add to root `.pubignore`:
```
!/packages/fa_llm/
!/packages/fa_llm_flutter/
```

The concern: this changes the ROOT package payload (root publish would now include those trees). The mirror guard test "root-scoped staging excludes are mirrored in .pubignore" — with negations added, `_ignoredByPubIgnore(rules, 'packages/*/pubspec.yaml')` — the probed path is a literal `packages/*/pubspec.yaml` with star char. Rules evaluated per prefix: prefixes `packages`, `packages/*`, `packages/*/pubspec.yaml`. The negation rules `!/packages/fa_llm/` have body `packages/fa_llm` — glob `^packages/fa_llm$` doesn't match `packages/*`. So ignored stays true. Test still passes.

But wait — does the negation actually work in real pub/gitignore semantics for publishing FROM packages/fa_llm? Gitignore semantics: `/packages/*` ignores each child of packages/; `!/packages/fa_llm/` re-includes the directory. When publishing from `packages/fa_llm`, pub walks up to the git root to collect files; the rule `/packages/*` would ignore `packages/fa_llm` dir but the negation re-includes it. Within an ignored dir, files can't be re-included — but here the parent `packages/` itself is not ignored, only its children via `*`, so the negation idiom works.

Now the decision requested in thread 10: "either accept fa_llm in the root payload (small) or keep the rsync excludes and update the mirror test tolerate pubignore-only negations."

Wait — does adding the negation to .pubignore affect the root payload? The root payload is what `dart publish` from repo root ships (dry-run in nightly). With negations, `packages/fa_llm/` and `packages/fa_llm_flutter/` would now be INCLUDED in the root payload, but the staging rsync still excludes them (stage script excludes `packages/*` without include exceptions for fa_llm). That creates mirror drift: .pubignore no longer mirrors the staged surface.

So the decision: option A — add rsync includes for fa_llm/fa_llm_flutter to the staging script too, so the root payload includes them; option B — keep the staging excludes and update the mirror test tolerate pubignore-only negations.

Which is better? The staging script's purpose: root publish payload = package surface + path dev-deps. fa_llm is not a path dep of the core pubspec (only fa_llm_mock is). ## PR Description

Closes #1511
# gh-1511 — publish-fa-llm first-publish guard + docs

### Root Cause
pub.dev OIDC publishing can only upload new **versions** of an **existing** package — the first upload of a new package must come from an authenticated human. `fa_llm` didn't exist on pub.dev at tag `fa_llm-v0.1.0`, so the upload died with `Only users are allowed to upload new packages.` and the workflow had no pre-flight to explain it.

### Fix
- `.github/workflows/publish-fa-llm.yml` — new pre-flight step: HEAD-probe `https://pub.dev/api/packages/fa_llm`; on 404 prints the actionable first-publish steps (manual `dart pub publish` + OIDC publisher entry, links issue #1511) and exits with distinct code `10`; unexpected probe codes warn but continue. Verified locally: 404 ⇒ exit 10, 200 ⇒ guard passes.
- `packages/fa_llm/README.md` — new **Publishing** section documenting the tag → OIDC flow and the one-time manual first-publish dance.
- `AGENTS.md` (`Commits and releases`) — bullet covering the `fa_llm` publish path; previously only the core package's auto-release was documented.

### Test Coverage
- Guard logic exercised locally against pub.dev: nonexistent package → exit 10 with message; `fa_llm` → 200, publish proceeds. Workflow YAML parses clean.
- `packages/fa_llm`: 87 tests passed (no Dart code changed).

### Notes
- The owner one-time step is **already done**: `https://pub.dev/api/packages/fa_llm` returns 200, latest `0.1.0` live on pub.dev (acceptance 1 ✅).
- Remaining acceptance 2 (`workflow green on next tag`) needs the owner to confirm the OIDC publisher entry on pub.dev (package admin → automated publishing → GitHub Actions, repo `IstiN/flutter_agent_harness`, workflow `publish-fa-llm.yml`, tag pattern `fa_llm-v*`) and push a new `fa_llm-v*` tag — not verifiable from code.
- `packages/fa_llm/pubspec.lock` (created by local `pub get`) is gitignored and outside the `check_lockfiles.sh` inventory — intentionally not committed.

## Review Threads (Inline Comments)

### Thread 1 — `.github/workflows/publish-fa-llm.yml`

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-10):
💡 **SUGGESTION: bare `curl` — add retry/timeout flags per repo convention**

The pre-flight probe uses a bare `curl`:

```bash
code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -I \
  https://pub.dev/api/packages/fa_llm || true)
```

Two consequences:

1. **No timeout** — if the connection to pub.dev hangs, `curl` has no default timeout and the step can stall until the job-level timeout (default 6h on hosted runners).
2. **No retry** — a transient failure yields code `000`, which falls into the warn-and-continue branch. That's a safe fallback, but a transient blip would then push a publish through the unguarded path.

The repo convention elsewhere (`ci.yml`, `nightly.yml`, `build-macos.yml`) is:

```bash
curl --retry 3 --retry-all-errors --retry-delay 10 --max-time 600 \
  --connect-timeout 30 ...
```

Suggest at minimum:

# pr-1512: gh-1511 [BUG] publish-fa-llm red since 08-14: pub.dev 'Only users are allowed to upload new packages' — first publish must be manual (one-time owner step)

## Description

Closes #1511
# gh-1511 — publish-fa-llm first-publish guard + docs

### Root Cause
pub.dev OIDC publishing can only upload new **versions** of an **existing** package — the first upload of a new package must come from an authenticated human. `fa_llm` didn't exist on pub.dev at tag `fa_llm-v0.1.0`, so the upload died with `Only users are allowed to upload new packages.` and the workflow had no pre-flight to explain it.

### Fix
- `.github/workflows/publish-fa-llm.yml` — new pre-flight step: HEAD-probe `https://pub.dev/api/packages/fa_llm`; on 404 prints the actionable first-publish steps (manual `dart pub publish` + OIDC publisher entry, links issue #1511) and exits with distinct code `10`; unexpected probe codes warn but continue. Verified locally: 404 ⇒ exit 10, 200 ⇒ guard passes.
- `packages/fa_llm/README.md` — new **Publishing** section documenting the tag → OIDC flow and the one-time manual first-publish dance.
- `AGENTS.md` (`Commits and releases`) — bullet covering the `fa_llm` publish path; previously only the core package's auto-release was documented.

### Test Coverage
- Guard logic exercised locally against pub.dev: nonexistent package → exit 10 with message; `fa_llm` → 200, publish proceeds. Workflow YAML parses clean.
- `packages/fa_llm`: 87 tests passed (no Dart code changed).

name: Publish fa_llm

on:
  push:
    tags: ['fa_llm-v*']

# Cancel superseded runs of the same ref (issue #177).
concurrency:
  group: Publish fa_llm-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

permissions:
  id-token: write # OIDC — pub.dev verifies the GitHub identity, no secrets
  contents: read

jobs:
  publish:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: packages/fa_llm
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@6afc89df92d6eb3834022f73cd65adc8cdfcb92d # v1
        with:
          sdk: stable

      - run: dart pub get

      # Pre-flight (issue #1511): pub.dev OIDC publishing can only upload new
      # VERSIONS of an existing package — the first upload must be manual.
      # Probe the package; on 404 fail loudly with the actionable steps.
      - name: Pre-flight — package must already exist on pub.dev
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -I \
            https://pub.dev/api/packages/fa_llm || true)
          if [ "$code" = "404" ]; then
            echo "::error::fa_llm does not exist on pub.dev yet."
            echo "Automated (OIDC) publishing can only upload new VERSIONS of an"
            echo "existing package — the first upload must be done manually by an"
            echo "authenticated owner:"
            echo "  cd packages/fa_llm && dart pub publish"
            echo "Then add the OIDC publisher on pub.dev (package admin → automated"
            echo "publishing → GitHub Actions, repo IstiN/flutter_agent_harness,"
            echo "workflow publish-fa-llm.yml, tag pattern fa_llm-v*)."
            echo "See https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/issues/1511"
            exit 10
          fi
          if [ "$code" != "200" ]; then
            echo "::warning::pub.dev probe returned HTTP '${code:-<none>}' (expected 200); continuing anyway."
          fi

      - name: Publish to pub.dev
        run: dart pub publish --force

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Stage the publishable package into a target directory (issue #597).
#
# `dart publish` packs everything under the repo root that isn't
# gitignored — and the root hosts sub-projects that are NOT part of the
# pub package (flutter_app with its 57 MB wasm toolchain, yoclip media,
# browser_ext, office_addin, vendored forks, docs, packages/*). That
# blew the archive past pub.dev's hard 100 MB cap (v0.1.406: 100.4 MB).
#
# The staged copy carries the package surface (~32 MB) plus the two PATH
# dev-dependencies (packages/fa_llm_mock, vendored vendor/xterm —
# accepted by pub.dev since v0.1.369). pubspec_overrides.yaml (the
# local-only dart_tui vendor pin, "never ships to pub.dev" by its own
# comment) must NOT enter the stage: version solving would re-pin the
# path dep and fail (the v0.1.407 failure, exit 66).
#
# Usage: stage_publish_package.sh <target-dir>
# Exits non-zero (with ::error) when the staged tree exceeds the guard.
# The repo root hosts sub-projects that are NOT part of the pub package
# (flutter_app, yoclip, browser_ext, office_addin, vendored forks, docs)
# — `dart publish` packs everything under the root that isn't gitignored
# (v0.1.406: 100.4 MB, over pub.dev's hard cap). Stage the package
# surface instead. PATH dev-deps of the core pubspec must resolve inside
# the stage (#584, `dart pub get` exit 66 on v0.1.407): their subtrees
# are included BEFORE the parent excludes, and the parent excludes are
# child-scoped (vendor/*) — excluding the parent dir itself would prune
# the subtree before the includes are ever consulted.
# pubspec_overrides.yaml is the workspace-only dart_tui pin (never
# published, see its header); shipped into the stage it re-dangles
# dart_tui onto the excluded vendor dir.
set -euo pipefail

target="${1:?usage: stage_publish_package.sh <target-dir>}"
repo_root="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)"

mkdir -p "$target"
# Root-scoped excludes are ANCHORED: rsync matches an unanchored name
# against the basename at ANY depth — `memory` also pruned lib/src/memory/,
# shipping v0.1.411 with broken memory imports (issue #613). build/ and
# .dart_tool stay unanchored: build artifacts may appear at any depth and
# never belong in the stage.
# gh-1452: /CHANGELOG_ARCHIVE.md (the lossless trimmed tail of CHANGELOG.md)
# has no consumer in the pub package — GitHub carries the history. It is
# excluded below; must mirror /CHANGELOG_ARCHIVE.md in .pubignore (guarded
# by test/publish_staging_test.dart).
rsync -a "$repo_root"/ "$target"/ \
  --include 'vendor/xterm/' --include 'vendor/xterm/**' \
  --include 'packages/fa_llm_mock/' --include 'packages/fa_llm_mock/**' \
  --exclude '/.git' --exclude '/.github' --exclude '/.worktrees' \
  --exclude '/flutter_app' --exclude '/browser_ext' \
  --exclude '/office_addin' --exclude '/yoclip' \
  --exclude 'vendor/*' --exclude '/docs' --exclude '/fa-local' \
  --exclude 'packages/*' \
  --exclude '/pubspec_overrides.yaml' \
  --exclude '/CHANGELOG_ARCHIVE.md' \
  --exclude '.dart_tool' --exclude 'build' \
  --exclude '/memory' --exclude '/.trash' --exclude '/coverage'

size=$(du -sm "$target" | cut -f1)
echo "staged package: ${size} MB"
if [ "$size" -gt 90 ]; then
  echo "::error::staged package is ${size} MB (>90) — pub.dev caps uploads at 100 MB. Trim the staging excludes."
  exit 1
fi

      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

          sdk: stable

      - uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2

          channel: stable

      - uses: actions/setup-python@5fda3b95a4ea91299a34e894583c3862153e4b97 # v7.0.0
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'

      - run: dart pub get

      # Publish gate at PR time: publish-blocking problems (undeclared lib/
      # imports, stray PEM-like strings) used to surface only in the tag-time
      # publish job — the v0.1.331 era: an undeclared package:cryptography
      # import shipped red on ~26 consecutive tags. --ignore-warnings: the
      # two known layout warnings (gitignored install_local.sh, docs/
      # naming) must not redden every PR, while validation ERRORS — "does
      # not have X in the dependencies section of pubspec.yaml" — still
      # fail. setup-dart (sdk >= 3.13) registers a publish-scoped PUB_TOKEN
      # job-wide and pub.dev rejects authenticated metadata reads, so
      # resolve unauthenticated (same pattern as the publish job);
      # --dry-run never uploads.
      - name: Publish dry-run (unauthenticated)
        run: |
          dart pub token remove https://pub.dev || true
          dart pub publish --dry-run --ignore-warnings

      # The example Flutter app lives in this repo; without its package
      # config the repo-wide `dart analyze` cannot resolve Flutter imports.
      - name: Example app pub get (for repo-wide analyze)
        uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

## PR Description

Closes #1511
# gh-1511 — publish-fa-llm first-publish guard + docs

### Root Cause
pub.dev OIDC publishing can only upload new **versions** of an **existing** package — the first upload of a new package must come from an authenticated human. `fa_llm` didn't exist on pub.dev at tag `fa_llm-v0.1.0`, so the upload died with `Only users are allowed to upload new packages.` and the workflow had no pre-flight to explain it.

### Fix
- `.github/workflows/publish-fa-llm.yml` — new pre-flight step: HEAD-probe `https://pub.dev/api/packages/fa_llm`; on 404 prints the actionable first-publish steps (manual `dart pub publish` + OIDC publisher entry, links issue #1511) and exits with distinct code `10`; unexpected probe codes warn but continue. Verified locally: 404 ⇒ exit 10, 200 ⇒ guard passes.
- `packages/fa_llm/README.md` — new **Publishing** section documenting the tag → OIDC flow and the one-time manual first-publish dance.
- `AGENTS.md` (`Commits and releases`) — bullet covering the `fa_llm` publish path; previously only the core package's auto-release was documented.

### Test Coverage
- Guard logic exercised locally against pub.dev: nonexistent package → exit 10 with message; `fa_llm` → 200, publish proceeds. Workflow YAML parses clean.
- `packages/fa_llm`: 87 tests passed (no Dart code changed).

### Notes
- The owner one-time step is **already done**: `https://pub.dev/api/packages/fa_llm` returns 200, latest `0.1.0` live on pub.dev (acceptance 1 ✅).
- Remaining acceptance 2 (`workflow green on next tag`) needs the owner to confirm the OIDC publisher entry on pub.dev (package admin → automated publishing → GitHub Actions, repo `IstiN/flutter_agent_harness`, workflow `publish-fa-llm.yml`, tag pattern `fa_llm-v*`) and push a new `fa_llm-v*` tag — not verifiable from code.
- `packages/fa_llm/pubspec.lock` (created by local `pub get`) is gitignored and outside the `check_lockfiles.sh` inventory — intentionally not committed.

### Thread 1 — `.github/workflows/publish-fa-llm.yml`

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-10):
💡 **SUGGESTION: bare `curl` — add retry/timeout flags per repo convention**

The pre-flight probe uses a bare `curl`:

```bash
code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -I \
  https://pub.dev/api/packages/fa_llm || true)
```

Two consequences:

1. **No timeout** — if the connection to pub.dev hangs, `curl` has no default timeout and the step can stall until the job-level timeout (default 6h on hosted runners).
2. **No retry** — a transient failure yields code `000`, which falls into the warn-and-continue branch. That's a safe fallback, but a transient blip would then push a publish through the unguarded path.

The repo convention elsewhere (`ci.yml`, `nightly.yml`, `build-macos.yml`) is:

```bash
curl --retry 3 --retry-all-errors --retry-delay 10 --max-time 600 \
  --connect-timeout 30 ...
```

Suggest at minimum:

```bash
code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -I \
  --retry 3 --retry-all-errors --connect-timeout 15 --max-time 60 \
  https://pub.dev/api/packages/fa_llm || true)
```

Note `--retry-all-errors` is needed for `--retry` to apply to the probe-style exit paths here (a plain `--retry` skips some transient failures such as curl 56 — already documented in `ci.yml:2051`).

- `packages/fa_llm/README.md` — new **Publishing** section documenting the tag → OIDC flow and the one-time manual first-publish dance.
- `AGENTS.md` (`Commits and releases`) — bullet covering the `fa_llm` publish path; previously only the core package's auto-release was documented.

### Test Coverage
- Guard logic exercised locally against pub.dev: nonexistent package → exit 10 with message; `fa_llm` → 200, publish proceeds. Workflow YAML parses clean.
- `packages/fa_llm`: 87 tests passed (no Dart code changed).

- The owner one-time step is **already done**: `https://pub.dev/api/packages/fa_llm` returns 200, latest `0.1.0` live on pub.dev (acceptance 1 ✅).

name: Publish fa_llm

on:
  push:
    tags: ['fa_llm-v*']

# Cancel superseded runs of the same ref (issue #177).
concurrency:
  group: Publish fa_llm-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

permissions:
  id-token: write # OIDC — pub.dev verifies the GitHub identity, no secrets
  contents: read

jobs:
  publish:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: packages/fa_llm
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@6afc89df92d6eb3834022f73cd65adc8cdfcb92d # v1
        with:
          sdk: stable

      - run: dart pub get

      # Pre-flight (issue #1511): pub.dev OIDC publishing can only upload new
      # VERSIONS of an existing package — the first upload must be manual.
      # Probe the package; on 404 fail loudly with the actionable steps.
      - name: Pre-flight — package must already exist on pub.dev
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -I \
            https://pub.dev/api/packages/fa_llm || true)
          if [ "$code" = "404" ]; then
            echo "::error::fa_llm does not exist on pub.dev yet."
            echo "Automated (OIDC) publishing can only upload new VERSIONS of an"
            echo "existing package — the first upload must be done manually by an"
            echo "authenticated owner:"
            echo "  cd packages/fa_llm && dart pub publish"
            echo "Then add the OIDC publisher on pub.dev (package admin → automated"
            echo "publishing → GitHub Actions, repo IstiN/flutter_agent_harness,"
            echo "workflow publish-fa-llm.yml, tag pattern fa_llm-v*)."
            echo "See https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/issues/1511"
            exit 10
          fi
          if [ "$code" != "200" ]; then
            echo "::warning::pub.dev probe returned HTTP '${code:-<none>}' (expected 200); continuing anyway."
          fi

      - name: Publish to pub.dev
        run: dart pub publish --force

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Stage the publishable package into a target directory (issue #597).
#
# `dart publish` packs everything under the repo root that isn't
# gitignored — and the root hosts sub-projects that are NOT part of the
# pub package (flutter_app with its 57 MB wasm toolchain, yoclip media,
# browser_ext, office_addin, vendored forks, docs, packages/*). That
# blew the archive past pub.dev's hard 100 MB cap (v0.1.406: 100.4 MB).
#
# The staged copy carries the package surface (~32 MB) plus the two PATH
# dev-dependencies (packages/fa_llm_mock, vendored vendor/xterm —
# accepted by pub.dev since v0.1.369). pubspec_overrides.yaml (the
# local-only dart_tui vendor pin, "never ships to pub.dev" by its own
# comment) must NOT enter the stage: version solving would re-pin the
# path dep and fail (the v0.1.407 failure, exit 66).
#
# Usage: stage_publish_package.sh <target-dir>
# Exits non-zero (with ::error) when the staged tree exceeds the guard.
# The repo root hosts sub-projects that are NOT part of the pub package
# (flutter_app, yoclip, browser_ext, office_addin, vendored forks, docs)
# — `dart publish` packs everything under the root that isn't gitignored
# (v0.1.406: 100.4 MB, over pub.dev's hard cap). Stage the package
# surface instead. PATH dev-deps of the core pubspec must resolve inside
# the stage (#584, `dart pub get` exit 66 on v0.1.407): their subtrees
# are included BEFORE the parent excludes, and the parent excludes are
# child-scoped (vendor/*) — excluding the parent dir itself would prune
# the subtree before the includes are ever consulted.
# pubspec_overrides.yaml is the workspace-only dart_tui pin (never
# published, see its header); shipped into the stage it re-dangles
# dart_tui onto the excluded vendor dir.
set -euo pipefail

target="${1:?usage: stage_publish_package.sh <target-dir>}"
repo_root="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)"

mkdir -p "$target"
# Root-scoped excludes are ANCHORED: rsync matches an unanchored name
# against the basename at ANY depth — `memory` also pruned lib/src/memory/,
# shipping v0.1.411 with broken memory imports (issue #613). build/ and
# .dart_tool stay unanchored: build artifacts may appear at any depth and
# never belong in the stage.
# gh-1452: /CHANGELOG_ARCHIVE.md (the lossless trimmed tail of CHANGELOG.md)
# has no consumer in the pub package — GitHub carries the history. It is
# excluded below; must mirror /CHANGELOG_ARCHIVE.md in .pubignore (guarded
# by test/publish_staging_test.dart).
rsync -a "$repo_root"/ "$target"/ \
  --include 'vendor/xterm/' --include 'vendor/xterm/**' \
  --include 'packages/fa_llm_mock/' --include 'packages/fa_llm_mock/**' \
  --exclude '/.git' --exclude '/.github' --exclude '/.worktrees' \
  --exclude '/flutter_app' --exclude '/browser_ext' \
  --exclude '/office_addin' --exclude '/yoclip' \
  --exclude 'vendor/*' --exclude '/docs' --exclude '/fa-local' \
  --exclude 'packages/*' \
  --exclude '/pubspec_overrides.yaml' \
  --exclude '/CHANGELOG_ARCHIVE.md' \
  --exclude '.dart_tool' --exclude 'build' \
  --exclude '/memory' --exclude '/.trash' --exclude '/coverage'

size=$(du -sm "$target" | cut -f1)
echo "staged package: ${size} MB"
if [ "$size" -gt 90 ]; then
  echo "::error::staged package is ${size} MB (>90) — pub.dev caps uploads at 100 MB. Trim the staging excludes."
  exit 1
fi

The path to match is `packages/*/pubspec.yaml` — the glob `packages/*` would need to match the whole string; `*` = `[^/]*` can't cross `/`, so `packages/*` does NOT match `packages/*/pubspec.yaml`. Hmm wait, but `_ignoredByPubIgnore` evaluates per path prefix. Path `packages/*/pubspec.yaml` — prefixes: `packages` (dir), `packages/*` (dir), `packages/*/pubspec.yaml` (file). Rule `/packages/*` — body `packages/*` — matches prefix `packages/*` as dir? `_globMatch('packages/*', 'packages/*')` → `^packages/[^/]*$` matches "packages/*"? But wait — does the negation actually work in real pub/gitignore semantics for publishing FROM packages/fa_llm? Gitignore semantics: `/packages/*` ignores each child of packages/; `!/packages/fa_llm/` re-includes the directory. When publishing from `packages/fa_llm`, pub walks up to the git root to collect files; the rule `/packages/*` would ignore `packages/fa_llm` dir but the negation re-includes it. Within an ignored dir, files can't be re-included — but here the parent `packages/` itself is not ignored, only its children via `*`, so the negation idiom works.

### Thread 1 — `.github/workflows/publish-fa-llm.yml`

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-10):
💡 **SUGGESTION: bare `curl` — add retry/timeout flags per repo convention**

The pre-flight probe uses a bare `curl`:

```bash
code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -I \
  https://pub.dev/api/packages/fa_llm || true)
```

Two consequences:

1. **No timeout** — if the connection to pub.dev hangs, `curl` has no default timeout and the step can stall until the job-level timeout (default 6h on hosted runners).
2. **No retry** — a transient failure yields code `000`, which falls into the warn-and-continue branch. That's a safe fallback, but a transient blip would then push a publish through the unguarded path.

The repo convention elsewhere (`ci.yml`, `nightly.yml`, `build-macos.yml`) is:

```bash
curl --retry 3 --retry-all-errors --retry-delay 10 --max-time 600 \
  --connect-timeout 30 ...
```

Suggest at minimum:

```bash
code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -I \
  --retry 3 --retry-all-errors --connect-timeout 15 --max-time 60 \
  https://pub.dev/api/packages/fa_llm || true)
```

Note `--retry-all-errors` is needed for `--retry` to apply to the probe-style exit paths here (a plain `--retry` skips some transient failures such as curl 56 — already documented in `ci.yml:2051`).

# pr-1512: gh-1511 [BUG] publish-fa-llm red since 08-14: pub.dev 'Only users are allowed to upload new packages' — first publish must be manual (one-time owner step)

## Description

Closes #1511
# gh-1511 — publish-fa-llm first-publish guard + docs

### Root Cause
pub.dev OIDC publishing can only upload new **versions** of an **existing** package — the first upload of a new package must come from an authenticated human. `fa_llm` didn't exist on pub.dev at tag `fa_llm-v0.1.0`, so the upload died with `Only users are allowed to upload new packages.` and the workflow had no pre-flight to explain it.

### Fix
- `.github/workflows/publish-fa-llm.yml` — new pre-flight step: HEAD-probe `https://pub.dev/api/packages/fa_llm`; on 404 prints the actionable first-publish steps (manual `dart pub publish` + OIDC publisher entry, links issue #1511) and exits with distinct code `10`; unexpected probe codes warn but continue. Verified locally: 404 ⇒ exit 10, 200 ⇒ guard passes.
- `packages/fa_llm/README.md` — new **Publishing** section documenting the tag → OIDC flow and the one-time manual first-publish dance.
- `AGENTS.md` (`Commits and releases`) — bullet covering the `fa_llm` publish path; previously only the core package's auto-release was documented.

### Test Coverage
- Guard logic exercised locally against pub.dev: nonexistent package → exit 10 with message; `fa_llm` → 200, publish proceeds. Workflow YAML parses clean.
- `packages/fa_llm`: 87 tests passed (no Dart code changed).

### Notes
- The owner one-time step is **already done**: `https://pub.dev/api/packages/fa_llm` returns 200, latest `0.1.0` live on pub.dev (acceptance 1 ✅).
- Remaining acceptance 2 (`workflow green on next tag`) needs the owner to confirm the OIDC publisher entry on pub.dev (package admin → automated publishing → GitHub Actions, repo `IstiN/flutter_agent_harness`, workflow `publish-fa-llm.yml`, tag pattern `fa_llm-v*`) and push a new `fa_llm-v*` tag — not verifiable from code.
- `packages/fa_llm/pubspec.lock` (created by local `pub get`) is gitignored and outside the `check_lockfiles.sh` inventory — intentionally not committed.

name: Publish fa_llm

on:
  push:
    tags: ['fa_llm-v*']

# Cancel superseded runs of the same ref (issue #177).
concurrency:
  group: Publish fa_llm-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

permissions:
  id-token: write # OIDC — pub.dev verifies the GitHub identity, no secrets
  contents: read

jobs:
  publish:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: packages/fa_llm
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@6afc89df92d6eb3834022f73cd65adc8cdfcb92d # v1
        with:
          sdk: stable

      - run: dart pub get

      # Pre-flight (issue #1511): pub.dev OIDC publishing can only upload new

      - name: Pre-flight — package must already exist on pub.dev
        run: |

          code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -I \
            https://pub.dev/api/packages/fa_llm || true)

            echo "::error::fa_llm does not exist on pub.dev yet."
            echo "Automated (OIDC) publishing can only upload new VERSIONS of an"
            echo "existing package — the first upload must be done manually by an"
            echo "authenticated owner:"
            echo "  cd packages/fa_llm && dart pub publish"
            echo "Then add the OIDC publisher on pub.dev (package admin → automated"
            echo "publishing → GitHub Actions, repo IstiN/flutter_agent_harness,"
            echo "workflow publish-fa-llm.yml, tag pattern fa_llm-v*)."
            echo "See https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/issues/1511"

blocks.text:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Stage the publishable package into a target directory (issue #597).
#
# `dart publish` packs everything under the repo root that isn't
# gitignored — and the root hosts sub-projects that are NOT part of the
# pub package (flutter_app with its 57 MB wasm toolchain, yoclip media,
# browser_ext, office_addin, vendored forks, docs, packages/*). That
# blew the archive past pub.dev's hard 100 MB cap (v0.1.406: 100.4 MB).
#
# The staged copy carries the package surface (~32 MB) plus the two PATH
# dev-dependencies (packages/fa_llm_mock, vendored vendor/xterm —
# accepted by pub.dev since v0.1.369). pubspec_overrides.yaml (the
# local-only dart_tui vendor pin, "never ships to pub.dev" by its own
# comment) must NOT enter the stage: version solving would re-pin the
# path dep and fail (the v0.1.407 failure, exit 66).
#
# Usage: stage_publish_package.sh <target-dir>
# Exits non-zero (with ::error) when the staged tree exceeds the guard.
# The repo root hosts sub-projects that are NOT part of the pub package
# (flutter_app, yoclip, browser_ext, office_addin, vendored forks, docs)
# — `dart publish` packs everything under the root that isn't gitignored
# (v0.1.406: 100.4 MB, over pub.dev's hard cap). Stage the package
# surface instead. PATH dev-deps of the core pubspec must resolve inside
# the stage (#584, `dart pub get` exit 66 on v0.1.407): their subtrees
# are included BEFORE the parent excludes, and the parent excludes are
# child-scoped (vendor/*) — excluding the parent dir itself would prune
# the subtree before the includes are ever consulted.
# pubspec_overrides.yaml is the workspace-only dart_tui pin (never
# published, see its header); shipped into the stage it re-dangles
# dart_tui onto the excluded vendor dir.
set -euo pipefail

target="${1:?usage: stage_publish_package.sh <target-dir>}"
repo_root="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)"

mkdir -p "$target"
# Root-scoped excludes are ANCHORED: rsync matches an unanchored name
# against the basename at ANY depth — `memory` also pruned lib/src/memory/,
# shipping v0.1.411 with broken memory imports (issue #613). build/ and
# .dart_tool stay unanchored: build artifacts may appear at any depth and
# never belong in the stage.
# gh-1452: /CHANGELOG_ARCHIVE.md (the lossless trimmed tail of CHANGELOG.md)
# has no consumer in the pub package — GitHub carries the history. It is
# excluded below; must mirror /CHANGELOG_ARCHIVE.md in .pubignore (guarded
# by test/publish_staging_test.dart).
rsync -a "$repo_root"/ "$target"/ \
  --include 'vendor/xterm/' --include 'vendor/xterm/**' \
  --include 'packages/fa_llm_mock/' --include 'packages/fa_llm_mock/**' \
  --exclude '/.git' --exclude '/.github' --exclude '/.worktrees' \
  --exclude '/flutter_app' --exclude '/browser_ext' \
  --exclude '/office_addin' --exclude '/yoclip' \
  --exclude 'vendor/*' --exclude '/docs' --exclude '/fa-local' \
  --exclude 'packages/*' \
  --exclude '/pubspec_overrides.yaml' \
  --exclude '/CHANGELOG_ARCHIVE.md' \
  --exclude '.dart_tool' --exclude 'build' \
  --exclude '/memory' --exclude '/.trash' --exclude '/coverage'

size=$(du -sm "$target" | cut -f1)
echo "staged package: ${size} MB"
if [ "$size" -gt 90 ]; then
  echo "::error::staged package is ${size} MB (>90) — pub.dev caps uploads at 100 MB. Trim the staging excludes."
  exit 1
fi

# pr-1512: gh-1511 [BUG] publish-fa-llm red since 08-14: pub.dev 'Only users are allowed to upload new packages' — first publish must be manual (one-time owner step)

## Description

Closes #1511
# gh-1511 — publish-fa-llm first-publish guard + docs

### Root Cause
pub.dev OIDC publishing can only upload new **versions** of an **existing** package — the first upload of a new package must come from an authenticated human. `fa_llm` didn't exist on pub.dev at tag `fa_llm-v0.1.0`, so the upload died with `Only users are allowed to upload new packages.` and the workflow had no pre-flight to explain it.

### Fix
- `.github/workflows/publish-fa-llm.yml` — new pre-flight step: HEAD-probe `https://pub.dev/api/packages/fa_llm`; on 404 prints the actionable first-publish steps (manual `dart pub publish` + OIDC publisher entry, links issue #1511) and exits with distinct code `10`; unexpected probe codes warn but continue. Verified locally: 404 ⇒ exit 10, 200 ⇒ guard passes.
- `packages/fa_llm/README.md` — new **Publishing** section documenting the tag → OIDC flow and the one-time manual first-publish dance.
- `AGENTS.md` (`Commits and releases`) — bullet covering the `fa_llm` publish path; previously only the core package's auto-release was documented.

### Test Coverage
- Guard logic exercised locally against pub.dev: nonexistent package → exit 10 with message; `fa_llm` → 200, publish proceeds. Workflow YAML parses clean.
- `packages/fa_llm`: 87 tests passed (no Dart code changed).

### Notes
- The owner one-time step is **already done**: `https://pub.dev/api/packages/fa_llm` returns 200, latest `0.1.0` live on pub.dev (acceptance 1 ✅).
- Remaining acceptance 2 (`workflow green on next tag`) needs the owner to confirm the OIDC publisher entry on pub.dev (package admin → automated publishing → GitHub Actions, repo `IstiN/flutter_agent_harness`, workflow `publish-fa-llm.yml`, tag pattern `fa_llm-v*`) and push a new `fa_llm-v*` tag — not verifiable from code.
- `packages/fa_llm/pubspec.lock` (created by local `pub get`) is gitignored and outside the `check_lockfiles.sh` inventory — intentionally not committed.

name: Publish fa_llm

on:
  push:
    tags: ['fa_llm-v*']

# Cancel superseded runs of the same ref (issue #177).
concurrency:
  group: Publish fa_llm-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

permissions:
  id-token: write # OIDC — pub.dev verifies the GitHub identity, no secrets
  contents: read

jobs:
  publish:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: packages/fa_llm
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@6afc89df92d6eb3834022f73cd65adc8cdfcb92d # v1
        with:
          sdk: stable

      - run: dart pub get

      # Pre-flight (issue #1511): pub.dev OIDC publishing can only upload new
      # VERSIONS of an existing package — the first upload must be manual.
      # Probe the package; on 404 fail loudly with the actionable steps.
      - name: Pre-flight — package must already exist on pub.dev
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -I \
            https://pub.dev/api/packages/fa_llm || true)
          if [ "$code" = "404" ]; then
            echo "::error::fa_llm does not exist on pub.dev yet."
            echo "Automated (OIDC) publishing can only upload new VERSIONS of an"
            echo "existing package — the first upload must be done manually by an"
            echo "authenticated owner:"
            echo "  cd packages/fa_llm && dart pub publish"
            echo "Then add the OIDC publisher on pub.dev (package admin → automated"
            echo "publishing → GitHub Actions, repo IstiN/flutter_agent_harness,"
            echo "workflow publish-fa-llm.yml, tag pattern fa_llm-v*)."
            echo "See https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/issues/1511"
            exit 10
          fi
          if [ "$code" != "200" ]; then
            echo "::warning::pub.dev probe returned HTTP '${code:-<none>}' (expected 200); continuing anyway."
          fi

      - name: Publish to pub.dev
        run: dart pub publish --force

blocks.text:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Stage the publishable package into a target directory (issue #597).
#
# `dart publish` packs everything under the repo root that isn't
# gitignored — and the root hosts sub-projects that are NOT part of the
# pub package (flutter_app with its 57 MB wasm toolchain, yoclip media,
# browser_ext, office_addin, vendored forks, docs, packages/*). That
# blew the archive past pub.dev's hard 100 MB cap (v0.1.406: 100.4 MB).
#
# The staged copy carries the package surface (~32 MB) plus the two PATH
# dev-dependencies (packages/fa_llm_mock, vendored vendor/xterm —
# accepted by pub.dev since v0.1.369). pubspec_overrides.yaml (the
# local-only dart_tui vendor pin, "never ships to pub.dev" by its own
# comment) must NOT enter the stage: version solving would re-pin the
# path dep and fail (the v0.1.407 failure, exit 66).
#
# Usage: stage_publish_package.sh <target-dir>
# Exits non-zero (with ::error) when the staged tree exceeds the guard.
# The repo root hosts sub-projects that are NOT part of the pub package
# (flutter_app, yoclip, browser_ext, office_addin, vendored forks, docs)
# — `dart publish` packs everything under the root that isn't gitignored
# (v0.1.406: 100.4 MB, over pub.dev's hard cap). Stage the package
# surface instead. PATH dev-deps of the core pubspec must resolve inside
# the stage (#584, `dart pub get` exit 66 on v0.1.407): their subtrees
# are included BEFORE the parent excludes, and the parent excludes are
# child-scoped (vendor/*) — excluding the parent dir itself would prune
# the subtree before the includes are ever consulted.
# pubspec_overrides.yaml is the workspace-only dart_tui pin (never
# published, see its header); shipped into the stage it re-dangles
# dart_tui onto the excluded vendor dir.
set -euo pipefail

target="${1:?usage: stage_publish_package.sh <target-dir>}"
repo_root="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)"

mkdir -p "$target"
# Root-scoped excludes are ANCHORED: rsync matches an unanchored name
# against the basename at ANY depth — `memory` also pruned lib/src/memory/,
# shipping v0.1.411 with broken memory imports (issue #613). build/ and
# .dart_tool stay unanchored: build artifacts may appear at any depth and
# never belong in the stage.
# gh-1452: /CHANGELOG_ARCHIVE.md (the lossless trimmed tail of CHANGELOG.md)
# has no consumer in the pub package — GitHub carries the history. It is
# excluded below; must mirror /CHANGELOG_ARCHIVE.md in .pubignore (guarded
# by test/publish_staging_test.dart).
rsync -a "$repo_root"/ "$target"/ \
  --include 'vendor/xterm/' --include 'vendor/xterm/**' \
  --include 'packages/fa_llm_mock/' --include 'packages/fa_llm_mock/**' \
  --exclude '/.git' --exclude '/.github' --exclude '/.worktrees' \
  --exclude '/flutter_app' --exclude '/browser_ext' \
  --exclude '/office_addin' --exclude '/yoclip' \
  --exclude 'vendor/*' --exclude '/docs' --exclude '/fa-local' \
  --exclude 'packages/*' \
  --exclude '/pubspec_overrides.yaml' \
  --exclude '/CHANGELOG_ARCHIVE.md' \
  --exclude '.dart_tool' --exclude 'build' \
  --exclude '/memory' --exclude '/.trash' --exclude '/coverage'

size=$(du -sm "$target" | cut -f1)
echo "staged package: ${size} MB"
if [ "$size" -gt 90 ]; then
  echo "::error::staged package is ${size} MB (>90) — pub.dev caps uploads at 100 MB. Trim the staging excludes."
  exit 1
fi
