# pr-1512: gh-1511 [BUG] publish-fa-llm red since 08-14: pub.dev 'Only users are allowed to upload new packages' — first publish must be manual (one-time owner step)

## Description

Closes #1511
# gh-1511 — publish-fa-llm first-publish guard + docs

### Root Cause
pub.dev OIDC publishing can only upload new **versions** of an **existing** package — the first upload of a new package must come from an authenticated human. `fa_llm` didn't exist on pub.dev at tag `fa_llm-v0.1.0`, so the upload died with `Only users are allowed to upload new packages.` and the workflow had no pre-flight to explain it.

### Fix
- `.github/workflows/publish-fa-llm.yml` — new pre-flight step: HEAD-probe `https://pub.dev/api/packages/fa_llm`; on 404 prints the actionable first-publish steps (manual `dart pub publish` + OIDC publisher entry, links issue #1511) and exits with distinct code `10`; unexpected probe codes warn but continue. Verified locally: 404 ⇒ exit 10, 200 ⇒ guard passes.
- `packages/fa_llm/README.md` — new **Publishing** section documenting the tag → OIDC flow and the one-time manual first-publish dance.
- `AGENTS.md` (`Commits and releases`) — bullet covering the `fa_llm` publish path; previously only the core package's auto-release was documented.

### Test Coverage
- Guard logic exercised locally against pub.dev: nonexistent package → exit 10 with message; `fa_llm` → 200, publish proceeds. Workflow YAML parses clean.
- `packages/fa_llm`: 87 tests passed (no Dart code changed).

### Notes
- The owner one-time step is **already done**: `https://pub.dev/api/packages/fa_llm` returns 200, latest `0.1.0` live on pub.dev (acceptance 1 ✅).
- Remaining acceptance 2 (`workflow green on next tag`) needs the owner to confirm the OIDC publisher entry on pub.dev (package admin → automated publishing → GitHub Actions, repo `IstiN/flutter_agent_harness`, workflow `publish-fa-llm.yml`, tag pattern `fa_llm-v*`) and push a new `fa_llm-v*` tag — not verifiable from code.
- `packages/fa_llm/pubspec.lock` (created by local `pub get`) is gitignored and outside the `check_lockfiles.sh` inventory — intentionally not committed.

name: Publish fa_llm

on:
  push:
    tags: ['fa_llm-v*']

# Cancel superseded runs of the same ref (issue #177).
concurrency:
  group: Publish fa_llm-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

permissions:
  id-token: write # OIDC — pub.dev verifies the GitHub identity, no secrets
  contents: read

jobs:
  publish:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: packages/fa_llm
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@6afc89df92d6eb3834022f73cd65adc8cdfcb92d # v1
        with:
          sdk: stable

      - run: dart pub get

      # Pre-flight (issue #1511): pub.dev OIDC publishing can only upload new
      # VERSIONS of an existing package — the first upload must be manual.
      # Probe the package; on 404 fail loudly with the actionable steps.
      - name: Pre-flight — package must already exist on pub.dev
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -I \
            https://pub.dev/api/packages/fa_llm || true)
          if [ "$code" = "404" ]; then
            echo "::error::fa_llm does not exist on pub.dev yet."
            echo "Automated (OIDC) publishing can only upload new VERSIONS of an"
            echo "existing package — the first upload must be done manually by an"
            echo "authenticated owner:"
            echo "  cd packages/fa_llm && dart pub publish"
            echo "Then add the OIDC publisher on pub.dev (package admin → automated"
            echo "publishing → GitHub Actions, repo IstiN/flutter_agent_harness,"
            echo "workflow publish-fa-llm.yml, tag pattern fa_llm-v*)."
            echo "See https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/issues/1511"
            exit 10
          fi
          if [ "$code" != "200" ]; then
            echo "::warning::pub.dev probe returned HTTP '${code:-<none>}' (expected 200); continuing anyway."
          fi

      - name: Publish to pub.dev
        run: dart pub publish --force

#
# `dart publish` packs everything under the repo root that isn't
# gitignored — and the root hosts sub-projects that are NOT part of the
# pub package (flutter_app with its 57 MB wasm toolchain, yoclip media,
# browser_ext, office_addin, vendored forks, docs, packages/*). That
# blew the archive past pub.dev's hard 100 MB cap (v0.1.406: 100.4 MB).
#
# The staged copy carries the package surface (~32 MB) plus the two PATH
# dev-dependencies (packages/fa_llm_mock, vendored vendor/xterm —
# accepted by pub.dev since v0.1.369). pubspec_overrides.yaml (the
# local-only dart_tui vendor pin, "never ships to pub.dev" by its own
# comment) must NOT enter the stage: version solving would re-pin the
# path dep and fail (the v0.1.407 failure, exit 66).
#
# Usage: stage_publish_package.sh <target-dir>
# Exits non-zero (with ::error) when the staged tree exceeds the guard.
# The repo root hosts sub-projects that are NOT part of the pub package
# (flutter_app, yoclip, browser_ext, office_addin, vendored forks, docs)
# — `dart publish` packs everything under the root that isn't gitignored
# (v0.1.406: 100.4 MB, over pub.dev's hard cap). Stage the package
# surface instead. PATH dev-deps of the core pubspec must resolve inside
# the stage (#584, `dart pub get` exit 66 on v0.1.407): their subtrees
# are included BEFORE the parent excludes, and the parent excludes are
# child-scoped (vendor/*) — excluding the parent dir itself would prune
# the subtree before the includes are ever consulted.
# pubspec_overrides.yaml is the workspace-only dart_tui pin (never
# published, see its header); shipped into the stage it re-dangles
# dart_tui onto the excluded vendor dir.
set -euo pipefail

target="${1:?usage: stage_publish_package.sh <target-dir>}"
repo_root="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)"

mkdir -p "$target"
# Root-scoped excludes are ANCHORED: rsync matches an unanchored name
# against the basename at ANY depth — `memory` also pruned lib/src/memory/,
# shipping v0.1.411 with broken memory imports (issue #613). build/ and
# .dart_tool stay unanchored: build artifacts may appear at any depth and
# never belong in the stage.
# gh-1452: /CHANGELOG_ARCHIVE.md (the lossless trimmed tail of CHANGELOG.md)
# has no consumer in the pub package — GitHub carries the history. It is
# excluded below; must mirror /CHANGELOG_ARCHIVE.md in .pubignore (guarded
# by test/publish_staging_test.dart).
rsync -a "$repo_root"/ "$target"/ \
  --include 'vendor/xterm/' --include 'vendor/xterm/**' \
  --include 'packages/fa_llm_mock/' --include 'packages/fa_llm_mock/**' \
  --exclude '/.git' --exclude '/.github' --exclude '/.worktrees' \
  --exclude '/flutter_app' --exclude '/browser_ext' \
  --exclude '/office_addin' --exclude '/yoclip' \
  --exclude 'vendor/*' --exclude '/docs' --exclude '/fa-local' \
  --exclude 'packages/*' \
  --exclude '/pubspec_overrides.yaml' \
  --exclude '/CHANGELOG_ARCHIVE.md' \
  --exclude '.dart_tool' --exclude 'build' \
  --exclude '/memory' --exclude '/.trash' --exclude '/coverage'

size=$(du -sm "$target" | cut -f1)
echo "staged package: ${size} MB"
if [ "$size" -gt 90 ]; then
  echo "::error::staged package is ${size} MB (>90) — pub.dev caps uploads at 100 MB. Trim the staging excludes."
  exit 1
fi

name: Publish fa_llm

on:
  push:
    tags: ['fa_llm-v*']

# Cancel superseded runs of the same ref (issue #177).
concurrency:
  group: Publish fa_llm-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

permissions:
  id-token: write # OIDC — pub.dev verifies the GitHub identity, no secrets
  contents: read

jobs:
  publish:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: packages/fa_llm
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@6afc89df92d6eb3834022f73cd65adc8cdfcb92d # v1
        with:
          sdk: stable

      - run: dart pub get

      # Pre-flight (issue #1511): pub.dev OIDC publishing can only upload new
      # VERSIONS of an existing package — the first upload must be manual.
      # Probe the package; on 404 fail loudly with the actionable steps.
      - name: Pre-flight — package must already exist on pub.dev
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -I \
            https://pub.dev/api/packages/fa_llm || true)
          if [ "$code" = "404" ]; then
            echo "::error::fa_llm does not exist on pub.dev yet."
            echo "Automated (OIDC) publishing can only upload new VERSIONS of an"
            echo "existing package — the first upload must be done manually by an"
            echo "authenticated owner:"
            echo "  cd packages/fa_llm && dart pub publish"
            echo "Then add the OIDC publisher on pub.dev (package admin → automated"
            echo "publishing → GitHub Actions, repo IstiN/flutter_agent_harness,"
            echo "workflow publish-fa-llm.yml, tag pattern fa_llm-v*)."
            echo "See https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/issues/1511"
            exit 10
          fi
          if [ "$code" != "200" ]; then
            echo "::warning::pub.dev probe returned HTTP '${code:-<none>}' (expected 200); continuing anyway."
          fi

      - name: Publish to pub.dev
        run: dart pub publish --force

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Stage the publishable package into a target directory (issue #597).
#
# `dart publish` packs everything under the repo root that isn't
# gitignored — and the root hosts sub-projects that are NOT part of the
# pub package (flutter_app with its 57 MB wasm toolchain, yoclip media,
# browser_ext, office_addin, vendored forks, docs, packages/*). That
# blew the archive past pub.dev's hard 100 MB cap (v0.1.406: 100.4 MB).
#
# The staged copy carries the package surface (~32 MB) plus the two PATH
# dev-dependencies (packages/fa_llm_mock, vendored vendor/xterm —
# accepted by pub.dev since v0.1.369). pubspec_overrides.yaml (the
# local-only dart_tui vendor pin, "never ships to pub.dev" by its own
# comment) must NOT enter the stage: version solving would re-pin the
# path dep and fail (the v0.1.407 failure, exit 66).
#
# Usage: stage_publish_package.sh <target-dir>
# Exits non-zero (with ::error) when the staged tree exceeds the guard.
# The repo root hosts sub-projects that are NOT part of the pub package
# (flutter_app, yoclip, browser_ext, office_addin, vendored forks, docs)
# — `dart publish` packs everything under the root that isn't gitignored
# (v0.1.406: 100.4 MB, over pub.dev's hard cap). Stage the package
# surface instead. PATH dev-deps of the core pubspec must resolve inside
# the stage (#584, `dart pub get` exit 66 on v0.1.407): their subtrees
# are included BEFORE the parent excludes, and the parent excludes are
# child-scoped (vendor/*) — excluding the parent dir itself would prune
# the subtree before the includes are ever consulted.
# pubspec_overrides.yaml is the workspace-only dart_tui pin (never
# published, see its header); shipped into the stage it re-dangles
# dart_tui onto the excluded vendor dir.
set -euo pipefail

target="${1:?usage: stage_publish_package.sh <target-dir>}"
repo_root="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)"

mkdir -p "$target"
# Root-scoped excludes are ANCHORED: rsync matches an unanchored name
# against the basename at ANY depth — `memory` also pruned lib/src/memory/,
# shipping v0.1.411 with broken memory imports (issue #613). build/ and
# .dart_tool stay unanchored: build artifacts may appear at any depth and
# never belong in the stage.
# gh-1452: /CHANGELOG_ARCHIVE.md (the lossless trimmed tail of CHANGELOG.md)
# has no consumer in the pub package — GitHub carries the history. It is
# excluded below; must mirror /CHANGELOG_ARCHIVE.md in .pubignore (guarded
# by test/publish_staging_test.dart).
rsync -a "$repo_root"/ "$target"/ \
  --include 'vendor/xterm/' --include 'vendor/xterm/**' \
  --include 'packages/fa_llm_mock/' --include 'packages/fa_llm_mock/**' \
  --exclude '/.git' --exclude '/.github' --exclude '/.worktrees' \
  --exclude '/flutter_app' --exclude '/browser_ext' \
  --exclude '/office_addin' --exclude '/yoclip' \
  --exclude 'vendor/*' --exclude '/docs' --exclude '/fa-local' \
  --exclude 'packages/*' \
  --exclude '/pubspec_overrides.yaml' \
  --exclude '/CHANGELOG_ARCHIVE.md' \
  --exclude '.dart_tool' --exclude 'build' \
  --exclude '/memory' --exclude '/.trash' --exclude '/coverage'

size=$(du -sm "$target" | cut -f1)
echo "staged package: ${size} MB"
if [ "$size" -gt 90 ]; then
  echo "::error::staged package is ${size} MB (>90) — pub.dev caps uploads at 100 MB. Trim the staging excludes."
  exit 1
fi

# gh-1220: the publish payload must mirror scripts/stage_publish_package.sh
# (issue #597) — the package surface only, never the sub-projects that share
# the repo root. The nightly/PR dry-runs validate at the REPO ROOT, where pub
# would otherwise pack everything under the root that git tracks: the
# flutter_app fastlane test fixtures (fake keys, #1046) trip the publish
# leak detector (nightly 37177316619, exit 65) and the payload blows past
# the pub.dev size cap (101.5 MB). This file changes only what pub SHIPS —
# nothing on disk is ignored for git, and the fastlane fixtures stay
# byte-identical for the tests that consume them.
#
# Keep in lockstep with stage_publish_package.sh — the mirror is guarded by
# test/publish_staging_test.dart. build/, .dart_tool/ and coverage/ need no
# entry here: .gitignore already keeps them out of pub's git file list.

# Sub-projects and non-package trees at the repo root (the #597 list).
/.git/
/.github/
/.worktrees/
/.trash/
/flutter_app/
/yoclip/
/browser_ext/
/office_addin/
/docs/
/memory/
/fa-local/
/coverage/

# Vendored forks: only the xterm dev-dependency ships (pubspec dev_deps).
/vendor/*
!/vendor/xterm/

# Local packages: only the fa_llm_mock dev-dependency ships.
/packages/*
!/packages/fa_llm_mock/

# Workspace-only dart_tui vendor pin — never published (see its header);
# shipped, it re-dangles dart_tui onto the excluded vendor dir (v0.1.407).
/pubspec_overrides.yaml

# gh-1452: the lossless archive of trimmed CHANGELOG.md sections (PR #1462)
# — GitHub carries the per-version history; pub consumers never read it and
# it grows at every future trim. Keep out of the payload; must mirror the
# rsync exclude in scripts/stage_publish_package.sh (guarded by
# test/publish_staging_test.dart).
/CHANGELOG_ARCHIVE.md

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Stage the publishable package into a target directory (issue #597).
#
# `dart publish` packs everything under the repo root that isn't
# gitignored — and the root hosts sub-projects that are NOT part of the
# pub package (flutter_app with its 57 MB wasm toolchain, yoclip media,
# browser_ext, office_addin, vendored forks, docs, packages/*). That
# blew the archive past pub.dev's hard 100 MB cap (v0.1.406: 100.4 MB).
#
# The staged copy carries the package surface (~32 MB) plus the two PATH
# dev-dependencies (packages/fa_llm_mock, vendored vendor/xterm —
# accepted by pub.dev since v0.1.369). pubspec_overrides.yaml (the
# local-only dart_tui vendor pin, "never ships to pub.dev" by its own
# comment) must NOT enter the stage: version solving would re-pin the
# path dep and fail (the v0.1.407 failure, exit 66).
#
# Usage: stage_publish_package.sh <target-dir>
# Exits non-zero (with ::error) when the staged tree exceeds the guard.
# The repo root hosts sub-projects that are NOT part of the pub package
# (flutter_app, yoclip, browser_ext, office_addin, vendored forks, docs)
# — `dart publish` packs everything under the root that isn't gitignored
# (v0.1.406: 100.4 MB, over pub.dev's hard cap). Stage the package
# surface instead. PATH dev-deps of the core pubspec must resolve inside
# the stage (#584, `dart pub get` exit 66 on v0.1.407): their subtrees
# are included BEFORE the parent excludes, and the parent excludes are
# child-scoped (vendor/*) — excluding the parent dir itself would prune
# the subtree before the includes are ever consulted.
# pubspec_overrides.yaml is the workspace-only dart_tui pin (never
# published, see its header); shipped into the stage it re-dangles
# dart_tui onto the excluded vendor dir.
set -euo pipefail

target="${1:?usage: stage_publish_package.sh <target-dir>}"
repo_root="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)"

mkdir -p "$target"
# Root-scoped excludes are ANCHORED: rsync matches an unanchored name
# against the basename at ANY depth — `memory` also pruned lib/src/memory/,
# shipping v0.1.411 with broken memory imports (issue #613). build/ and
# .dart_tool stay unanchored: build artifacts may appear at any depth and
# never belong in the stage.
# gh-1452: /CHANGELOG_ARCHIVE.md (the lossless trimmed tail of CHANGELOG.md)
# has no consumer in the pub package — GitHub carries the history. It is
# excluded below; must mirror /CHANGELOG_ARCHIVE.md in .pubignore (guarded
# by test/publish_staging_test.dart).
rsync -a "$repo_root"/ "$target"/ \
  --include 'vendor/xterm/' --include 'vendor/xterm/**' \
  --include 'packages/fa_llm_mock/' --include 'packages/fa_llm_mock/**' \
  --exclude '/.git' --exclude '/.github' --exclude '/.worktrees' \
  --exclude '/flutter_app' --exclude '/browser_ext' \
  --exclude '/office_addin' --exclude '/yoclip' \
  --exclude 'vendor/*' --exclude '/docs' --exclude '/fa-local' \
  --exclude 'packages/*' \
  --exclude '/pubspec_overrides.yaml' \
  --exclude '/CHANGELOG_ARCHIVE.md' \
  --exclude '.dart_tool' --exclude 'build' \
  --exclude '/memory' --exclude '/.trash' --exclude '/coverage'

size=$(du -sm "$target" | cut -f1)
echo "staged package: ${size} MB"
if [ "$size" -gt 90 ]; then
  echo "::error::staged package is ${size} MB (>90) — pub.dev caps uploads at 100 MB. Trim the staging excludes."
  exit 1
fi

blocks.text:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Stage the publishable package into a target directory (issue #597).
#
# `dart publish` packs everything under the repo root that isn't
# gitignored — and the root hosts sub-projects that are NOT part of the
# pub package (flutter_app with its 57 MB wasm toolchain, yoclip media,
# browser_ext, office_addin, vendored forks, docs, packages/*). That
# blew the archive past pub.dev's hard 100 MB cap (v0.1.406: 100.4 MB).
#
# The staged copy carries the package surface (~32 MB) plus the two PATH
# dev-dependencies (packages/fa_llm_mock, vendored vendor/xterm —
# accepted by pub.dev since v0.1.369). pubspec_overrides.yaml (the
# local-only dart_tui vendor pin, "never ships to pub.dev" by its own
# comment) must NOT enter the stage: version solving would re-pin the
# path dep and fail (the v0.1.407 failure, exit 66).
#
# Usage: stage_publish_package.sh <target-dir>
# Exits non-zero (with ::error) when the staged tree exceeds the guard.
# The repo root hosts sub-projects that are NOT part of the pub package
# (flutter_app, yoclip, browser_ext, office_addin, vendored forks, docs)
# — `dart publish` packs everything under the root that isn't gitignored
# (v0.1.406: 100.4 MB, over pub.dev's hard cap). Stage the package
# surface instead. PATH dev-deps of the core pubspec must resolve inside
# the stage (#584, `dart pub get` exit 66 on v0.1.407): their subtrees
# are included BEFORE the parent excludes, and the parent excludes are
# child-scoped (vendor/*) — excluding the parent dir itself would prune
# the subtree before the includes are ever consulted.
# pubspec_overrides.yaml is the workspace-only dart_tui pin (never
# published, see its header); shipped into the stage it re-dangles
# dart_tui onto the excluded vendor dir.
set -euo pipefail

target="${1:?usage: stage_publish_package.sh <target-dir>}"
repo_root="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)"

mkdir -p "$target"
# Root-scoped excludes are ANCHORED: rsync matches an unanchored name
# against the basename at ANY depth — `memory` also pruned lib/src/memory/,
# shipping v0.1.411 with broken memory imports (issue #613). build/ and
# .dart_tool stay unanchored: build artifacts may appear at any depth and
# never belong in the stage.
# gh-1452: /CHANGELOG_ARCHIVE.md (the lossless trimmed tail of CHANGELOG.md)
# has no consumer in the pub package — GitHub carries the history. It is
# excluded below; must mirror /CHANGELOG_ARCHIVE.md in .pubignore (guarded
# by test/publish_staging_test.dart).
rsync -a "$repo_root"/ "$target"/ \
  --include 'vendor/xterm/' --include 'vendor/xterm/**' \
  --include 'packages/fa_llm_mock/' --include 'packages/fa_llm_mock/**' \
  --exclude '/.git' --exclude '/.github' --exclude '/.worktrees' \
  --exclude '/flutter_app' --exclude '/browser_ext' \
  --exclude '/office_addin' --exclude '/yoclip' \
  --exclude 'vendor/*' --exclude '/docs' --exclude '/fa-local' \
  --exclude 'packages/*' \
  --exclude '/pubspec_overrides.yaml' \
  --exclude '/CHANGELOG_ARCHIVE.md' \
  --exclude '.dart_tool' --exclude 'build' \
  --exclude '/memory' --exclude '/.trash' --exclude '/coverage'

size=$(du -sm "$target" | cut -f1)
echo "staged package: ${size} MB"
if [ "$size" -gt 90 ]; then
  echo "::error::staged package is ${size} MB (>90) — pub.dev caps uploads at 100 MB. Trim the staging excludes."
  exit 1
fi

blocks.text:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Stage the publishable package into a target directory (issue #597).
#
# `dart publish` packs everything under the repo root that isn't
# gitignored — and the root hosts sub-projects that are NOT part of the
# pub package (flutter_app with its 57 MB wasm toolchain, yoclip media,
# browser_ext, office_addin, vendored forks, docs, packages/*). That
# blew the archive past pub.dev's hard 100 MB cap (v0.1.406: 100.4 MB).
#
# The staged copy carries the package surface (~32 MB) plus the two PATH
# dev-dependencies (packages/fa_llm_mock, vendored vendor/xterm —
# accepted by pub.dev since v0.1.369). pubspec_overrides.yaml (the
# local-only dart_tui vendor pin, "never ships to pub.dev" by its own
# comment) must NOT enter the stage: version solving would re-pin the
# path dep and fail (the v0.1.407 failure, exit 66).
#
# Usage: stage_publish_package.sh <target-dir>
# Exits non-zero (with ::error) when the staged tree exceeds the guard.
# The repo root hosts sub-projects that are NOT part of the pub package
# (flutter_app, yoclip, browser_ext, office_addin, vendored forks, docs)
# — `dart publish` packs everything under the root that isn't gitignored
# (v0.1.406: 100.4 MB, over pub.dev's hard cap). Stage the package
# surface instead. PATH dev-deps of the core pubspec must resolve inside
# the stage (#584, `dart pub get` exit 66 on v0.1.407): their subtrees
# are included BEFORE the parent excludes, and the parent excludes are
# child-scoped (vendor/*) — excluding the parent dir itself would prune
# the subtree before the includes are ever consulted.
# pubspec_overrides.yaml is the workspace-only dart_tui pin (never
# published, see its header); shipped into the stage it re-dangles
# dart_tui onto the excluded vendor dir.
set -euo pipefail

target="${1:?usage: stage_publish_package.sh <target-dir>}"
repo_root="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)"

mkdir -p "$target"
# Root-scoped excludes are ANCHORED: rsync matches an unanchored name
# against the basename at ANY depth — `memory` also pruned lib/src/memory/,
# shipping v0.1.411 with broken memory imports (issue #613). build/ and
# .dart_tool stay unanchored: build artifacts may appear at any depth and
# never belong in the stage.
# gh-1452: /CHANGELOG_ARCHIVE.md (the lossless trimmed tail of CHANGELOG.md)
# has no consumer in the pub package — GitHub carries the history. It is
# excluded below; must mirror /CHANGELOG_ARCHIVE.md in .pubignore (guarded
# by test/publish_staging_test.dart).
rsync -a "$repo_root"/ "$target"/ \
  --include 'vendor/xterm/' --include 'vendor/xterm/**' \
  --include 'packages/fa_llm_mock/' --include 'packages/fa_llm_mock/**' \
  --exclude '/.git' --exclude '/.github' --exclude '/.worktrees' \
  --exclude '/flutter_app' --exclude '/browser_ext' \
  --exclude '/office_addin' --exclude '/yoclip' \
  --exclude 'vendor/*' --exclude '/docs' --exclude '/fa-local' \
  --exclude 'packages/*' \
  --exclude '/pubspec_overrides.yaml' \
  --exclude '/CHANGELOG_ARCHIVE.md' \
  --exclude '.dart_tool' --exclude 'build' \
  --exclude '/memory' --exclude '/.trash' --exclude '/coverage'

size=$(du -sm "$target" | cut -f1)
echo "staged package: ${size} MB"
if [ "$size" -gt 90 ]; then
  echo "::error::staged package is ${size} MB (>90) — pub.dev caps uploads at 100 MB. Trim the staging excludes."
  exit 1
fi

The test checks `_ignoredByPubIgnore(rules, 'packages/*/pubspec.yaml', false)` — wait, body is `packages/*`, so it probes `${f.body}/pubspec.yaml` = `packages/*/pubspec.yaml`. Hmm, `_globMatch('packages/*', 'packages/*/pubspec.yaml')` — `*` matches `[^/]*`, so `packages/*` matches `packages/*`? The path to match is `packages/*/pubspec.yaml` — the glob `packages/*` would need to match the whole string; `*` = `[^/]*` can't cross `/`, so `packages/*` does NOT match `packages/*/pubspec.yaml`. Hmm wait, but `_ignoredByPubIgnore` evaluates per path prefix. Path `packages/*/pubspec.yaml` — prefixes: `packages` (dir), `packages/*` (dir), `packages/*/pubspec.yaml` (file). Rule `/packages/*` — body `packages/*` — matches prefix `packages/*` as dir? `_globMatch('packages/*', 'packages/*')` → `^packages/[^/]*$` matches "packages/*"? The literal `*` in the probed path is just a character; `[^/]*` matches `*`. Yes! So the rule `/packages/*` matches the prefix `packages/*` (the literal star), setting ignored=true. Rationale: fa_llm_flutter is `publish_to: none` — never published, so its visibility to pub is irrelevant; including it in the root payload only adds dead weight and risk (flutter files in the core payload, analyzed by stage analyze if went option A — we won't). Key findings:
- `packages/fa_llm_flutter` has `publish_to: none` — it is NEVER published. So the negation for fa_llm_flutter is unnecessary for publishing. Thread 10 suggested it perhaps for consistency, but the verified fix claim... Actually wait, thread 10 says the fix makes `dart publish --dry-run` from packages/fa_llm pass. fa_llm's own payload includes only files under packages/fa_llm. The fa_llm_flutter tree is irrelevant to fa_llm's publish. So minimal fix: only `!/packages/fa_llm/`.

But the commenter said "Verified fix (dry-run passes, 0 warnings): add !/packages/fa_llm/ and !/packages/fa_llm_flutter/". Maybe they added both because fa_llm's payload... no. fa_llm payload wouldn't include fa_llm_flutter regardless. Actually maybe they added both to keep symmetry. Hmm.

Minimal, surgical scope: add only `!/packages/fa_llm/`. Rationale: fa_llm_flutter is `publish_to: none` — never published, so its visibility to pub is irrelevant; including it in the root payload only adds dead weight and risk (flutter files in the core payload, analyzed by stage analyze if went option A — we won't). I'll go with option B (keep rsync excludes, pubignore-only negation) with just fa_llm, and update the mirror test tolerate the pubignore-only negation, with an explicit test pinning: packages/fa_llm is visible to pub (publishes clean), while the other packages/* trees (dap_hub, fa_ui, fa_llm_mock is allowed... wait fa_llm_mock is negated already as path dep) remain excluded from the root payload.

Wait — fa_llm_mock is currently negated (`!/packages/fa_llm_mock/`) and rides the root payload because it's a path dev-dep of the core pubspec. So precedent exists: pubignore negations can diverge from... no wait, fa_llm_mock is ALSO included in the stage (rsync includes packages/fa_llm_mock). So mirror is kept.

Decision rationale for option B over A: Option A (rsync includes) would put fa_llm (and its test/) into the staged publish payload shipped to pub.dev consumers — dead weight — and would require stage analyze to handle it. fa_llm is NOT a path dep of the core package, so it must not ride the core payload. The negation exists solely so pub's upward-walk from packages/fa_llm sees its own files. Option B keeps the shipped core payload unchanged while fixing the sub-package publish. This is the right call. The mirror test then needs: tolerate pubignore-only negations — i.e., verify the divergence is exactly the documented allowlist.

Now, does the nightly root dry-run change? Yes — nightly root dry-run payload now includes packages/fa_llm tree (1 MB). Any leak/PEM concerns? Let me check packages/fa_llm content for PEM-like strings. And size is trivial. Also nightly dry-run `--ignore-warnings`: could there be a new warning about... packages/fa_llm contains a pubspec.yaml of a different package riding inside — pub doesn't care about nested pubspecs in files. Fine.

Also verify: does pub from packages/fa_llm actually fail today? Let me try running `dart publish --dry-run` in packages/fa_llm to reproduce (RED). Check dart availability.

Also the curl fix in publish-fa-llm.yml.

Also: should the publish-fa-llm.yml workflow itself now get a dry-run validation? There might be a workflow-lint test that validates YAML. Let me check tests referencing workflows. Also check "actions stay SHA-pinned" validation exists. Fine.

Now also consider: maybe add a per-package `.pubignore` note? Not needed.

1. RED: extend `test/publish_staging_test.dart` with a test group "sub-package publishes see their own tree (gh-1511)": assert `_publishedByPub('packages/fa_llm/pubspec.yaml')` is true and `packages/fa_llm/LICENSE` true, and that other packages/* trees (`packages/fa_ui/...`, `packages/dap_hub/...`) remain excluded, and `packages/fa_llm_flutter`... hmm — if I don't negate fa_llm_flutter, then a test asserting fa_llm_flutter visible would fail. I'll assert fa_llm_flutter stays excluded with reason (publish_to: none). Also update the anti-drift test tolerate negations: the current anti-drift test iterates stage anchored excludes and asserts pubignore ignores `${f.body}/pubspec.yaml`. With the fa_llm negation, does it fail? Probe path is `packages/*/pubspec.yaml` (literal star) — negations don't match. So it passes as-is. But semantically, the anti-drift test should ensure negations are only for documented trees. I'll add a test: "pubignore negations are an explicit allowlist" — parse negated rules under packages/ and assert the set equals {fa_llm_mock, fa_llm}.

2. Also add a REAL verification: run `dart publish --dry-run` in packages/fa_llm before and after the .pubignore change to prove the fix (like thread 10 did). This is a bash verification, not a unit test — but TDD requires a failing test first. The unit test (simulator) reproduces the ignore-walk issue. Also run real dry-run as verification.

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

      - uses: actions/setup-python@5fda3b95a4ea91299a34e894583c3862153e4b97 # v7.0.0
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'

      - run: dart pub get

      # Publish gate at PR time: publish-blocking problems (undeclared lib/
      # imports, stray PEM-like strings) used to surface only in the tag-time
      # publish job — the v0.1.331 era: an undeclared package:cryptography
      # import shipped red on ~26 consecutive tags. --ignore-warnings: the
      # two known layout warnings (gitignored install_local.sh, docs/
      # naming) must not redden every PR, while validation ERRORS — "does
      # not have X in the dependencies section of pubspec.yaml" — still
      # fail. setup-dart (sdk >= 3.13) registers a publish-scoped PUB_TOKEN
      # job-wide and pub.dev rejects authenticated metadata reads, so
      # resolve unauthenticated (same pattern as the publish job);
      # --dry-run never uploads.
      - name: Publish dry-run (unauthenticated)
        run: |
          dart pub token remove https://pub.dev || true
          dart pub publish --dry-run --ignore-warnings

      # The example Flutter app lives in this repo; without its package
      # config the repo-wide `dart analyze` cannot resolve Flutter imports.
      - name: Example app pub get (for repo-wide analyze)
        uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

Fixed. The pre-flight probe now uses the repo's bounded-retry curl convention:

```bash
code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -I \
  --retry 3 --retry-all-errors --connect-timeout 15 --max-time 60 \
  https://pub.dev/api/packages/fa_llm || true)
```

- `--retry 3 --retry-all-errors` covers probe-style transient failures (curl 56 et al. — plain `--retry` skips them, per the `ci.yml` note).
- `--connect-timeout 15 --max-time 60` bounds the step well under any hang; the 404 ⇒ exit-10 / 200 ⇒ proceed semantics are unchanged.

Pinned by the new YAML-level guard `test/publish_fa_llm_preflight_guard_test.dart` (asserts each flag individually so a partial fix still reds — same static-guard pattern as `ci_pub_get_retry_guard_test.dart`).

Fixed in this round (same change as thread 1 — the probe still carried a bare `curl`). The pre-flight step now runs:

```bash
code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -I \
  --retry 3 --retry-all-errors --connect-timeout 15 --max-time 60 \
  https://pub.dev/api/packages/fa_llm || true)
```

This closes both consequences flagged here:

1. **Timeout** — `--connect-timeout 15 --max-time 60` fails fast instead of stalling to the job-level timeout.
2. **Retry** — `--retry 3 --retry-all-errors` retries probe-style transient failures (a plain `--retry` misses curl 56-class exits), so a transient blip no longer yields `000` and slips the publish through the warn-and-continue branch.

The 404 ⇒ actionable message + exit 10 / 200 ⇒ publish semantics are unchanged. Guarded by `test/publish_fa_llm_preflight_guard_test.dart`, which asserts each flag individually (a future bare `curl` is a test red).

name: Full quality gates
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@6afc89df92d6eb3834022f73cd65adc8cdfcb92d # v1
        with:
          sdk: stable

      - uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2
        with:
          channel: stable

      - uses: actions/setup-python@5fda3b95a4ea91299a34e894583c3862153e4b97 # v7.0.0
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'

      - run: dart pub get

      # Publish gate at PR time: publish-blocking problems (undeclared lib/
      # imports, stray PEM-like strings) used to surface only in the tag-time
      # publish job — the v0.1.331 era: an undeclared package:cryptography
      # import shipped red on ~26 consecutive tags. --ignore-warnings: the
      # two known layout warnings (gitignored install_local.sh, docs/
      # naming) must not redden every PR, while validation ERRORS — "does
      # not have X in the dependencies section of pubspec.yaml" — still
      # fail. setup-dart (sdk >= 3.13) registers a publish-scoped PUB_TOKEN
      # job-wide and pub.dev rejects authenticated metadata reads, so
      # resolve unauthenticated (same pattern as the publish job);
      # --dry-run never uploads.
      - name: Publish dry-run (unauthenticated)
        run: |
          dart pub token remove https://pub.dev || true
          dart pub publish --dry-run --ignore-warnings

      # The example Flutter app lives in this repo; without its package
      # config the repo-wide `dart analyze` cannot resolve Flutter imports.
      - name: Example app pub get (for repo-wide analyze)
        uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

arguments.content:
# Rework — PR #1512 (gh-1511 publish-fa-llm first-publish guard + docs)

## Issues/Notes

- **Review threads 1 & 2 (inline, `publish-fa-llm.yml`)** — the pre-flight probe used a bare `curl`: no timeout (a hung pub.dev connection stalls to the job-level timeout) and no retry (a transient blip yields `000` and slips the publish past the guard via warn-and-continue). **Fixed** with the repo's bounded-retry convention (`--retry 3 --retry-all-errors --connect-timeout 15 --max-time 60`), pinned by a new static guard test.
- **PR comment "The real bug" (root `.pubignore` hides `packages/fa_llm` from its own publish)** — reproduced locally: `dart pub publish --dry-run` in `packages/fa_llm` failed with `The pubspec is hidden` + `missing LICENSE` (README/CHANGELOG hidden too), exactly as reported. **Fixed** with a pubignore-only `!/packages/fa_llm/` negation; dry-run now passes with 0 errors / 0 warnings.
  - **Decision taken (the comment offered two options): keep the staging rsync excludes, pubignore-only negation** — `fa_llm` is not a path dependency of the core pubspec, so it must not ride the staged core payload; the negation exists only so pub's upward ignore walk sees the tree when publishing FROM `packages/fa_llm`. The mirror guard now tolerates pubignore-only negations **only** when pinned by an explicit allowlist (`vendor/xterm`, `packages/fa_llm_mock`, `packages/fa_llm`), and the anti-drift test enumerates real `/*`-scoped children instead of probing a literal `packages/*` path.
  - **Deviation from the suggested fix, with reason:** `!/packages/fa_llm_flutter/` was **not** added — `fa_llm_flutter` is `publish_to: none` (never published from this repo), so it needs no sub-package visibility, and keeping it hidden preserves the core payload. If a future `publish-fa_llm_flutter` workflow lands, it needs its own LICENSE first anyway; the guard test will point there.
- **Owner items (not code-actionable from here):**
  - Acceptance 2: confirm the OIDC publisher entry on pub.dev (repo `IstiN/flutter_agent_harness`, workflow `publish-fa-llm.yml`, tag pattern `fa_llm-v*`) and push a new `fa_llm-v*` tag.
  - Stray mistyped tag `vfa_llm-v0.1.1` (leading `v`) still exists on the remote — safe to delete; it never matched the `fa_llm-v*` trigger.

## Approach

TDD (RED → GREEN) for every change:

1. **RED** — extended `test/publish_staging_test.dart` with a `gh-1511 — sub-package publish sees its own tree` group (failing: `fa_llm` payload probes hidden, negation allowlist short one entry) and hardened the gh-1220 anti-drift mirror test to enumerate real `/*`-scoped children while tolerating only allowlisted pubignore-only negations. New `test/publish_fa_llm_preflight_guard_test.dart` asserts the probe curl carries each retry/timeout flag individually (failing on the bare curl). All new tests failed before the fix.
2. **GREEN** — added `--retry 3 --retry-all-errors --connect-timeout 15 --max-time 60` to the probe; added the documented `!/packages/fa_llm/` negation to root `.pubignore` (with a header comment explaining the pubignore-only divergence). Also restored the missing trailing newline at EOF of the workflow file.
3. **REFACTOR** — `dart format` + `dart analyze` clean on both test files.

## Files Modified

- `.github/workflows/publish-fa-llm.yml` — probe curl flags (review threads 1 & 2) + trailing newline.
- `.pubignore` — `!/packages/fa_llm/` negation with the gh-1511 rationale (pubignore-only, staging rsync unchanged).
- `test/publish_staging_test.dart` — new gh-1511 group (payload probes, explicit-allowlist, sibling trees stay hidden); anti-drift mirror test now enumerates real `/*`-scoped children and tolerates only allowlisted pubignore-only negations.
- `test/publish_fa_llm_preflight_guard_test.dart` — new static guard: YAML parses, probe + exit-10 guard present, each curl flag asserted individually.

## Test Coverage

{"content":"# Rework — PR #1512 (gh-1511 publish-fa-llm first-publish guard + docs)

## Issues/Notes

- **Review threads 1 & 2 (inline, `publish-fa-llm.yml`)** — the pre-flight probe used a bare `curl`: no timeout (a hung pub.dev connection stalls to the job-level timeout) and no retry (a transient blip yields `000` and slips the publish past the guard via warn-and-continue). **Fixed** with the repo's bounded-retry convention (`--retry 3 --retry-all-errors --connect-timeout 15 --max-time 60`), pinned by a new static guard test.
- **PR comment "The real bug" (root `.pubignore` hides `packages/fa_llm` from its own publish)** — reproduced locally: `dart pub publish --dry-run` in `packages/fa_llm` failed with `The pubspec is hidden` + `missing LICENSE` (README/CHANGELOG hidden too), exactly as reported. **Fixed** with a pubignore-only `!/packages/fa_llm/` negation; dry-run now passes with 0 errors / 0 warnings.
  - **Decision taken (the comment offered two options): keep the staging rsync excludes, pubignore-only negation** — `fa_llm` is not a path dependency of the core pubspec, so it must not ride the staged core payload; the negation exists only so pub's upward ignore walk sees the tree when publishing FROM `packages/fa_llm`. The mirror guard now tolerates pubignore-only negations **only** when pinned by an explicit allowlist (`vendor/xterm`, `packages/fa_llm_mock`, `packages/fa_llm`), and the anti-drift test enumerates real `/*`-scoped children instead of probing a literal `packages/*` path.
  - **Deviation from the suggested fix, with reason:** `!/packages/fa_llm_flutter/` was **not** added — `fa_llm_flutter` is `publish_to: none` (never published from this repo), so it needs no sub-package visibility, and keeping it hidden preserves the core payload. If a future `publish-fa_llm_flutter` workflow lands, it needs its own LICENSE first anyway; the guard test will point there.
- **Owner items (not code-actionable from here):**
  - Acceptance 2: confirm the OIDC publisher entry on pub.dev (repo `IstiN/flutter_agent_harness`, workflow `publish-fa-llm.yml`, tag pattern `fa_llm-v*`) and push a new `fa_llm-v*` tag.
  - Stray mistyped tag `vfa_llm-v0.1.1` (leading `v`) still exists on the remote — safe to delete; it never matched the `fa_llm-v*` trigger.

## Approach

TDD (RED → GREEN) for every change:

1. **RED** — extended `test/publish_staging_test.dart` with a `gh-1511 — sub-package publish sees its own tree` group (failing: `fa_llm` payload probes hidden, negation allowlist short one entry) and hardened the gh-1220 anti-drift mirror test to enumerate real `/*`-scoped children while tolerating only allowlisted pubignore-only negations. ```bash
code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -I \
  --retry 3 --retry-all-errors --connect-timeout 15 --max-time 60 \

- `--retry 3 --retry-all-errors` covers probe-style transient failures (curl 56 et al. — plain `--retry` skips them, per the `ci.yml` note).
- `--connect-timeout 15 --max-time 60` bounds the step well under any hang; the 404 ⇒ exit-10 / 200 ⇒ proceed semantics are unchanged.

{"content":"# Rework — PR #1512 (gh-1511 publish-fa-llm first-publish guard + docs)

## Issues/Notes

- **Review threads 1 & 2 (inline, `publish-fa-llm.yml`)** — the pre-flight probe used a bare `curl`: no timeout (a hung pub.dev connection stalls to the job-level timeout) and no retry (a transient blip yields `000` and slips the publish past the guard via warn-and-continue). **Fixed** with the repo's bounded-retry convention (`--retry 3 --retry-all-errors --connect-timeout 15 --max-time 60`), pinned by a new static guard test.
- **PR comment "The real bug" (root `.pubignore` hides `packages/fa_llm` from its own publish)** — reproduced locally: `dart pub publish --dry-run` in `packages/fa_llm` failed with `The pubspec is hidden` + `missing LICENSE` (README/CHANGELOG hidden too), exactly as reported. **Fixed** with a pubignore-only `!/packages/fa_llm/` negation; dry-run now passes with 0 errors / 0 warnings.
  - **Decision taken (the comment offered two options): keep the staging rsync excludes, pubignore-only negation** — `fa_llm` is not a path dependency of the core pubspec, so it must not ride the staged core payload; the negation exists only so pub's upward ignore walk sees the tree when publishing FROM `packages/fa_llm`. The mirror guard now tolerates pubignore-only negations **only** when pinned by an explicit allowlist (`vendor/xterm`, `packages/fa_llm_mock`, `packages/fa_llm`), and the anti-drift test enumerates real `/*`-scoped children instead of probing a literal `packages/*` path.
  - **Deviation from the suggested fix, with reason:** `!/packages/fa_llm_flutter/` was **not** added — `fa_llm_flutter` is `publish_to: none` (never published from this repo), so it needs no sub-package visibility, and keeping it hidden preserves the core payload. If a future `publish-fa_llm_flutter` workflow lands, it needs its own LICENSE first anyway; the guard test will point there.
- **Owner items (not code-actionable from here):**
  - Acceptance 2: confirm the OIDC publisher entry on pub.dev (repo `IstiN/flutter_agent_harness`, workflow `publish-fa-llm.yml`, tag pattern `fa_llm-v*`) and push a new `fa_llm-v*` tag.
  - Stray mistyped tag `vfa_llm-v0.1.1` (leading `v`) still exists on the remote — safe to delete; it never matched the `fa_llm-v*` trigger.

## Approach

TDD (RED → GREEN) for every change:

1. **RED** — extended `test/publish_staging_test.dart` with a `gh-1511 — sub-package publish sees its own tree` group (failing: `fa_llm` payload probes hidden, negation allowlist short one entry) and hardened the gh-1220 anti-drift mirror test to enumerate real `/*`-scoped children while tolerating only allowlisted pubignore-only negations. New `test/publish_fa_llm_preflight_guard_test.dart` asserts the probe curl carries each retry/timeout flag individually (failing on the bare curl). All new tests failed before the fix.
2. **GREEN** — added `--retry 3 --retry-all-errors --connect-timeout 15 --max-time 60` to the probe; added the documented `!/packages/fa_llm/` negation to root `.pubignore` (with a header comment explaining the pubignore-only divergence). Also restored the missing trailing newline at EOF of the workflow file.
3. **REFACTOR** — `dart format` + `dart analyze` clean on both test files.

## Files Modified

- `.github/workflows/publish-fa-llm.yml` — probe curl flags (review threads 1 & 2) + trailing newline.
- `.pubignore` — `!/packages/fa_llm/` negation with the gh-1511 rationale (pubignore-only, staging rsync unchanged).
- `test/publish_staging_test.dart` — new gh-1511 group (payload probes, explicit-allowlist, sibling trees stay hidden); anti-drift mirror test now enumerates real `/*`-scoped children and tolerates only allowlisted pubignore-only negations.
- `test/publish_fa_llm_preflight_guard_test.dart` — new static guard: YAML parses, probe + exit-10 guard present, each curl flag asserted individually.

## Test Coverage

- **New unit guards:** 16/16 pass in `test/publish_staging_test.dart` + `test/publish_fa_llm_preflight_guard_test.dart` (5 new tests total: 3 pubignore + 2 curl-guard).
- **Real verification:** `dart pub publish --dry-run` in `packages/fa_llm` — before: `The pubspec is hidden` + `missing LICENSE` (2 errors); after: payload includes pubspec/LICENSE/README/CHANGELOG/lib, **0 errors, 0 warnings** (1 pre-existing version-increment hint). Key-material scan of the fa_llm trees: clean.
- **No core-payload regression:** root-level `dart pub publish --dry-run --ignore-warnings` passes with only the 3 known pre-existing layout warnings; staging script untouched, so the staged core payload is byte-identical to before.
- **Full suite:** `dart test` (repo-wide) run in background — result appended below when complete.

{"content":"# Rework — PR #1512 (gh-1511 publish-fa-llm first-publish guard + docs)

## Issues/Notes

- **Review threads 1 & 2 (inline, `publish-fa-llm.yml`)** — the pre-flight probe used a bare `curl`: no timeout (a hung pub.dev connection stalls to the job-level timeout) and no retry (a transient blip yields `000` and slips the publish past the guard via warn-and-continue). **Fixed** with the repo's bounded-retry convention (`--retry 3 --retry-all-errors --connect-timeout 15 --max-time 60`), pinned by a new static guard test.
- **PR comment "The real bug" (root `.pubignore` hides `packages/fa_llm` from its own publish)** — reproduced locally: `dart pub publish --dry-run` in `packages/fa_llm` failed with `The pubspec is hidden` + `missing LICENSE` (README/CHANGELOG hidden too), exactly as reported. **Fixed** with a pubignore-only `!/packages/fa_llm/` negation; dry-run now passes with 0 errors / 0 warnings.
  - **Decision taken (the comment offered two options): keep the staging rsync excludes, pubignore-only negation** — `fa_llm` is not a path dependency of the core pubspec, so it must not ride the staged core payload; the negation exists only so pub's upward ignore walk sees the tree when publishing FROM `packages/fa_llm`. The mirror guard now tolerates pubignore-only negations **only** when pinned by an explicit allowlist (`vendor/xterm`, `packages/fa_llm_mock`, `packages/fa_llm`), and the anti-drift test enumerates real `/*`-scoped children instead of probing a literal `packages/*` path.
  - **Deviation from the suggested fix, with reason:** `!/packages/fa_llm_flutter/` was **not** added — `fa_llm_flutter` is `publish_to: none` (never published from this repo), so it needs no sub-package visibility, and keeping it hidden preserves the core payload. If a future `publish-fa_llm_flutter` workflow lands, it needs its own LICENSE first anyway; the guard test will point there.
- **Owner items (not code-actionable from here):**
  - Acceptance 2: confirm the OIDC publisher entry on pub.dev (repo `IstiN/flutter_agent_harness`, workflow `publish-fa-llm.yml`, tag pattern `fa_llm-v*`) and push a new `fa_llm-v*` tag.
  - Stray mistyped tag `vfa_llm-v0.1.1` (leading `v`) still exists on the remote — safe to delete; it never matched the `fa_llm-v*` trigger.

## Approach

TDD (RED → GREEN) for every change:

1. **RED** — extended `test/publish_staging_test.dart` with a `gh-1511 — sub-package publish sees its own tree` group (failing: `fa_llm` payload probes hidden, negation allowlist short one entry) and hardened the gh-1220 anti-drift mirror test to enumerate real `/*`-scoped children while tolerating only allowlisted pubignore-only negations. New `test/publish_fa_llm_preflight_guard_test.dart` asserts the probe curl carries each retry/timeout flag individually (failing on the bare curl). All new tests failed before the fix.
2. **GREEN** — added `--retry 3 --retry-all-errors --connect-timeout 15 --max-time 60` to the probe; added the documented `!/packages/fa_llm/` negation to root `.pubignore` (with a header comment explaining the pubignore-only divergence). Also restored the missing trailing newline at EOF of the workflow file.
3. **REFACTOR** — `dart format` + `dart analyze` clean on both test files.

## Files Modified

- `.github/workflows/publish-fa-llm.yml` — probe curl flags (review threads 1 & 2) + trailing newline.
- `.pubignore` — `!/packages/fa_llm/` negation with the gh-1511 rationale (pubignore-only, staging rsync unchanged).
- `test/publish_staging_test.dart` — new gh-1511 group (payload probes, explicit-allowlist, sibling trees stay hidden); anti-drift mirror test now enumerates real `/*`-scoped children and tolerates only allowlisted pubignore-only negations.
- `test/publish_fa_llm_preflight_guard_test.dart` — new static guard: YAML parses, probe + exit-10 guard present, each curl flag asserted individually.

## Test Coverage

- **New unit guards:** 16/16 pass in `test/publish_staging_test.dart` + `test/publish_fa_llm_preflight_guard_test.dart` (5 new tests total: 3 pubignore + 2 curl-guard).
- **Real verification:** `dart pub publish --dry-run` in `packages/fa_llm` — before: `The pubspec is hidden` + `missing LICENSE` (2 errors); after: payload includes pubspec/LICENSE/README/CHANGELOG/lib, **0 errors, 0 warnings** (1 pre-existing version-increment hint). Key-material scan of the fa_llm trees: clean.
- **No core-payload regression:** root-level `dart pub publish --dry-run --ignore-warnings` passes with only the 3 known pre-existing layout warnings; staging script untouched, so the staged core payload is byte-identical to before.
- **Full suite:** `dart test` (repo-wide) run in background — result appended below when complete.

{"content":"# Rework — PR #1512 (gh-1511 publish-fa-llm first-publish guard + docs)

## Issues/Notes

- **Review threads 1 & 2 (inline, `publish-fa-llm.yml`)** — the pre-flight probe used a bare `curl`: no timeout (a hung pub.dev connection stalls to the job-level timeout) and no retry (a transient blip yields `000` and slips the publish past the guard via warn-and-continue). **Fixed** with the repo's bounded-retry convention (`--retry 3 --retry-all-errors --connect-timeout 15 --max-time 60`), pinned by a new static guard test.
- **PR comment "The real bug" (root `.pubignore` hides `packages/fa_llm` from its own publish)** — reproduced locally: `dart pub publish --dry-run` in `packages/fa_llm` failed with `The pubspec is hidden` + `missing LICENSE` (README/CHANGELOG hidden too), exactly as reported. **Fixed** with a pubignore-only `!/packages/fa_llm/` negation; dry-run now passes with 0 errors / 0 warnings.
  - **Decision taken (the comment offered two options): keep the staging rsync excludes, pubignore-only negation** — `fa_llm` is not a path dependency of the core pubspec, so it must not ride the staged core payload; the negation exists only so pub's upward ignore walk sees the tree when publishing FROM `packages/fa_llm`. The mirror guard now tolerates pubignore-only negations **only** when pinned by an explicit allowlist (`vendor/xterm`, `packages/fa_llm_mock`, `packages/fa_llm`), and the anti-drift test enumerates real `/*`-scoped children instead of probing a literal `packages/*` path.
  - **Deviation from the suggested fix, with reason:** `!/packages/fa_llm_flutter/` was **not** added — `fa_llm_flutter` is `publish_to: none` (never published from this repo), so it needs no sub-package visibility, and keeping it hidden preserves the core payload. If a future `publish-fa_llm_flutter` workflow lands, it needs its own LICENSE first anyway; the guard test will point there.
- **Owner items (not code-actionable from here):**
  - Acceptance 2: confirm the OIDC publisher entry on pub.dev (repo `IstiN/flutter_agent_harness`, workflow `publish-fa-llm.yml`, tag pattern `fa_llm-v*`) and push a new `fa_llm-v*` tag.
  - Stray mistyped tag `vfa_llm-v0.1.1` (leading `v`) still exists on the remote — safe to delete; it never matched the `fa_llm-v*` trigger.

## Approach

TDD (RED → GREEN) for every change:

1. **RED** — extended `test/publish_staging_test.dart` with a `gh-1511 — sub-package publish sees its own tree` group (failing: `fa_llm` payload probes hidden, negation allowlist short one entry) and hardened the gh-1220 anti-drift mirror test to enumerate real `/*`-scoped children while tolerating only allowlisted pubignore-only negations. New `test/publish_fa_llm_preflight_guard_test.dart` asserts the probe curl carries each retry/timeout flag individually (failing on the bare curl). All new tests failed before the fix.
2. **GREEN** — added `--retry 3 --retry-all-errors --connect-timeout 15 --max-time 60` to the probe; added the documented `!/packages/fa_llm/` negation to root `.pubignore` (with a header comment explaining the pubignore-only divergence). Also restored the missing trailing newline at EOF of the workflow file.
3. **REFACTOR** — `dart format` + `dart analyze` clean on both test files.

## Files Modified

- `.github/workflows/publish-fa-llm.yml` — probe curl flags (review threads 1 & 2) + trailing newline.
- `.pubignore` — `!/packages/fa_llm/` negation with the gh-1511 rationale (pubignore-only, staging rsync unchanged).
- `test/publish_staging_test.dart` — new gh-1511 group (payload probes, explicit-allowlist, sibling trees stay hidden); anti-drift mirror test now enumerates real `/*`-scoped children and tolerates only allowlisted pubignore-only negations.
- `test/publish_fa_llm_preflight_guard_test.dart` — new static guard: YAML parses, probe + exit-10 guard present, each curl flag asserted individually.

## Test Coverage

- **New unit guards:** 16/16 pass in `test/publish_staging_test.dart` + `test/publish_fa_llm_preflight_guard_test.dart` (5 new tests total: 3 pubignore + 2 curl-guard).
- **Real verification:** `dart pub publish --dry-run` in `packages/fa_llm` — before: `The pubspec is hidden` + `missing LICENSE` (2 errors); after: payload includes pubspec/LICENSE/README/CHANGELOG/lib, **0 errors, 0 warnings** (1 pre-existing version-increment hint). Key-material scan of the fa_llm trees: clean.
- **No core-payload regression:** root-level `dart pub publish --dry-run --ignore-warnings` passes with only the 3 known pre-existing layout warnings; staging script untouched, so the staged core payload is byte-identical to before.
- **Full suite:** `dart test` (repo-wide) run in background — result appended below when complete.
